  • All engagements subject to successful Background Verification (BGV)
  • Candidates must keep their email ID active for one year

Junior Assistant (Fire Services): 10th Pass + 3 years approved regular Diploma in Mechanical/Automobile/Fire with minimum 50% marks; OR 12th Pass (Regular Study) with 50% marks.
  • Essential qualifications: Senior Assistant (Electronics): Diploma in Electronics/Telecommunication/Radio Engineering. Junior Assistant (HR): Graduation + 30/25 w.p.m English/Hindi Typing speed. Junior Assistant (Fire Services): 10th Pass + 3 years approved regular Diploma in Mechanical/Automobile/Fire with minimum 50% marks; OR 12th Pass (Regular Study) with 50% marks.

Salary/Stipend

  • Junior Assistant (HR) and Junior Assistant (Fire Services): Rs. 31000-3%-92000

Age Limit (as on 06-12-2025)

  • Maximum Age: 30 years

  • 5 years for SC/ST

Application Fee

  • General, EWS and OBC Category: Rs. 1000/-
  • Women/SC/ST/PWD/Ex-Servicemen and Apprentices who have completed 01 year Apprenticeship Training in AAI: No application fee

Important Dates

Date Description
12/12/2025 Opening Date for On-Line Application
11/01/2026 Last Date for On-Line Application

Selection Process

  • Senior Assistant (Electronics): Written Exam (Computer Based Test). Duration of Exam: 2(Two) hours. Document Verification/Skill Test.
  • Junior Assistant (HR): Written Exam (Computer Based Test). Duration of Exam-2 (Two) hours. Computer Literacy test in MS Office.
  • Junior Assistant (Fire Services): Written Exam (Computer Based Test)- Duration: 2 (Two) hours. Physical Measurement Test, Driving Test, Physical Endurance Test.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only candidates who are Domicile of Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland and Tripura for the posts of Senior Assistant (Electronics), Junior Assistant (HR) and Junior Assistant (Fire Services) for its various airports in North Eastern Region.
  • No application through any other mode will be accepted.
  • The number of vacancies are tentative. Airports Authority of India (AAI) reserves the right to increase or decrease the vacancies depending upon the future requirements. AAI also reserves the right to modify/cancel the recruitment process, if need so arises without issuing any further notice or any reasons what so ever. The decision of the Management will be final and binding and no appeal shall be entertained.
  • Definition of various categories of disability identified suitable for the post shall be defined under RPwD Act. 2016 and subsequent amendments thereof.
  • Ex-Servicemen who have already secured employment in civil sector under Center Government/State Government of in Group-‘C’ & ‘D’ posts on regular basis after availing the benefits of reservation given of Ex-Servicemen to their re-employment are not eligible for reservation for appointment under Ex-Servicemen categories. However, they are eligible for age relaxation only. Age relaxation/ESM reservation is not admissible to sons, daughter and dependent of ESM. Therefore, such candidates should not indicate their category as Ex-Servicemen.
  • Disabled candidates are not eligible for the post of Junior Assistant (Fire Service) due to specific nature of job.
  • The vacancy reserved for Ex-SM/Ex-Agniveers/PWD will be filled from any category and adjusted horizontally against respective categories viz-UR/SC/ST/OBC as the case may be depending upon the category to which the selected candidate belongs to, within the respective total vacancies of the posts.
  • Fees will be accepted through online net banking, Debit card, Credit cards or Internet Banking/UPI etc.
  • Excluding of Bank Charges & Service Tax.
  • For detailed Notification, Please refer AAI website.
  • Candidates should have a valid personal e-mail ID & Mobile No. and must ensure that it is active during the entire recruitment process.
  • The eligibility with respect to Age, Education Qualification and Experience etc. will be determined as on 06/12/2025.
  • Where CGPA/OGPA/DGPA/CPI etc. is awarded in the essential qualification degree examination, percentage (%) of marks shall be arrived by applying the following formula Eg: If CGPA/OGPA/DGPA/CPI is 6.75 (Out of 10), then equivalent percentage (%) of marks would be 6.75*9.5=64.125%.
  • The date of declaration of result/issuance of mark sheets shall be deemed to be the date of acquiring of qualification and there shall be no relaxation on this account.
  • The education and other qualification must be obtained from Govt. recognized institutions as per laid down criteria by Central Govt. for the purpose.
  • AAI will not bear any liability on account of salary/leave salary/pension contribution etc. if any, of previous employment of any candidate already working in Central Government/Autonomous Institution/State Government.

How to Apply

  • Candidates shall apply only ONLINE through Airports Authority of India website www.aai.aero under tab “CAREERS” for the above posts.
  • Post submission, the candidate will be re-directed to make the online payment of application fee.
  • Kindly verify the details and make the payment for application fee via the different payment modes.
  • After successful payment of application fee, candidate will be redirected to his/her application form.

Name of posts No of Vacancy

Senior Project Officer (Electrical) 1

Project Officer (Safety) 1
Total 4

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications for SPO (Mechanical/Electrical): Degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering with minimum 60% marks from a recognized University.
  • Qualifications for SPO (Safety): Degree in Safety Engineering OR Engineering Degree (any branch) OR Degree in Physics/Chemistry OR Diploma in Engineering (any branch).
  • Qualifications for PO (Safety): Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Industrial Safety recognized by State Govt. (requirements may vary based on base degree/diploma).
  • Essential qualifications (Experience):
    • SPO (Mechanical/Electrical): Minimum 4 years post qualification experience in Ship Building/Repair/Marine related/Port/Engineering/Govt/Semi-Govt company.
    • SPO (Safety): 4 years experience for Engineering Degree holders; 7 years experience for other Degree/Diploma holders in safety/production/maintenance department of a Shipyard/Factory handling HSE activities.
    • PO (Safety): 2 years experience for Engineering Degree holders; 5 years experience for other Degree/Diploma holders in safety/production/maintenance department of a Shipyard/Factory handling HSE activities.
  • Desirable: Proficiency and experience of working in a computerized environment (for Mech/Elect SPO). Proficiency in Computer Applications like AutoCAD, SAP, MS Project, MS Office etc. is preferred in general.
  • Experience: Experience acquired after the stipulated qualification date is considered, reckoned as on 31st December 2025. Training with remuneration is treated as experience. Certificates from registered companies/foreign companies are considered.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Project Officer:
    • First Year: ₹63,100/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Second Year: ₹65,200/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Third Year: ₹67,300/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fourth Year: ₹69,400/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fifth Year: ₹71,500/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
  • Project Officer:
    • First Year: ₹49,100/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Second Year: ₹51,200/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Third Year: ₹53,300/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fourth Year: ₹55,400/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fifth Year: ₹57,500/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • For the post of Project Officer, age shall not exceed 30 years as on 31 December 2025.
  • For the post of Senior Project Officer, age shall not exceed 35 years as on 31 December 2025.
  • Age limit after applying all relaxations (Ex-servicemen etc.) shall not exceed 50 years.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of ₹400/- (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra) should be remitted online.
  • Applicants belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC)/ Scheduled Tribe (ST) are exempted from payment of application fee.

Important Dates

Event Date
Commencement of Online Application 16th December 2025
Last Date of Online Application 31st December 2025
Application Fee Payment Window closes 31st December 2025

Selection Process

  • Selection will be through Power Point Presentation (80 marks for assessing work experience) and Personal Interview (20 marks).
  • Total marks for final selection: 100 marks.
  • CSL reserves the right to hold an objective type test for shortlisting if many applications are received. These test marks will not be used in the final rank list preparation.
  • Certificate verification will be conducted before the Presentation and Interview.
  • Rank lists will be prepared based on aggregate marks in Presentation and Interview, with tie-breaking based on Presentation marks first, then age seniority.

General Information/Instructions

  • The posts are purely temporary on a contract basis for a maximum period of five years.
  • Posting shall be at CSL AN Ship Repair Unit (CANSRU), Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands/ any other CSL units/project sites as desired by CSL.
  • The posts are not identified as suitable for Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) due to job requirements (working at heights, confined spaces, etc.).
  • Candidates must meet eligibility requirements before applying. Upload all necessary certificates with the online application.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.
  • Call letters will be sent by e-mail/published on the CSL website only.

How To Apply

  • Applicants must visit the website www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page→ CANSRU, Andaman) and follow the User Manual/FAQ.
  • Complete the one-time registration on the SAP Online portal and submit the application against the post from 16 December 2025 to 31 December 2025.
  • Ensure all certificates and a recent passport size colour photograph are uploaded.
  • Ensure the application status shows "In process" after final submission.
  • Retain a soft copy/printout of the online application with the unique registration number for future correspondence.
  • Do not send the application printout/certificates by post.

  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.

How to Apply

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities who possess the prescribed qualifications and experience as per Recruitment Rules for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I).

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) carries the scale of pay of Rs. 50,000–1,60,000/- (pre-revised Rs. 10,750–16,750) in the Civil Engineering Department, Visakhapatnam Port Authority.
  • Officers selected on deputation will have the option either to get their pay fixed in the deputation post under normal rules or to draw pay of the post held in parent department plus deputation (duty) allowance as per applicable government orders.

7. Are advance copies of applications accepted by VPA?

Ans: No, advance copies from applicants will not be accepted; only applications forwarded by the Competent Authority within due date will be considered.

8. What documents must accompany the application for Executive Engineer (Civil) post?

Ans: Certified ACRs/APARs for last 5 years, attested copies of educational and experience certificates, undertaking of non-withdrawal of candidature, No Objection Certificate, Vigilance/Administrative clearance, certificate verifying degrees, and complete service details must be enclosed.

9. What is the crucial date for determining eligibility for VPA Executive Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: The crucial date for determining educational qualifications, experience and age is the last date of closing of applications, i.e. 19.01.2026.

10. Is any application fee prescribed for VPA Executive Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: The vacancy circular does not mention any application fee for this absorption/deputation-based recruitment.

11. Can VPA change the number of vacancies notified for Executive Engineer (Civil)?

Ans: Yes, Visakhapatnam Port Authority reserves the right to cancel or make changes in the number of vacancies without assigning any reasons.

12. Where can candidates view the full circular and annexures for VPA Executive Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: The circular along with annexures is available on the Visakhapatnam Port Authority website www.vizagport.com.

Advertisement
Details Information
Organization Name Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL)
Post Name General Manager (Technical/HR), Deputy General Manager (HR), Manager (HR), Deputy Manager (Safety/Finance), Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical), Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works) and other posts as per detailed advertisement

Salary/Pay Scale IDA pay scales from Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000 (E2) up to Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000 (E7) with Industrial DA, HRA, Allowances etc. and consolidated pay of approx. Rs. 2,15,000/- per month for FTC and Rs. 1,20,000/- per month for Consultant.

Application End Date 13/01/2026 up to 17:00 hrs
Application Mode Online only through the official website; no other mode is accepted.
Official Website hslvizag.in

HSL Various Posts 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for HSL Recruitment 2025 as per the detailed advertisement is distributed as follows:

  • On Permanent Absorption Basis:
    • P1 – General Manager (Technical) (E7) – Post Code 04/2025/GM01 – 01 Post (OBC)
    • P2 – General Manager (HR) (E7) – Post Code 04/2025/GM02 – 01 Post (OBC)
    • P3 – Deputy General Manager (HR) (E5) – Post Code 04/2025/DGM01 – 01 Post (UR)
    • P4 – Manager (HR) (E3) – Post Code 04/2025/MGR01 – 03 Posts (01 OBC; 01 SC; 01 ST)
    • P5 – Deputy Manager (Safety) (E2) – Post Code 04/2025/DM01 – 01 Post (UR)
    • P6 – Deputy Manager (Finance) (E2) – Post Code 04/2025/DM02 – 01 Post (UR)
  • On Fixed Term Contract (FTC) Basis:
    • F1 – Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) [Equivalent to CGM (E8)] – Post Code 04/2025/CGM01 – 02 Posts (01 UR; 01 OBC)
  • Consultant on Fixed Term Contract & Part Time Basis:
    • C1 – Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works) – Post Code 04/2025/CON01 – 01 Post

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • General Manager (Technical) (E7): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Naval Architecture disciplines from a recognised University/Institute registered with AICTE. Desirable – Post-graduation in Engineering/Management.
  • General Manager (HR) (E7): Full-time Graduate in any discipline with not less than 60% marks and full-time Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Management with specialization in HR/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare from UGC-recognised University/Institute with not less than 60% marks. Desirable – Degree in Law.
  • Deputy General Manager (HR) (E5): Full-time Graduate with 60% marks and full-time PG Degree/Diploma in Management specializing in HR/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare with 60% marks. Desirable – Degree in Law.
  • Manager (HR) (E3): Full-time Graduate with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST) and full-time PG Degree/Diploma in Management with specialization in HR/Personnel Management/Labour Laws from UGC-recognised University/Institute. Desirable – LLB/LLM.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety) (E2): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in any discipline from AICTE-recognised University/Institute and full-time Diploma (not less than 1 year) in Industrial Safety from recognised University/AICTE.
  • Deputy Manager (Finance) (E2): Graduate with Qualified/Passed Final Examination from ICAI/ICWAI; MBA Finance desirable.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) (FTC): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Naval Architecture disciplines; Post-graduation in Engineering/Management desirable.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Engineering Graduate or equivalent in Civil Engineering from AICTE-recognised University/Institute; Post-graduation in Civil Engineering and Marine works course from IIT/other reputed institute desirable.

2. Experience

  • GM (Technical/HR): At least 22 years of post-qualification experience in Indian Navy/PSUs/large reputed private companies with specified shipbuilding/HR experience and minimum 3 years in immediate lower grade or equivalent CTC and level in private sector.
  • DGM (HR): At least 15 years’ post-qualification HR/Personnel/IR experience with required lower grade/CTC experience.
  • Manager (HR): Minimum 9 years’ post-qualification experience in HR/Personnel/IR/Legal/Administration in Govt/PSU/large private companies; preference for legal and RTI experience.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety): Minimum 5 years’ experience in Safety department in PSUs/large industrial establishments with statutory compliance exposure under Factories Act and AP Factory Rules.
  • Deputy Manager (Finance): Minimum 5 years’ post-qualification experience in Finance/Cost Accounting/Management/Funds/Budgeting/Auditing/Cost control in Govt/PSU/Private of repute.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical): At least 24 years’ post-qualification experience with shipbuilding/design/repairs/warships/submarines and specified minimum service in lower grade/CTC levels.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): At least 25 years’ experience in planning/construction of defence projects, marine works (jetties/bridges), with structural design knowledge; retired Group A officers in pay level 13 of 7th CPC preferred.

3. Age Limit (as on 23/12/2025)

  • GM (Technical/HR): Maximum 52 years.
  • DGM (HR) & Manager (HR): Maximum 45 years.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety/Finance): Maximum 35 years.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical): Maximum 56 years.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Maximum 62 years.
  • Relaxations: 5 years relaxation in age and 1 year in lower-grade experience for internal permanent employees; age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-servicemen as per Government rules.

Selection Process

  • Candidates meeting essential qualification, experience and grade/CTC criteria will be shortlisted for interview, conducted either online (VC mode) or physically at HSL, Visakhapatnam.
  • The selection process may include group discussion, preliminary screening interview and final selection interview; decision of the selection committee will be final.
  • Shortlisting may be in a ratio not exceeding 06 times the number of vacancies, based on percentage of marks in essential qualification/graduation if large number of applications are received.
  • Shortlisted candidates called for physical interview will be reimbursed 1st AC train fare (P1–P4 posts) and 2nd AC train fare (P5–P6 etc.) by shortest route; air travel is allowed at candidate’s option but reimbursement limited to train fare.
  • Detailed scrutiny of applications will be done and mere issuance of call letter does not imply eligibility; management reserves right to change selection criteria or cancel the recruitment process.

Application Fee

  • Application fee: Rs. 300/- (Rupees Three Hundred only).
  • No registration fee for SC/ST/PH and internal candidates.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances; candidates must verify eligibility before applying.
  • Payment should be made through online mode; receipt of online payment is to be saved for future reference.

How To Apply

  • Visit the official website: hslvizag.in.
  • Go to “Careers” under “Human Resources” and open “Current Openings” to view the advertisement and posts.
  • Read the detailed advertisement and ensure you meet all eligibility criteria as on 23/12/2025.
  • Submit application online only via https://www.hslvizag.in; no other mode is accepted.
  • Register and complete three stages: Personal Details, Educational Details and Payment Details.
  • Upload mandatory self-attested documents: SSC/Intermediate/Diploma/Degree/PG mark sheets and certificates, proof of date of birth, caste/PH certificate, experience certificates, latest salary certificate, Annexure-I and other relevant documents.
  • Upload photograph (20–50 KB) and signature (10–20 KB) in prescribed size and format.
  • Select “Experienced” or “Management Trainee” appropriately against “Type of post” as per instructions.
  • Use SAVE button to avoid data loss and SUBMIT only after verifying all details; once submitted, editing is not allowed.
  • After successful submission, receive confirmation message and email with Registration ID and link to view submitted application; take a print-out for future reference.
  • For registration issues or clarifications, contact [email protected] electronically.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement / Cut-off Date (Age & Experience) 23/12/2025
Date of commencement of ONLINE application for all posts 23/12/2025 from 10:00 hrs
Last Date for ONLINE submission for all posts 13/01/2026 up to 17:00 hrs (once submitted, editing not allowed)
Possible extension for selective posts May be extended at the discretion of HSL (if decided)

Salary/Stipend

  • Permanent Positions: IDA pay scales – E7: Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000; E5: Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000; E3: Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000; E2: Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000.
  • In addition to Basic Pay, regular officers are entitled to Industrial DA, HRA, Allowances (27% of Basic Pay under cafeteria approach subject to Govt review), Contributory PF, Gratuity, reimbursement of medical expenses at CGHS rates for in-patient treatment, leave encashment, subsidized lunch and other benefits as per company policies/Govt regulations.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) – FTC: Approx. consolidated pay of Rs. 2,15,000/- per month on fixed term contract for 3 years extendable by 1+1 years or till 60 years of age, whichever earlier.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Rs. 1,20,000/- per month with retention incentive of Rs. 3,000/- on completion of every year till contract closure, with TA/DA, travel arrangements (for non-Vizag residents) and accommodation as per E7-equivalent rules.

Instructions

  • Indian Nationals only are eligible to apply.
  • All vacancies are primarily for Visakhapatnam; selected officers may be transferred to project locations for up to 2 years in one stretch and may undertake outstation duties to Delhi/Yards/Vendor premises as required.
  • Applications submitted other than the prescribed online method will be rejected; incomplete applications or those lacking requisite documents will be summarily dismissed.
  • Aggregate percentage of marks shall not be rounded off; for CGPA/OGPA/Grade, conversion to percentage must follow University formula or factor 10 with documentary proof where no formula is prescribed.
  • Training period, teaching experience, apprenticeship/internship and sabbatical/extraordinary leave will not be counted toward required experience.
  • Reservation rules for SC/ST/OBC/EWS will apply; category certificates must be in prescribed format and within one year from date of advertisement for OBC (non-creamy layer) and EWS “Income & Asset” certificates.
  • Candidates from Govt/PSU/private sector must submit NOC/CTC and turnover proof as applicable; failure to do so may lead to summary rejection.
  • All original documents will be verified at the time of interview; non-production will debar the candidate from interview and travel fare reimbursement.
  • Management reserves the right to create and operate a panel, increase/decrease number of posts, consider candidates for lower posts/grades, relax qualification/experience/age in exceptional cases, or cancel the recruitment process without notice.
  • All correspondence including interview call letters will be through email only; candidates must keep the registered email active and also check spam/junk folders.
  • Appointments are subject to medical fitness and submission of dependents’ medical history declaration and medical test reports prior to joining; canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature.

Official Website https://eastgodavari.ap.gov.in/

GMC & GTGH Rajamahendravaram Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

Name of the Post GMC Vacancies GTGH Vacancies Total Vacancies Mode of Filling
Office Subordinate 09 16 25 Out Sourcing
Anesthesia Technician 00 02 02 Contract
Cardiology Technician 00 03 03 Contract
Lab Technician 00 02 02 Contract
Operation Theatre Technician 00 02 02 Contract
General Duty Attendant 01 19 20 Out Sourcing
Store Attendant 00 03 03 Out Sourcing
Lab Attendant 01 00 01 Out Sourcing
ECG Technician 00 01 01 Contract
Library Assistant 01 00 01 Contract
Total 12 48 60  
Contract Posts: 11 | Out Sourcing Posts: 49

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications:

  • Office Subordinate: Must have passed SSC or equivalent
  • Anesthesia Technician: Must possess Intermediate with science Groups and 2 years Diploma in Anaesthesia Technician. Must be registered in APPMB
  • Cardiology Technician: B.Sc Degree from a Recognized University with 2 years Diploma in Cardiology Technician with 2 years Diploma in Electrocardiography from a Recognized Institution OR B.Sc in Cardiovascular Technology from a Recognized Institution. Must be registered in APPMB
  • Lab Technician: Must possess DMLT or B.Sc (MLT) OR Intermediate (VOC) with one year apprenticeship in Govt. Hospitals. Must be registered in APPMB. In case of candidate possess both DMLT and B.Sc MLT, the maximum percentage secured in any of the above shall be considered
  • Operation Theatre Technician: Must possess Diploma in Medical Sterilization Management & Operation Theatre Technician. Must be registered in APPMB
  • General Duty Attendant: Must have passed SSC/10th Class or its equivalent from a recognized Board
  • Store Attendant: Must have passed SSC or its equivalent
  • Lab Attendant: Must have passed SSC/10th or its equivalent. Must possess Lab Attendant Course or Intermediate (Lab Attendant Vocational Course) conducted by the Board of Inter Education, AP or from any other institution recognized by the Govt of AP
  • ECG Technician: Must have passed intermediate examination or its equivalent. Must possess Diploma in ECG Technician course from a recognized institution. Must be registered in APPMB
  • Library Assistant: Must possess Intermediate with CLISc (Certificate in Library Science) from a recognized university

Essential Requirements:

  • The candidate should possess prescribed academic/technical/professional qualifications for the post they are applying for as on the date of this notification
  • If the applicant possesses an equivalent qualification to prescribed qualification in this notification, applicant shall enclose a copy of the Government orders to that effect to the application, failing which their application will be rejected
  • For posts requiring APPMB registration, valid certificate of registration in A.P. Para Medical Board is mandatory

Age Limit (as on 01.12.2025)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 42 years
  • Age Relaxations:
    • For SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates: 05 (Five) years
    • For Ex-service Men: 03 (Three) years in addition to the length of service in armed forces
    • For differently abled persons: 10 (Ten) years
    • Maximum age limit with all relaxations put together: 52 years
  • Age Calculation Date: Age will be reckoned as on 01.12.2025 as per G.O.Ms.No.105 GA (Ser-A) dept., dated 27.09.2021

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
OC Candidates Rs.300/- (Rupees Three Hundred Only)
BC/SC/ST/EWS/Ex-Service Candidates/PWD (Other than OC) Rs.200/- (Rupees Two Hundred Only)
  • Applicant must enclose a Demand Draft towards application processing fee in favor of Principal, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram
  • If any candidate wants to apply for more than one post, he/she is required to enclose separate demand draft for each post and apply for each post separately for both Government Medical College and Government Teaching General Hospital, Rajamahendravaram

Important Dates

Event Date
Application Form Available From 26 December 2025 (10:00 AM)
Last Date for Submission of Applications 09 January 2026 (04:00 PM)
Age Calculation Date 01/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Total Marks: 100
  • Marks Distribution for Qualifying Examination: 75% will be allocated for aggregate of marks obtained in all the years in qualifying examination or any other equivalent qualification
  • Weightage for Experience: Up to 10 marks @ 1.0 mark per completed year after acquiring requisite Qualification as mentioned in the pass certificate. Weightage will be reckoned up to date of notification
  • Weightage for Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium Service: Up to 15% will be given to the candidates working on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis including COVID-19 service subject to their Satisfactory service certified by the competent authority
  • Weightage Based on Working Area:
    • 2.5 marks per Six Months in Tribal Area
    • 2.0 marks per Six Months in Rural Area
    • 1.0 marks per Six Months in Urban Areas
    • No weightage will be given for the services less than six months for Non-COVID service
  • COVID-19 Weightage: If any individual worked less than 6 months for COVID, 0.8 marks per completed month will be awarded. Applicable only to the persons who have rendered their services for COVID-19 on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis and are appointed by the District Collector or any other competent authority
  • The candidates claiming service weightage shall submit original contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium service certificate issued by competent authority along with copy of appointment orders

General Information/Instructions

  • Proforma of application will be available on the portal https://eastgodavari.ap.gov.in/ from 10:00 am on 26.12.2025 to 04:00 pm on 09.01.2026
  • Filled in applications shall be submitted in the specified counters in office of the Principal/Addl. DME, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram
  • All candidates are advised to apply as soon as possible without waiting till last date to avoid last hour rush
  • Candidates are advised to obtain dated acknowledgement from the receiving authority
  • No applications will be accepted by post or through email
  • District Jurisdiction for this recruitment is Erstwhile District Only. Candidates studied from Erstwhile East Godavari District will only be considered as local candidates based on 4th to 10th study certificates as per the Presidential order
  • Counseling will be conducted Separately for Government Medical College and Government Teaching General Hospital, Rajamahendravaram
  • Candidates have to submit separate application form for Government Medical College posts and Government Teaching General Hospital posts
  • The Final Merit Lists of this notification is valid for one Year from the date of issue of this notification
  • Reservations are applicable as per Rule 22 of AP State and Subordinate Services Rules and instructions issued from time to time including BC, SC and ST reservations
  • The tenure for the contract/outsourcing posts is initially one year from the date of joining in the post and may be extended for further period as per the instructions issued by the Government from time to time
  • The District Selection Committee reserves all the rights to terminate the contract/outsourcing services of any candidate/candidates at any time with one month notice
  • If selected, he/she should stay at the bonafide Head Quarters compulsorily
  • If selected and appointed, he/she should abide to the Government rules in force regularly from time to time
  • Candidates are advised to follow official website of the District from time to time for further information
  • Candidates should make sure of their eligibility to the post applied for and that the declaration made by them in the format of application regarding their eligibility in all aspects
  • Any candidate furnishing in-correct information or making false declaration regarding his/her eligibility at any stage or suppressing any information is liable to be debarred from recruitment conducted by the department and summarily rejection of their candidature for this recruitment & future recruitment

How to Apply

  • Download the application proforma from the official portal https://eastgodavari.ap.gov.in/ between 26.12.2025 (10:00 AM) and 09.01.2026 (04:00 PM)
  • Fill the application form completely with accurate information
  • Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates including:
    • SSC or its equivalent (for date of birth)
    • Pass certificates of qualifications prescribed for the posts concerned
    • Marks memos of all years of qualifying examination or its equivalent
    • Valid certificate of registration in A.P. Para Medical Board (wherever applicable)
    • Study Certificates from class IV to X
    • Copy of valid latest caste certificate (if applicable)
    • Latest EWS certificate (if applicable)
    • Certificate of disability issued in SADAREM (if applicable)
    • Service certificate for claiming weightage (if applicable)
    • Any other relevant certificates
  • Enclose Demand Draft towards application processing fee in favor of Principal, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram
  • Submit the filled application form with all documents and DD at the specified counters in the office of Principal/Addl. DME, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram
  • Submit separate application forms for GMC posts and GTGH posts if applying to both
  • Obtain dated acknowledgement from the receiving authority
  • Candidates must submit clear, visible self-attested documents, failing which application will be summarily rejected

  • Place of posting shall be at different construction Sites spread across the country including Bina, Dahej, Vadinar, Vishakhapatnam, Raipur, etc.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Candidate must hold a graduate degree from a University incorporated by an Act of Central/State Legislature in India or an institution declared as a University under UGC Act 1956, or an equivalent qualification recognized by Chhattisgarh Government.
  • Candidates appearing in final qualifying examination or awaiting results may apply for Preliminary Examination, but must produce proof of passing the required degree before Main Examination application/within prescribed time.
  • Candidates with recognized professional and technical qualifications deemed equivalent to a degree by the State Government are also eligible.
  • For reserved category benefits (SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer, PwD, women, ex-servicemen, etc.), candidate must be a local/native resident of Chhattisgarh and possess valid permanent caste and other relevant certificates.
  • Physical standards are prescribed for certain posts like Deputy Superintendent of Police, District Excise Officer, Assistant Jail Superintendent and others; candidates must ensure they meet these standards when opting for such posts.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • For Deputy Superintendent of Police (State Police Service): 21 to 28 years, with relaxations:
    • Up to 5 years relaxation in upper age limit for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer) of Chhattisgarh.
    • Ex-servicemen of Chhattisgarh can deduct entire defence service period from actual age, subject to resulting age not exceeding upper limit by more than 3 years.
    • Certain categories of Government servants, retrenched employees, voluntary home guards, women (including widows/divorcees) and specific award holders get relaxations as detailed, but combined upper age not beyond prescribed maximum (generally 33 years for some service categories, plus notified relaxations).
  • For other posts (except Police Service): Generally 21 to 30 years; for local/native residents of Chhattisgarh, maximum age 35 years, with additional relaxation of 5 years for educated unemployed locals, subject to a ceiling of 45 years including all relaxations.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities get 5 years relaxation in maximum age as per RPwD Act 2016 and relevant Government notifications.

Application Fee

  • For local/native residents of Chhattisgarh belonging to SC, ST, OBC (non-creamy layer) and Persons with Disabilities: Rs. 300/- as examination fee.
  • For all other categories and applicants from outside Chhattisgarh: Rs. 400/- as examination fee.
  • In addition, portal fee, GST and other payment gateway charges as applicable will be payable by all candidates.
  • Only online modes of payment are accepted; bank draft and cheque are not accepted for examination fee.
  • Local residents of Chhattisgarh who actually appear in the written examination/interview are eligible for refund of examination fee on submission of online refund request within 10 days of exam/interview; portal fee, correction charges, service tax etc. are non-refundable.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay scales are as per Chhattisgarh Government pay matrix:
    • Level-12: Basic pay Rs. 56,100/- per month for posts like Deputy Collector, Deputy Superintendent of Police, State Finance Service Officer, State Tax Assistant Commissioner, Labour Officer, Employment Officer, Assistant Director/District Women & Child Development Officer, District Registrar, Chief Municipal Officer Class ‘B’.
    • Level-9: Basic pay Rs. 38,100/- per month for posts like Chief Municipal Officer Class ‘C’, Child Development Project Officer, Subordinate Account Service Officer.
    • Level-8: Basic pay Rs. 35,400/- per month for Nayab Tehsildar.
    • Level-7: Basic pay Rs. 28,700/- per month for State Tax Inspector, Excise Sub Inspector, Deputy Registrar.
    • Level-6: Basic pay Rs. 25,300/- per month for Assistant Jail Superintendent.
  • Other allowances and benefits are admissible as per Chhattisgarh State Government rules applicable to respective services.

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Preliminary Examination (Objective Type): Two papers – General Studies (Paper I) and Aptitude Test (Paper II), each of 200 marks and 2 hours; both with multiple-choice questions and negative marking (1/3 of correct-answer marks for each wrong answer). Paper II (Aptitude) is qualifying; merit for Main Examination shortlisting is based on Paper I (General Studies) marks only; minimum qualifying marks: 33% for unreserved and 23% for reserved categories in each paper.
  • Stage 2 – Main Examination (Conventional Type): Seven descriptive papers – Language, Essay, General Studies I to V – each of 200 marks and 3 hours; total 1400 marks. All shortlisted candidates must appear in all papers; absence in any paper leads to disqualification.
  • Stage 3 – Interview/Personality Test: 100 marks; only candidates securing minimum marks in Main Examination as fixed by Commission are called, up to about three times the number of posts; final merit list is prepared based on aggregate of Main Examination (1400) and Interview (100) marks.
  • Preliminary Examination is only a screening test; marks of Prelims are not counted in final selection. Separate unreserved and reserved lists are prepared as per reservation rules, and supplementary lists up to 25% of main list may also be prepared.

How To Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only for State Services Preliminary Examination 2025; any manual or postal applications will not be accepted.
  • Online application can be submitted from 01/12/2025 (12:00 Noon) to 30/12/2025 (11:59 PM) via the link available on the official website www.psc.cg.gov.in.
  • Candidates must carefully read State Service Examination Rules 2008 (as amended), Commission’s Procedure Rules 2014 (as amended), and all instructions in the advertisement before filling the online form to ensure eligibility.
  • Examination fee and portal fee must be paid online only; bank draft or cheque will not be accepted. Candidates should preserve application and fee payment details.
  • After Prelims result, candidates declared qualified for Main Examination must submit a fresh online application for Main Examination within the prescribed dates; failure to do so will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates in Government/PSU/University/other institutional service must obtain and submit No Objection Certificate from competent authority at the time of document verification/interview as per instructions.

Important Dates

Last date for online application (Preliminary Exam) 30/12/2025, 11:59 PM
Online error correction (free) window 31/12/2025, 12:00 Noon to 02/01/2026, 11:59 PM
Online chargeable correction window (Rs. 500/-) 03/01/2026, 12:00 Noon to 05/01/2026, 11:59 PM
Preliminary Examination Date 22/02/2026 – Forenoon 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon and Afternoon 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM
Probable dates for Main Examination 16, 17, 18 and 19 May 2026

Instructions

  • Applications will be accepted only online within specified dates; manual or postal applications will be rejected.
  • Admission to the examination at all stages is purely provisional; issue of admit card does not imply final acceptance of candidature, which is verified after written examination/interview and document scrutiny.
  • Candidates are responsible for ensuring that they meet all eligibility conditions; if found ineligible at any stage or if any information is found incomplete/incorrect/false, candidature/selection can be cancelled and Commission’s decision will be final and binding.
  • Reservation and selection procedures are subject to final orders of Hon’ble Supreme Court in SLP (C) No.19668/2022 and to any modifications in rules notified by Government before last date of application.
  • Reservation benefits for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer), women, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, ex-servicemen and other special categories apply only to local/native residents of Chhattisgarh with valid certificates; candidates from other States will be treated as unreserved for such posts.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in each paper of Preliminary and Main Examinations are 33% for unreserved and 23% for reserved categories; Prelims is only qualifying/screening and marks are not counted for final merit.
  • Use of unfair means, misconduct, disobedience, abusive language, damage to answer sheets, violation of exam discipline or carrying banned items (like mobile phones) inside exam premises is punishable and may lead to debarment.
  • There is no provision for revaluation/rechecking of answer scripts; requests for re-evaluation or recounting will not be entertained.
  • No certificate/documents are required to be sent/uploaded for Preliminary Examination; all relevant documents must be produced at the time of document verification before interview for candidates qualified in Main Examination.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Under graduation (Regular – Full time) in any discipline from a University / Institution recognized by AICTE / DOTE / UGC. The candidates should have appeared for the examination, passed and received the degree certificate in any of the years from July 2021 to 2025.
  • Essential qualifications: Candidates must have passed their Graduation not earlier than 01.07.2021. Candidate with 100% complete profile on the Apprenticeship portal only are eligible to apply.
  • Experience: The candidate possesses one year or more of work experience in any Government, Government Undertaking, or Private Organization as on 01.12.2025. (Not eligible if have experience)

Salary/Stipend

  • A monthly stipend of Rs. 9,000/- shall be paid to the apprentice during the period of apprenticeship training. The Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances/ benefits.
  • United India Insurance Company will make a payment of 4,500/- into the apprentices account on a monthly basis.
  • Government share of Stipend of Rs. 4500 will be directly credited to the Apprentices Bank account through DBT mode as per extant guidelines.
  • The stipend shall be paid to Apprentices each month after adjusting Loss of pay, If any.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age—21 years
  • Maximum Age -28 years
  • [i.e. candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.12.1997 and not later than 01.12.2004 (both days inclusive)]
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates.

Important Dates

Activity Date
Online Application Starting Date 18.12.2025
Last date for applying “UNITED INDIA INSURANCE CO. LTD” 20.01.2026
Physical appearance for verification of documents of shortlisted candidates at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd Call letter will be sent through Registered Email ID

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish the details while filling in application.
  • Company reserves right to reject ineligible candidate's applications at any stage of the selection process.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

RBI Bank's Medical Consultant Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
Post Name Bank's Medical Consultant
No of Posts 01
Salary Rs. 1000/- per hour
Qualification MBBS degree from any university recognized by the Medical Council of India in the allopathic system of medicine.
Start Date for Apply  21/12/2025
Last Date for Apply  22/01/2026
Official Website https://www.rbi.org.in

RBI Bank's Medical Consultant Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Bank's Medical Consultant 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicants should at a minimum, possess MBBS degree from any university recognized by the Medical Council of India in the allopathic system of medicine.
  • Applicants having post graduate degree in General Medicine can also apply.
  • The applicants should have a minimum of two (02) years' of experience practicing medicine in any hospital or clinic.
  • The applicants should have his/her dispensary or place of residence within a radius of 10-15 kms from the dispensaries located at Bank's Office Premise/ Reserve Bank of India Officers' Colony at the aforementioned location.

Selection Process

  • The Reserve Bank of India, Guwahati will conduct an interview for selection of one Bank’s Medical Consultant (BMC) on contract basis, with fixed hourly remuneration.
  • Selection will be made through interview of eligible candidates. The Bank reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards etc. in order to limit the number of candidates to be called for interview. The decision of the Bank in this regard will be final. The Bank will not entertain any correspondence with the applicants who have not been called for the interview.
  • The shortlisted applicant/s after interview will be subjected to medical tests as per prescribed norms before engagement as Bank’s Medical Consultant (BMC). The cost of these medical tests will have to be borne by the applicant.
  • Candidate selected for the post will be appointed subject to their being found medically fit and acceptance of Terms and Conditions as per Annex-I and Code of Conduct as per Annex-II.
  • The selected candidate has to enter into an agreement with the Bank before engagement as Bank’s Medical Consultant on contract basis with fixed hourly remuneration.

How To Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates may make an application in the prescribed format as at Annex-III. The application should be sent in a sealed cover super scribed as- “Application for the Post of Bank’s Medical Consultant (BMC) on Contract Basis with Fixed Hourly Remuneration”.
  • The candidates should submit their applications to, The Regional Director, Reserve Bank of India, Human Resource Management Department (Recruitment Section), Station Road, Panbazar, Guwahati – 781001 on or before 05:00 PM of January 22, 2026.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 21/12/2025
Last Date for Apply 22/01/2026

Instructions

  • You shall attend to the Bank’s Office dispensary located at RBI Dispensary, Main Office Premises, Reserve Bank of India, Station Road, Panbazar, Guwahati, Assam - 781001 and at Reserve Bank of India Officer’s Colony, G.S. Road, Christian Basti, Guwahati – 781005 with duty hours from as mentioned in Para 2(viii) of the advertisement (or for longer periods as may be necessary) excluding Bank holidays except days declared as holidays for purposes of half yearly closing and annual closing subject to the condition that the dispensary will not be kept closed for two successive days.
  • You will give medical advice free of charge, prescribe medicines and administer injections free of charge to the members of the staff including touring staff of the Bank, the members of their families including dependent parents and retired employee members / their spouses who are members of the Medical Assistance Fund Scheme, who present themselves during that time (the timings and / or duration may be changed as and when considered necessary by the Bank). You will be available for consultation at your private clinic in urgent cases in respect of employees of the Bank at any time with charges at the rate prescribed in the schedule. The Schedule of charges applicable to the Staff/Officers of the Bank would be made available on request.
  • You will provide the facilities referred to in paragraph (2) above to the relatives of the employees who have been permitted to reside with them in the Staff Quarters/leased flats and facilitate recovery of charges from the employees for credit to the Bank’s account at the rates prescribed by the Bank from time to time.
  • You will be required to perform duties similar to those of a General Medical Practitioner irrespective of whatever post-graduate or other medical qualifications you may possess / acquire in future. It shall be your responsibility to ensure that the qualifications you hold or acquire in future do not restrict you in any manner from rendering the services required of a General Medical Practitioner and if as per any stipulations by the Indian Medical Association, the qualification you hold or acquire as the case may be, comes into conflict with the Bank`s requirements as indicated above, to work as a general practitioner, you will be required to ensure that no liability or responsibility on this account devolves on the Bank under any circumstance and shall indemnify and keep indemnified the Bank at all times against the same.

Salary/Stipend

  • ₹ 1000/- per hour for the entire period of contract i.e., three years.
  • Out of the total monthly remuneration so payable, a sum of ₹1000/- per month shall be treated as conveyance expenses.
  • Reimbursement of mobile charges of ₹1,000/- per month.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: Candidate must be a citizen of India
  • Educational Qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university or any equivalent qualifications recognized by central government
  • Essential Qualification: The candidate should have passed graduation degree between 01.04.2021 and 01.12.2025
  • Experience: Candidate who had training or job experience for a period of one year or more after completing educational qualifications shall not be eligible for being engaged as Apprentice
  • Registration: Candidate need to register on apprenticeship portal of National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) at https://nats.education.gov.in
  • Prior Apprenticeship: The candidate should not have undergone apprenticeship either with Bank of India or in any other organization earlier
  • Physical Fitness: Engagement is subject to being declared medically fit as per requirement of the Bank and producing medical fitness certificate from a practicing registered general physician (minimum MBBS)

Salary/Stipend

  • Total Stipend Per Month: Rs.13,000/- (Rupees Thirteen Thousand only)
  • Bank's Contribution: Rs.8,500/- per month
  • Government of India's Stipendiary Support: Rs.4,500/- per month
  • Payment Mode: Stipend will be credited in the Saving Bank Account of apprentices each month after adjusting unauthorised leaves
  • Government Share: Rs.4,500/- will be directly credited to the apprentices DBT enabled Bank Account registered with NATS Portals through Direct Beneficiary Transfer (DBT) mode
  • Other Allowances: The apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits

Age Limit (as on 01.12.2025)

  • Minimum Age: 20 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years
  • Date of Birth: The candidate must have been born not earlier than 02.12.1997 and not later than 01.12.2005 (both days inclusive)
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-creamy layer): 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for Persons With Benchmark Disabilities: 10 years
  • Note: The maximum age limit of 28 years is applicable to General Category and EWS candidates

Application Fee

Category Application/Examination/Intimation Fees
PwBD candidates Rs.400/- + GST
Schedule Caste / Schedule Tribe / All Women candidates Rs.600/- + GST
All Other Candidates Rs.800/- + GST
  • Payment Mode: Online payment only
  • Bank Transaction Charges: To be borne by the candidate
  • Refund Policy: Application fee is non-refundable
  • Note: Application fee to be remitted only on demand by BFSI SSC (scrutinizing/examining body) deputed by the Bank

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 01.12.2025
Relevant date for Age and Qualification 01.12.2025
Submission of online application commencing from 25.12.2025
Last date for submission of online application 10.01.2026
Tentative Date of Online Examination Will be advised separately

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Online Written Test: The test will consist of 100 questions for 100 marks with total duration of 90 minutes
  • Test Components:
    • General / Financial Awareness: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • English Language: 25 questions, 25 marks (Qualifying nature only)
    • Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • Computer Knowledge: 25 questions, 25 marks
  • Language: All tests except English Language will be available bilingually (English and Hindi)
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum qualifying marks will be decided by Bank. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates entitled to 5% relaxation
  • Stage 2 - Test of Local Language: Conducted after qualifying the online written examination. Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the local language of the state
  • Exemption from Language Test: Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language
  • Final Merit List: Drawn state wise and category wise based on marks obtained in online examination in descending order
  • Tie Breaker: If marks are equal, merit order will be on the basis of Date of Birth (senior by age placed higher)
  • Document Verification: Candidates must produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Medical Fitness: Candidate must be declared medically fit as per Bank requirements

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for engagement in only one state and choose only one zone under that state
  • The number of training seats mentioned is provisional and may vary according to actual requirements of the Bank
  • Bank has right to post apprentices in any Branch/Offices within the state as per operational requirements
  • This is neither an employment nor a contract employment in the Bank. Engaged apprentices will only be "Trainees" and not treated as employees/workers
  • Period of engagement shall be restricted to One Year Apprenticeship Training Programme
  • Apprenticeship period shall not give the apprentice any lien/right on permanent employment with the Bank
  • No Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice and there is no reservation for them
  • Apprentices are prohibited from joining/forming any Union Body
  • Bank may issue certificate to candidate upon successful completion of Apprenticeship
  • Successful Apprentice will be issued a proficiency certificate by Board of Apprentice Training (BOAT)
  • Bank has the rights to cancel the engagement of apprenticeship at any point of time without prior notice in case of any misconduct
  • No change of category as well as any other details will be permitted at any stage after registration on the apprenticeship portal
  • Multiple applications will result in only the latest valid application being retained
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Any resulting dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Mumbai

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at https://nats.education.gov.in by navigating to "Student Register/Login" section
  • Step 2: After registration, login to the NATS portal using user ID and password at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php
  • Step 3: Apply for Apprenticeship against the advertisement published by "Bank of India" by going to the section "Apply against advertised vacancies"
  • Step 4: Eligible candidates will receive an email from [email protected] within 48 hours of applying on NATS portal
  • Step 5: Fill the final "Application cum Examination Fee Form" by providing personal data, choice of zone, category, PWBD status
  • Step 6: Make online payment of the requisite examination fee
  • Step 7: Note down the Enrolment ID issued by NATS portal for future reference
  • Step 8: After successful payment, you will receive an email from [email protected] with copy of "Application cum Examination Fee Form" within 48 hours
  • Application Period: 25.12.2025 to 10.01.2026
  • Mode of Application: Online only through NATS Portal
  • Important: Application process is complete only when examination fee is deposited with BFSI SSC
  • For Help: Refer to the help manual available at https://nats.education.gov.in/assets/manual/student_manual.pdf or email queries to [email protected]

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications:

  • Discipline Code 107 - Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 108 - Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 109 - Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 110 - Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 111 - Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 101 - Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 102 - Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 103 - Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 104 - Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 105 - Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 106 - Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 112 - Graduate Apprentice: Regular full time Graduate in any discipline (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 113 - Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/Board
  • Discipline Code 114 - Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Skilled Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/Board. Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government

Essential Conditions:

  • The qualification prescribed shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course in relevant disciplines
  • Qualification acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning mode shall render the candidate NOT ELIGIBLE
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, only those applicants who have acquired the prescribed qualification between 01.04.2022 and 31.12.2025 shall be considered eligible
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator) only those applicants who have acquired the prescribed qualification between 01.04.2021 and 31.12.2025 shall be considered eligible
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA or equivalent or MCA/CA/ICWA, LLB or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining the apprenticeship training shall NOT BE ELIGIBLE
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute
  • Candidates possessing Diploma in Engineering in relevant trade/discipline under a recognized lateral entry scheme shall also be considered eligible subject to meeting prescribed percentage of marks

Previous Apprenticeship Training Conditions:

  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training, and the second training shall not be in the same trade
  • There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed
  • No gap shall be required in the case of termination of previous apprenticeship training due to failure on the part of the employer
  • Where an apprentice has terminated a previous apprenticeship contract due to health or financial hardship or relocation, transportation or career changes or language barrier, the waiting period of three month shall apply before the apprentice shall enter into another contract of apprenticeship with the same employer or any other employer and there shall be no waiting period for women

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time
  • The exact stipend amount will be communicated at the time of engagement
  • Stipend will be paid on monthly basis during the apprenticeship training period

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years (maximum age up to 29 years)
  • Age Relaxation for OBC-NCL: 3 years (maximum age up to 27 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: 10 years (maximum age up to 34 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years (maximum age up to 39 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC-NCL): 13 years (maximum age up to 37 years)
  • Date of Reckoning: 31.12.2025

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the notification
  • The application process is completely online and free of cost

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 10/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 10/12/2025 (10:00 AM onwards)
Last Date for Registration in NAPS/NATS Portal 09/01/2026 (5:00 PM)
Last Date for Microsoft Form Submission 09/01/2026
Date of Reckoning (Age & Qualification) 31/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for selection process
  • No Written Test/Interview: There will be no written test or interview for the selection
  • Merit-Based Selection: Merit list of all the candidates who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the post
  • The shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification
  • Candidates will have to complete Pre-engagement medical fitness test for being adjudged suitable for engagement
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format
  • Shortlisted candidates whose documents including Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting process shall be considered for filling by eligible and qualifying candidates from the panel cum merit list from the same opportunity

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates are advised to register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the NAPS/NATS portals under the respective State as per their Trades
  • Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator) must register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
  • Technician Apprentice (Diploma) must register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Graduate Apprentice must register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Candidates need to LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings with the Establishment ID: NATS - EWBKOC000077, NAPS - E05201900011
  • Candidates MUST ensure their profile (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in application
  • Candidates have to apply for ANY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one discipline Code will not be considered
  • The candidature of the applicant would be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to his/her being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation
  • The decision of the Management will be final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the applications
  • Applications which are incomplete or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected"
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such apprentices
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and Mobile number which must be valid for at least 1 year as all future communications will take place through email alerts
  • Candidates must have PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, and Bank Account linked with Aadhar
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence shall be shared only on the website
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL-Non-Creamy Layer) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to their fulfilling the standards applicable to General category
  • Reservation for PwBD shall be applied on horizontal basis, across all categories, as per Government guidelines
  • PwBD are not eligible to apply for Discipline Code 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111

Samagra Shiksha Axom Procurement Specialist Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name No. of Posts Monthly Fixed Remuneration
Procurement Specialist (World Bank supported Project “Support School Education in Assam” PMU) 01 Rs. 1,20,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/-

Eligibility Criteria

  • Engineering or Commerce graduate with MBA or Master’s Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (minimum two years duration) in any discipline from any Government recognized university/institution.
  • Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in project procurement and contract management.
  • Experience of procurement rules of the World Bank/Externally Aided Projects (EAP).
  • Proven experience in preparing procurement plans, bid documents, evaluation reports and contracts as per Bank Standard Bidding Documents (SBD) and managing procurement processes.
  • Thorough knowledge of procurement through Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and Assamtenders and ability to upload bids on these platforms.
  • Thorough knowledge of General Financial Rules (GFR), Assam Public Procurement Act 2017, Assam Public Procurement Rules 2020, Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) guidelines and GeM procedures.
  • Age between 18 and 45 years as on 01-01-2025, calculated based on Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by recognized Board/Council.

Salary/Stipend

  • The Procurement Specialist will receive a monthly fixed remuneration in the range of Rs. 1,20,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/-.
  • Remuneration will be paid under the PMU fund of the World Bank supported Project “Support School Education in Assam” and is strictly project-based.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • The candidate should not be less than 18 years of age and not more than 45 years of age as on 01-01-2025.
  • The age limit will be calculated on the basis of the Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by a recognized Board/Council; no other document will be accepted for age calculation.

Application Fee

  • The advertisement does not mention any application fee for the Procurement Specialist post under the World Bank supported project.

Selection Process

  • Only eligible candidates will be called for test/interview; the exact date and time will be communicated separately.
  • Marking pattern will cover General Awareness, Personality & Aptitude, subject matter in relevant field, and relevant experience for the post.
  • The applicant must secure minimum 50% of the total marks in the interview to be shortlisted.
  • Decision of the Selection Committee in all aspects including acceptance/rejection of applications, conduct of test and final selection will be final and binding.

General Information/Instructions

  • A Project Management Unit (PMU) is being set up in Assam for implementation of the World Bank supported project “Support School Education in Assam” for a period of 5 years, and engagements are purely temporary.
  • The posts are temporary, with initial engagement for 11 months only; contractual engagement will not be regularised under any job/programme of Government of Assam or Samagra Shiksha Axom in future and no right to permanent absorption is created.
  • The link for the recruitment portal will be available on Samagra Shiksha website https://ssa.assam.gov.in and candidates must carefully read the User Guidelines before filling the online application.
  • Claims for correction will not be entertained after submitting online registration and application; the office will not be responsible for non-submission due to errors or other problems.
  • Candidates must be in good mental and bodily health and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with efficient discharge of duties.
  • The authority reserves the right to cancel the advertisement at any time without assigning any reason or in case of non-receipt of suitable candidates.

How to Apply

  • Eligible Indian citizens must apply online through the recruitment portal link available on the Samagra Shiksha website https://ssa.assam.gov.in.
  • Candidates must read the User Guidelines on the recruitment portal carefully before filling the online registration and application form.
  • Applicants must upload supporting documents of educational qualification, experience and other relevant certificates through the portal.
  • Only online applications submitted between 17.12.2025 and 31.12.2025 will be accepted; no offline applications are mentioned.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed separately about the exact date and time of test/interview through appropriate communication channels.
