Selection Process

There will be 125 objective type questions carrying one mark each for a duration of 2.5 Hours. There will be no negative marking system applicable and therefore, no marks will be deducted in case of an incorrect answer. Candidates belonging to PwBD Category are eligible for an compensatory time of 50 minutes.

A minimum of 50% marks for UR/ EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts) in written test will be required to enable the candidate to be considered for further consideration.

Based on the result of the written test and no. of vacancies, the documents submitted by candidates will be scrutinized by RITES Limited and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview preceded by verification of original documents. It will be the candidates’ responsibility to upload supporting documents substantiating the claims submitted in the application form.

In case of deficiency in documents scrutinized by RITES in establishing the claim made in the application, the same shall be notified on the website along with the list of candidates to be called for the interview preceded by document verification. The candidates called for the interview shall bring all the required documents in original, including the original copies of such documents which fulfill the deficiency notified (as applicable). It shall be the responsibility of the candidate to produce all the documents establishing their eligibility and claim made in the application, and inability to produce the documents fulfilling the deficiency at the time of document verification before the interview will render their candidature ineligible.

The documents fulfilling the deficiency must be submitted at the time of document verification and the same must be issued in relation to the deficiency notified, with the purpose of substantiating the claim made in the application by such candidate; however, the date on the same shall not be later than the of date of document verification (submission of documents with regard to category status including OBC-NCL and EWS will continue to be governed as per the ‘Relaxation & Concessions’ section of this advertisement, to be read along with clause 8 under ‘How to Apply’ section of this advertisement).

Candidates will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies.

  • Departmental candidates of RITES and Candidates working in any organization shall be allowed to join RITES only after being properly relieved from their parent organization.
  • Before applying, the Candidates must satisfy themselves about their eligibility for the post applied for.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact (s), his/her candidature is liable for cancellation. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after appointment, his/her services are liable to be terminated.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum to this advertisement will be displayed only on the Company’s website www.rites.com. Therefore, applicants are advised to keep checking the Company’s website for any update.
  • Offer letter is not considered as proof of experience and candidate has to submit joining & relieving order / experience certificate for claiming the experience.
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Delhi in case of any dispute 9. No fares / TA / DA shall be payable.

  • Computer Programmer: Rs. 25,000/- per month.

NABARD Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Discipline/Post Name Total Vacancies Location
Climate Action & Sustainability 3 Mumbai (1), Lucknow (1), Shimla (1)
Economics 3 Mumbai (2), Ranchi (1)
Data Science 4 Mumbai (3), Dehradun (1)
Cyber Security 1 Mumbai (1)
Academic Administration 2 Lucknow (1), Mangaluru (1)
Graphic Designing 1 Lucknow (1)

Information Technology 12 Mumbai (9), Guwahati (1), Aizawl (1), Kolkata (1)
Geoinformatics 1 Shimla (1)
Development Management 3 Lucknow (1), New Delhi (2)
Project Monitoring 4 Mumbai (1), Chennai (2), Chandigarh (1)
Finance 6 Mumbai (6)
UI/UX Designing 1 Mumbai (1)
Software Testing 1 Mumbai (1)
Total 44

Note: A candidate shall be permitted to apply only for one discipline/location. Multiple applications under the same/different disciplines shall lead to cancellation of candidature.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science/Climate Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Economics: Post Graduate Degree in Economics/Applied Economics/Financial Economics/Statistics/Data Science/Finance/Public Policy with minimum 55% marks
  • Data Science: B.E./B.Tech in Information Technology/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication/Artificial Intelligence & Data Science with minimum 60% marks
  • Cyber Security: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Electronics and Communications Engineering with minimum 60% marks OR Postgraduate degree with minimum 55% marks
  • Academic Administration: Bachelor's degree in Education/Business Administration/Computer Science/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Master's degree in Education (M.Ed.)/Educational Management/HRD/MBA (HR)/PGDM-HR with minimum 55% marks
  • Graphic Designing: Bachelor's degree in Digital Media/Multimedia/Graphic Design with minimum 60% marks
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Post graduate degree in Mass Media/Development Communication/Visual Communication/Journalism with minimum 55% marks
  • Information Technology: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Computer Applications/Information Technology with minimum 55% marks
  • Geoinformatics: Post graduate degree in Geoinformatics/Geography/Remote Sensing/Environmental Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Development Management: Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate degree in Social Work/Rural Development/Rural Management/Development Studies/Development Management/Development Administration/Project Management/Business Management with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Project Monitoring: Bachelor's Degree or Post Graduate Degree in Agriculture/Soil Science/Agronomy/Horticulture/Land/Water resources with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Finance: BBA (Finance/Banking)/BMS (Finance/Banking) with 60% marks OR Two years full time PGDM (Finance)/Full time MBA (Finance)/MMS (Finance) with minimum 55% marks OR Bachelor of Financial and Investment Analysis with 60% marks OR Bachelor's degree with Membership of ICAI obtained on or before 01-11-2025
  • UI/UX Designing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Software Testing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation

Essential Qualifications

  • Required educational qualification must be possessed as on 01-11-2025
  • Result of final term/semester/year examination must have been declared on or before 01-11-2025
  • Candidates whose final year/semester results declared after 01-11-2025 are not eligible
  • All degrees must be from recognized University/Institution
  • Minimum percentage as specified for each discipline is mandatory

Desirable

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Certifications in climate change management, sustainable development, or environmental policy
  • Economics: Working knowledge of Visualisation tools (Tableau & Power BI), advanced quantitative and econometrics skills, knowledge of Stata/R, Excel
  • Academic Administration: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in learning and development, Certification in Instructional Design, LMS, ICT in Education
  • Graphic Designing: Certifications in E-Learning tools, Adobe Certified Professional, UX Design, LMS, Articulate or Captivate certifications, SCORM/xAPI training
  • Information Technology: Proficiency in Programming languages (Python, Java), knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, familiarity with web hosting, APIs, wireframing tools like Figma
  • Geoinformatics: Certification in GIS tools like QGIS or ArcGIS
  • UI/UX Designing: Relevant certification in UI/UX design/development

Experience (Mandatory)

  • All Disciplines: Prior relevant experience of minimum 1 year in reputed organizations
  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Minimum 1 year in climate change mitigation, adaptation, or sustainability
  • Economics: Minimum 1 year in forecasting, financial modeling, preparation of impact balance sheets, exposure to domestic and international databases
  • Data Science: Minimum 1 year, preference for projects involving banking technologies
  • Cyber Security: Minimum 1 year in Information and Cyber security domain (preferably having worked in SOC)
  • Academic Administration: Minimum 1 year in training, instructional design, learning experience design & learning and development
  • Graphic Designing: Minimum 1 year in Graphic design, animation, e-learning tools, LMS, Adobe Creative Suite
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Minimum 1 year in developmental filmmaking/social work outreach
  • Information Technology: Minimum 1 year with experience in creating BRD or FSD, analyzing processes and designing workflows
  • UI/UX Designing: Minimum 1 year as UI/UX designer and developer
  • Software Testing: Minimum 1 year in reputed organization

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹70,000/- (All Inclusive)
  • Income tax or any other tax liable will be deducted at source as per applicable rules before effecting payment
  • The stipend is paid during the entire engagement period including training
  • Young Professionals engaged on purely contractual basis

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Candidate must be an Indian citizen
  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 01-11-1995 and not later than 01-11-2004
  • No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Application Fee

  • Application Fee cum Intimation Charges: ₹150/- (exclusive of applicable GST)
  • Application Fee is Non-Refundable
  • Application Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances
  • Bank Transaction charges for Online Payment will have to be borne by the candidate
  • Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 26th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 26th December 2025
Last Date for Online Application 12th January 2026
Payment of Application Fee/Intimation Charges 26th December 2025 to 12th January 2026
Qualification & Experience Date As on 01-11-2025
Age Calculation Date As on 01-11-2025

Note: NABARD reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Application Screening
    • Applications received from interested eligible candidates shall be placed before the Screening Committee
    • Screening for interview based on matrix of identified indicators like academic performance, relevance of work experience, overall profile, statement of intent
  • Step 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted applications shall be placed before Young Professional Selection Committee (YPSC)
    • Final selection based on combined marks in Presentation and Interview conducted by YPSC
    • Interview will be conducted at respective NABARD Regional Offices of the States against which vacancies have been announced
  • Medical Fitness: Final appointment subject to being declared medically fit by Medical Officer(s) appointed/approved by the Bank
  • Document Verification: NABARD shall verify eligibility at stage of interview/joining
  • Final Decision: Final appointment based on decision of Selection Committee constituted for the purpose
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria shall not vest any right to candidate for being called for interviews
  • Decision of NABARD shall be final in all matters
  • Travel for Interview: Candidates may be reimbursed to and fro 2AC rail fare for shortest route for attending interviews

General Information/Instructions

Program Duration

  • Duration of engagement is 1 (one) year, extendable upto maximum three years
  • Extension depends on performance of Young Professional and organizational requirements

Legal Status

  • Young Professionals selected on short-term contract basis
  • Shall not be considered as "staff member" or "official" of NABARD
  • Engagement shall not establish relationship of employee and employer between NABARD and Young Professional
  • No right/claim for placement in NABARD by virtue of engagement under Young Professional Program
  • Appointed on full-time basis and shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement period

Leave Facility

  • Young Professionals entitled to maximum 30 days leave in a calendar year during engagement period
  • Leave provided on proportionate basis

Medical Facility

  • Medical facility available for self only at NABARD Dispensary

Office Facilities

  • Lounge facility, Tea/Coffee provided as per entitlement of officers of the bank
  • NABARD will provide Office Space, Internet Connectivity, and other support facilities

Conduct, Discipline and Confidentiality

  • Services governed by code of conduct as prescribed by NABARD
  • Internal data must be kept confidential
  • NABARD entitled to all intellectual property rights including patent, copyright, trademark developed during engagement
  • Must furnish undertaking for maintenance of secrecy before commencement
  • Subject to provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
  • Shall not use name, letterhead, emblem or official seal of NABARD without prior permission

Termination

  • NABARD can terminate contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
  • In normal course, NABARD may terminate engagement by giving one month's notice in advance
  • Young Professional can also seek termination by giving one month's notice
  • If notice period not served, Young Professional required to pay sum equivalent to one month's pay
  • Unauthorized absence of more than 8 days (not including public holidays and weekends) without valid explanation can lead to termination

Travel and Official Benefits

  • For official domestic travel, eligible for halting, boarding and incidental allowances same as Grade A officer of NABARD
  • In event of death, injury or illness during engagement, neither Young Professional nor dependents entitled to any compensation or employment
  • Young Professionals solely responsible for maintaining adequate insurance (life, health) at own expense

Mentorship and Review

  • Each Young Professional attached to mentor/supervising officer who acts as Project Guide
  • Mentor responsible for regularly overseeing progress
  • Assessment done jointly by Officer in Charge of Department/RO/TE and supervising officer
  • Letter of Experience/Recommendation given at end of engagement period

Application Guidelines

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens
  • Candidates should check eligibility carefully before applying
  • Applications accepted through ONLINE mode only on www.nabard.org
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Should not suppress any material information
  • If found guilty of misconduct/unfair means, liable to disqualification/debarment/termination
  • Bank reserves right to increase/decrease/modify/cancel any provisions of vacancy/recruitment process
  • No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible and non-selected candidates
  • Bank's decision shall be final and binding on all matters

For Government/PSU Employees

  • Applicants serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Nationalized Banks required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from employer at time of interview
  • Before appointment, proper relieving letter indicating date of relief and no dues pending must be produced

Legal Jurisdiction

  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai
  • Courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only shall have sole & exclusive jurisdiction

Communication

  • Notice/communication displayed on Bank's website or sent by Registered/Speed Post or email shall be deemed sufficient
  • Check www.nabard.org regularly for updates
  • Any corrigendum or announcements published only on Bank's website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit NABARD website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Under Career Notices, click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • Step 3: Choose "Click here for New Registration" tab
  • Step 4: Enter Name, Contact details and Email-id
  • Step 5: System will generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Step 6: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (will also be sent via Email & SMS)
  • Step 7: Before starting, prepare scanned documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 200x230 pixels
    • Signature (with black ink) - 10kb-20kb, jpg format, 140x60 pixels
    • Left thumb impression (on white paper with black/blue ink) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 240x240 pixels
    • Hand written declaration (on white paper with black ink) - 50kb-100kb, jpg format, 800x400 pixels
    • Latest CV/Resume in PDF format - 500KB
  • Step 8: Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Step 9: Use "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to save data and continue later if needed
  • Step 10: Carefully fill and verify all details in online application
  • Step 11: Upload Photo & Signature as per specifications
  • Step 12: Fill other details of Application Form
  • Step 13: Click on Preview Tab to verify entire application
  • Step 14: Modify details if required
  • Step 15: Click 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' only after verifying all details are correct
  • Step 16: Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment
  • Step 17: Pay application fee of ₹150/- (plus GST) using Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets
  • Step 18: Wait for intimation from server after payment - DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH
  • Step 19: On successful payment, e-Receipt will be generated
  • Step 20: Click 'Submit' button to complete application
  • Step 21: Take printout of e-Receipt and online Application Form for future reference

Important Points for Online Application

  • Apply only for ONE discipline/location - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A1. The last date to apply online and pay the application fee is 09-01-2026 (23:55 Hrs).

Q2. What is the age limit for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A2. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 26 years for General/EWS candidates as on 31-12-2025, with relaxations up to 29 years (OBC-NCL), 31 years (SC/ST), and higher for PwBD/Ex-Servicemen as per rules.

Q4. What is the selection process for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A4. Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT); final merit is prepared refinery-wise based solely on CBT marks among candidates who qualify SPPT and fulfil all eligibility conditions.

Q5. What is the application fee for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A5. General/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates must pay Rs. 300/- as non-refundable application fee, while SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from fee payment.

Q6. Is there any negative marking in the IOCL Non-Executive CBT?
A6. No, there is no negative marking in the Computer Based Test; all 100 questions are objective type with 1 mark each.

A7. No, once the final online application is submitted and registration is completed, no change or correction is permitted; candidates must verify details carefully before final submission.

A9. No, the IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025 notification does not prescribe GATE or any external score; selection is based on IOCL’s own CBT followed by SPPT and medical fitness.

ST(H) 5% 5%
Women (within each category) 30% 10%
Militancy-affected Areas 5% 5%
Former Member of Militant Organization (FMMOs) 5% 5%
Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers 1% 1%
Special Police Officers (SPOs) 1% 1%
Sports Person/NCC Certificate Holder 1% 1%

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Constable (UB): Higher Secondary (HS) or Class XII passed from Government recognized Board or Council
  • Constable (AB): HSLC or Class X passed from Government recognized Board or Council
  • Applicants having educational qualification of Higher Secondary and above may apply for both Armed Branch and Unarmed Branch with clear preference indication

Essential Requirements

  • Applicant must be a Citizen of India and Permanent Resident of Assam
  • Must be registered with a local Employment Exchange in Assam
  • Must speak Assamese or any other State language fluently
  • Selected applicants will have to submit Proof of Residence after publication of Final Select List (SC, ST, OBC/MOBC exempted)

Experience

  • For Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers: Minimum 1 year service certificate required for reservation quota benefit; Minimum 3 years service for age relaxation
  • For SPOs: Appointment Certificate required for reservation and age relaxation benefits
  • For FMMOs: Certificate issued by Special Branch, HQrs. of Assam Police, Kahilipara, Guwahati required

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 14,000 - 70,000/- per month
  • Grade Pay: Rs. 5,600/-
  • Other Benefits: Allowances as admissible under the Rules
  • Pension Benefits: Selected applicants shall be entitled to pension benefits as per the pension scheme existing at the time of appointment

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (Applicants born not later than 01-01-2008)
  • Maximum Age: 25 years (Applicants born not before 01-01-2001)

Age Relaxation

  • SC, ST(P) and ST(H): 5 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • OBC/MOBC: 3 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers (served 3 years or more): Additional 3 years relaxation
  • Former Members of Militant Organization (FMMOs)/SPOs: Additional 10 years relaxation
  • Age will be calculated based on Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Certificate issued by recognized Board/Council only
  • No other documents like Horoscope, Affidavit, Birth Extract etc. will be accepted for age proof

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: NIL - There will be no Application Fee for this recruitment

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 05-12-2025
Online Application Start Date 16-12-2025
Online Application Last Date 16-01-2026
Edit Option Available (After Last Date) 5 days from 16-01-2026 (Only once, subject to SLPRB approval)
Last Date for Document Submission 16-01-2026 (All documents must be issued on or before this date)
Age Calculation Date As on 01-01-2026
PET & PST Date Will be notified later on official website
Written Test Date Will be notified later on official website
Viva-Voce Date Will be notified later on official website

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - 40 marks for Constable (UB) Male & Female, 40 marks for Constable (AB) Female, 60 marks for Constable (AB) Male
  • Stage 2: Medical Examination - Applicants will be examined by Medical & Health Officer for mental and bodily health parameters
  • Stage 3: Physical Standard Test (PST) - Height and Chest measurement (No marks, qualifying in nature)
  • Stage 4: Written Test - 50 marks (100 MCQ questions, 0.5 marks each, no negative marking)
  • Stage 5: Oral/Viva-Voce - 5 marks
  • Academic Weightage: 5 marks (Only for Constable UB based on HS percentage)
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at entry, exit and during all stages of recruitment
  • Shortlisting for Written Test: 5 times the number of posts based on PET merit
  • Shortlisting for Viva-Voce: 2 times the number of vacancies based on PET + Written Test merit

Total Marks Distribution

  • Constable (UB) Male & Female: PET (40) + Written (50) + Viva (5) + Academic (5) = 100 marks
  • Constable (AB) Male: PET (60) + Written (50) + Viva (5) = 115 marks
  • Constable (AB) Female: PET (40) + Written (50) + Viva (5) = 95 marks

Physical Standards

Category Male Height Female Height Male Chest (Normal) Male Chest (Expansion)
General/OBC/MOBC/SC/ST(P) 162.5 cm 154 cm Min. 80 cm +5 cm
ST(H) 160 cm 152 cm Min. 78 cm +5 cm

Medical Standards

  • Applicants must be in good mental and bodily health
  • Must be free from physical deformities and diseases like diabetes, heart disease, hernia, piles, respiratory diseases, knock-knee, flat foot
  • Should not be colour blind or squint eyed
  • Eye Sight: Distance vision should be 6/6 for at least one eye and not poorer than 6/9 for the other without correction; Near vision should be normal
  • Varicose vein shall be considered as temporary disqualification

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must register in the application portal only once for all advertisements using single Application ID
  • Multiple Application IDs using different mobile numbers will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Name must be entered exactly as per HSLC Certificate
  • Valid mobile number and email address must be provided and kept active throughout recruitment process
  • Documents required: Latest passport photo (max 450 KB), Signature (max 100 KB in black/blue ink), Age proof, Mark sheets, Employment Exchange Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • All documents uploaded must be issued on or before 16-01-2026
  • Caste Certificate must be from Competent Authority authorized by Govt. of Assam only
  • Admit Card and Identity Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving License) mandatory for PET & PST
  • CCTV surveillance and RFID chips will be used for Race events
  • Individual statement of marks signed by applicant and conducting officer will be provided
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for journey and stay during any stage of recruitment
  • The number of posts may increase or decrease at any time due to administrative reasons
  • Final appointment subject to satisfactory Police Verification and Medical Examination Report
  • Selected candidates must undergo basic police training and serve minimum 3 years after posting
  • Selected applicants will be required to work in any District or Unit anywhere in Assam
  • No payment required at any stage except medical investigations in Government Hospital if required
  • Anonymous complaints will not be entertained
  • Incomplete, defective or invalid applications will be summarily rejected
  • Candidature will be rejected for providing wrong information, fake documents, misrepresentation or impersonation at any stage

Written Test Details

  • 100 Multiple Choice Questions on OMR sheet
  • Each correct answer carries 0.5 marks (Total 50 marks)
  • No negative marking
  • Question level: Class IX and X standard
  • Subjects: Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical Reasoning/Mental Ability, Assam's History/Geography/Polity/Economy, General Awareness/GK and Current Affairs
  • Languages Available: Assamese, Bodo, Bengali, English

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the SLPRB portal at www.slprbassam.in with valid mobile number (Register only once for all advertisements)
  • Step 2: Provide accurate information including Employment Exchange Number, Highest Qualification, Permanent District, Gender, Caste/Category, Date of Birth, and Aadhaar Number
  • Step 3: After successful registration, an Application ID will be generated - keep it safe for future reference
  • Step 4: Login using Application ID or Registered Mobile Number along with Date of Birth
  • Step 5: Apply for the relevant Advertisement (SLPRB/REC/CONST (AB & UB)/727/2025/94)
  • Step 6: Upload mandatory documents - Photograph (450 KB max), Signature (100 KB max), Age Proof, HSLC/HS Mark sheets and Certificates, Employment Exchange Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • Step 7: Upload additional documents if claiming reservation/quota benefits (Home Guard/VDP/SPO/FMMO/Sports/NCC certificates)
  • Step 8: Select post preferences clearly (UB/AB if applying for both)
  • Step 9: Fill in all personal and academic details carefully
  • Step 10: Generate OTP and download the Acknowledgement Slip
  • Step 11: Keep Acknowledgement Slip and Application ID safe for future reference
  • Edit option available for 5 days after last date (only once, subject to SLPRB approval) for inadvertent entry corrections
  • Bring all original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies on the day of PET & PST for verification
  • Detailed instructions available on SLPRB website at time of application submission

  • To be posted at at CoEES, Oil India Limited, Guwahati, Assam.

The selection process for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025 is based on a combination of written test and personal interview. Candidates must qualify the written test with minimum prescribed marks to be shortlisted for the interview stage.

Non-Executive Recruitment 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025 invites bright, young and energetic Indian nationals seeking a career in refinery and petrochemical operations, utilities, maintenance, quality control, and fire & safety functions. The selection process of Indian Oil Corporation Limited includes a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT), where SPPT is of qualifying nature and final merit is prepared refinery-wise based on CBT scores only among candidates who qualify SPPT. Candidates who get selected will be appointed in the Non-Executive cadre in the pay scale of Rs. 25,000–1,05,000/- after having been found medically fit as per IOCL’s pre-employment medical standards.

This recruitment offers excellent career growth opportunities, competitive salary, and strong job security in India’s leading Maharatna PSU in the energy sector. The selected candidates will be posted across IOCL refineries at Guwahati (Assam), Barauni (Bihar), Gujarat (Vadodara), Haldia (West Bengal), Mathura (Uttar Pradesh), Panipat (Haryana), Digboi (Assam), Bongaigaon (Assam) and Paradip (Odisha) and will be responsible for safe and efficient operation, maintenance, quality assurance, and fire & safety of refinery units. Work arrangements may involve one, two or three shifts including continuous operations based on work exigencies.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website www.iocl.com from 20-12-2025 to 09-01-2026 by completing both registration and application steps, including payment of fee where applicable. The application fee for General/EWS/OBC (NCL) candidates is Rs. 300/-, while SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

  • Mode of Examination: Computer Based Test (CBT) or Written Screening Test (OMR) as decided by the Aayog.
  • Total Marks: 120 Marks
  • Duration: 1½ hours (one and a half hours)
  • Type of Questions: Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
  • Number of Questions: 120 Questions (Each question carries 1 mark)

Syllabus Distribution:

  • Subjects/Fields (85 Questions): Questions up to the level of prescribed essential qualification (10+2 level)
  • General Section (35 Questions):
    • General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh
    • Current Affairs
    • Everyday Science
    • Logical Reasoning
    • Social Science
    • General English of Matric Standard
    • General Hindi of Matric Standard

Normalization:

  • In case of multiple shifts CBT examination, the score of candidates shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list.

Document Verification:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification based on merit.
  • Original documents and self-attested photocopies must be produced at the time of documentation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA.
  • Only online applications will be accepted. No offline applications will be entertained.
  • Candidates must provide working mobile number and email ID which should remain active till completion of selection process.
  • The candidate shall be eligible for appointment if he/she has passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh. This condition shall not apply to Bonafide Himachalis.
  • Candidates belonging to reserved categories of other states shall be treated as General category candidates.
  • A correction window shall be opened for a period of seven days, commencing after three working days from the closing date for submission of ORAs, subject to payment of fee.
  • Admissions to the examination shall be purely provisional subject to verification of eligibility at the time of document verification.
  • Category certificates (OBC, BPL/EWS, WFF) should be valid on the closing date for submission of ORA as well as on the date of document verification.
  • Candidates with disabilities of 40% or more are allowed extra time of minimum 40 minutes for examination of two hour duration.
  • No admit card will be sent by post. Candidates will have to download their admit card from the official website.
  • Provisional answer key will be uploaded on the official website. Candidates can raise objections within seven days with a non-refundable fee of ₹200 per challenge.
  • Candidates must visit the website regularly for updates regarding roll numbers, admit card, documentation etc.
  • Dispute, if any, shall be subject to Court jurisdictions of HP.

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - Sign Up: Register on the HPRCA portal by clicking the "Sign Up" option to create a username and password.
  • Step 2 - One-Time Registration: Complete the One-Time Registration by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), uploading recent photograph and signature, and uploading relevant supporting documents.
  • Step 3 - Complete/Update Profile: Ensure your profile is complete. Only users who have completed their profile can apply for posts. Update any information if required.
  • Step 4 - Apply for Post: View the list of available posts under different categories on the HPRCA portal and click on the "Apply" button for the desired post.
  • Step 5 - Select Preferred Exam District: Select your preferred district(s) for the examination from the dropdown menu.
  • Step 6 - Confirm Application Details: The system will automatically fill your application form using information from your profile. Review the details before proceeding.
  • Step 7 - Pay Application Fee: Make the application fee payment of ₹800/- through the available payment gateway options (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking).
  • Step 8 - Application Submission Confirmation: After successful payment, your application will be considered complete. Download and save the application form for future reference.
  • Important: Candidates are strictly advised to apply online well in advance to avoid rush during closing dates.
  • Keep all original certificates and self-attested photocopies ready for document verification stage.

  • Geoinformatics: Post graduate degree in Geoinformatics/Geography/Remote Sensing/Environmental Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Development Management: Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate degree in Social Work/Rural Development/Rural Management/Development Studies/Development Management/Development Administration/Project Management/Business Management with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Project Monitoring: Bachelor's Degree or Post Graduate Degree in Agriculture/Soil Science/Agronomy/Horticulture/Land/Water resources with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Finance: BBA (Finance/Banking)/BMS (Finance/Banking) with 60% marks OR Two years full time PGDM (Finance)/Full time MBA (Finance)/MMS (Finance) with minimum 55% marks OR Bachelor of Financial and Investment Analysis with 60% marks OR Bachelor's degree with Membership of ICAI obtained on or before 01-11-2025
  • UI/UX Designing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Software Testing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation

Essential Qualifications

  • Required educational qualification must be possessed as on 01-11-2025
  • Result of final term/semester/year examination must have been declared on or before 01-11-2025
  • Candidates whose final year/semester results declared after 01-11-2025 are not eligible
  • All degrees must be from recognized University/Institution
  • Minimum percentage as specified for each discipline is mandatory

Desirable

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Certifications in climate change management, sustainable development, or environmental policy
  • Economics: Working knowledge of Visualisation tools (Tableau & Power BI), advanced quantitative and econometrics skills, knowledge of Stata/R, Excel
  • Academic Administration: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in learning and development, Certification in Instructional Design, LMS, ICT in Education
  • Graphic Designing: Certifications in E-Learning tools, Adobe Certified Professional, UX Design, LMS, Articulate or Captivate certifications, SCORM/xAPI training
  • Information Technology: Proficiency in Programming languages (Python, Java), knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, familiarity with web hosting, APIs, wireframing tools like Figma
  • Geoinformatics: Certification in GIS tools like QGIS or ArcGIS
  • UI/UX Designing: Relevant certification in UI/UX design/development

Experience (Mandatory)

  • All Disciplines: Prior relevant experience of minimum 1 year in reputed organizations
  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Minimum 1 year in climate change mitigation, adaptation, or sustainability
  • Economics: Minimum 1 year in forecasting, financial modeling, preparation of impact balance sheets, exposure to domestic and international databases
  • Data Science: Minimum 1 year, preference for projects involving banking technologies
  • Cyber Security: Minimum 1 year in Information and Cyber security domain (preferably having worked in SOC)
  • Academic Administration: Minimum 1 year in training, instructional design, learning experience design & learning and development
  • Graphic Designing: Minimum 1 year in Graphic design, animation, e-learning tools, LMS, Adobe Creative Suite
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Minimum 1 year in developmental filmmaking/social work outreach
  • Information Technology: Minimum 1 year with experience in creating BRD or FSD, analyzing processes and designing workflows
  • UI/UX Designing: Minimum 1 year as UI/UX designer and developer
  • Software Testing: Minimum 1 year in reputed organization

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹70,000/- (All Inclusive)
  • Income tax or any other tax liable will be deducted at source as per applicable rules before effecting payment
  • The stipend is paid during the entire engagement period including training
  • Young Professionals engaged on purely contractual basis

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Candidate must be an Indian citizen
  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 01-11-1995 and not later than 01-11-2004
  • No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Application Fee

  • Application Fee cum Intimation Charges: ₹150/- (exclusive of applicable GST)
  • Application Fee is Non-Refundable
  • Application Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances
  • Bank Transaction charges for Online Payment will have to be borne by the candidate
  • Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 26th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 26th December 2025
Last Date for Online Application 12th January 2026
Payment of Application Fee/Intimation Charges 26th December 2025 to 12th January 2026
Qualification & Experience Date As on 01-11-2025
Age Calculation Date As on 01-11-2025

Note: NABARD reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Application Screening
    • Applications received from interested eligible candidates shall be placed before the Screening Committee
    • Screening for interview based on matrix of identified indicators like academic performance, relevance of work experience, overall profile, statement of intent
  • Step 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted applications shall be placed before Young Professional Selection Committee (YPSC)
    • Final selection based on combined marks in Presentation and Interview conducted by YPSC
    • Interview will be conducted at respective NABARD Regional Offices of the States against which vacancies have been announced
  • Medical Fitness: Final appointment subject to being declared medically fit by Medical Officer(s) appointed/approved by the Bank
  • Document Verification: NABARD shall verify eligibility at stage of interview/joining
  • Final Decision: Final appointment based on decision of Selection Committee constituted for the purpose
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria shall not vest any right to candidate for being called for interviews
  • Decision of NABARD shall be final in all matters
  • Travel for Interview: Candidates may be reimbursed to and fro 2AC rail fare for shortest route for attending interviews

General Information/Instructions

Program Duration

  • Duration of engagement is 1 (one) year, extendable upto maximum three years
  • Extension depends on performance of Young Professional and organizational requirements

Legal Status

  • Young Professionals selected on short-term contract basis
  • Shall not be considered as "staff member" or "official" of NABARD
  • Engagement shall not establish relationship of employee and employer between NABARD and Young Professional
  • No right/claim for placement in NABARD by virtue of engagement under Young Professional Program
  • Appointed on full-time basis and shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement period

Leave Facility

  • Young Professionals entitled to maximum 30 days leave in a calendar year during engagement period
  • Leave provided on proportionate basis

Medical Facility

  • Medical facility available for self only at NABARD Dispensary

Office Facilities

  • Lounge facility, Tea/Coffee provided as per entitlement of officers of the bank
  • NABARD will provide Office Space, Internet Connectivity, and other support facilities

Conduct, Discipline and Confidentiality

  • Services governed by code of conduct as prescribed by NABARD
  • Internal data must be kept confidential
  • NABARD entitled to all intellectual property rights including patent, copyright, trademark developed during engagement
  • Must furnish undertaking for maintenance of secrecy before commencement
  • Subject to provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
  • Shall not use name, letterhead, emblem or official seal of NABARD without prior permission

Termination

  • NABARD can terminate contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
  • In normal course, NABARD may terminate engagement by giving one month's notice in advance
  • Young Professional can also seek termination by giving one month's notice
  • If notice period not served, Young Professional required to pay sum equivalent to one month's pay
  • Unauthorized absence of more than 8 days (not including public holidays and weekends) without valid explanation can lead to termination

Travel and Official Benefits

  • For official domestic travel, eligible for halting, boarding and incidental allowances same as Grade A officer of NABARD
  • In event of death, injury or illness during engagement, neither Young Professional nor dependents entitled to any compensation or employment
  • Young Professionals solely responsible for maintaining adequate insurance (life, health) at own expense

Mentorship and Review

  • Each Young Professional attached to mentor/supervising officer who acts as Project Guide
  • Mentor responsible for regularly overseeing progress
  • Assessment done jointly by Officer in Charge of Department/RO/TE and supervising officer
  • Letter of Experience/Recommendation given at end of engagement period

Application Guidelines

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens
  • Candidates should check eligibility carefully before applying
  • Applications accepted through ONLINE mode only on www.nabard.org
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Should not suppress any material information
  • If found guilty of misconduct/unfair means, liable to disqualification/debarment/termination
  • Bank reserves right to increase/decrease/modify/cancel any provisions of vacancy/recruitment process
  • No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible and non-selected candidates
  • Bank's decision shall be final and binding on all matters

For Government/PSU Employees

  • Applicants serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Nationalized Banks required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from employer at time of interview
  • Before appointment, proper relieving letter indicating date of relief and no dues pending must be produced

Legal Jurisdiction

  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai
  • Courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only shall have sole & exclusive jurisdiction

Communication

  • Notice/communication displayed on Bank's website or sent by Registered/Speed Post or email shall be deemed sufficient
  • Check www.nabard.org regularly for updates
  • Any corrigendum or announcements published only on Bank's website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit NABARD website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Under Career Notices, click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • Step 3: Choose "Click here for New Registration" tab
  • Step 4: Enter Name, Contact details and Email-id
  • Step 5: System will generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Step 6: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (will also be sent via Email & SMS)
  • Step 7: Before starting, prepare scanned documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 200x230 pixels
    • Signature (with black ink) - 10kb-20kb, jpg format, 140x60 pixels
    • Left thumb impression (on white paper with black/blue ink) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 240x240 pixels
    • Hand written declaration (on white paper with black ink) - 50kb-100kb, jpg format, 800x400 pixels
    • Latest CV/Resume in PDF format - 500KB
  • Step 8: Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Step 9: Use "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to save data and continue later if needed
  • Step 10: Carefully fill and verify all details in online application
  • Step 11: Upload Photo & Signature as per specifications
  • Step 12: Fill other details of Application Form
  • Step 13: Click on Preview Tab to verify entire application
  • Step 14: Modify details if required
  • Step 15: Click 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' only after verifying all details are correct
  • Step 16: Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment
  • Step 17: Pay application fee of ₹150/- (plus GST) using Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets
  • Step 18: Wait for intimation from server after payment - DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH
  • Step 19: On successful payment, e-Receipt will be generated
  • Step 20: Click 'Submit' button to complete application
  • Step 21: Take printout of e-Receipt and online Application Form for future reference

Important Points for Online Application

  • Apply only for ONE discipline/location - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted
  • Application will be rejected if only photo uploaded without signature
  • Left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged
  • Hand written declaration must be in candidate's handwriting and in English only
  • Keep valid personal email ID and mobile number active till completion of recruitment
  • Name should be spelt correctly as in Certificates/Mark sheets/Identity proof
  • No change possible after clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' button
  • Photo must be uploaded at place of photo and signature at place of signature
  • If photo not uploaded properly, admission for examination will be rejected/denied
  • For any problem, use "Candidate Grievance Lodging and Redressal Mechanism" at https://cgrs.ibps.in/
  • Mention "NABARD – Recruitment of Young Professionals" in subject of email

Action Against Candidates Found Guilty

  • Do not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Using unfair means will lead to disqualification
  • Impersonating or procuring impersonation will lead to criminal prosecution
  • Misbehaving in examination/interview hall will lead to disqualification
  • Carrying mobile phones or electronic devices in examination/interview hall not allowed
  • May be debarred permanently or for specified period from any examination conducted by bank
  • If already joined, services may be terminated

  • Assistant Professor: Entry Level Pay Matrix 12 (Basic Rs. 1,01,500–1,67,400) as per 7th CPC and all usual allowances, plus NPA for candidates possessing medical qualification.

Selection Process

  • Applications received within the prescribed date and time with requisite fee will be scrutinized by the scrutiny committee of the Institute.
  • Candidates found eligible after scrutiny will ONLY be called for personal interview by the Standing Selection Committee (SSC) of the Institute.
  • Mere fulfilling eligibility criteria does not confer the right to be called for interview or selection; eligibility will be decided based on duration and nature of experience, patient care, teaching/training, research, number and quality of publications, publication metrics, and administrative experience.
  • If the number of applicants is large, the Selection Committee may devise additional criteria and procedure for shortlisting, including holding a written examination if necessary.
  • Only eligible/shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, subject to verification of all requirements and documents; otherwise, they will not be allowed to appear for interview.
  • Interview schedule will be published on the official website of AIIMS Bilaspur.
  • Candidates called for interview must make a presentation on their work/achievements (maximum 05 minutes) in Microsoft PowerPoint as per prescribed proforma, to be submitted in a Pen Drive with the application and updated if required.
  • Candidates must appear personally and physically before the Selection Committee; no online interview through electronic media (e.g., Skype, Viber) will be allowed.
  • The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final and no representation will be entertained.
  • Selected candidates will be issued appointment letters subject to being declared medically fit by the Medical Board of the Institute and verification of documents, declarations, and antecedents.

General Information/Instructions

  • AIIMS Bilaspur reserves the right to increase or decrease or not to fill up any post(s)/vacancy and to amend, cancel, or change the advertisement wholly or partly without assigning any reason or notice.
  • Detailed advertisement is available on the website of the Institute and aspiring candidates may visit https://www.aiimsbilaspur.edu.in.
  • Further updates regarding the recruitment process will be available only on the Institute website.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest to apply much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • The posts are whole-time and private practice of any kind is prohibited.
  • Selected candidates will be governed by the New Pension Scheme as per Ministry of Finance Notification No.5/7/2003-ECB&PR dated 22.12.2003.
  • All original certificates/documents will be verified at the time of interview; candidates must bring originals and self-attested photocopies of age, educational qualifications, experience, NOC (if applicable), and other relevant documents.
  • Experience will be counted only after obtaining the prescribed qualification.
  • Candidates in Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Bodies must obtain “No Objection Certificate” from their present employer stating expected duration of notice period.
  • If any information or declaration is found false or if material facts are suppressed, candidature will be cancelled and, if detected after appointment, services will be summarily terminated.
  • Separate application is required for each post if a candidate is applying for more than one post.
  • Candidates are advised to visit AIIMS Bilaspur website regularly for further instructions, if any.
  • No age relaxation will be given to SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply under UR category and category once applied cannot be changed later.
  • The Executive Director, AIIMS Bilaspur is the final authority for decisions relating to this recruitment and courts of Himachal Pradesh will have exclusive jurisdiction for any dispute.

How to Apply

  • Application Fees (Step-1)
    • Pay the non-refundable application fee via online NEFT in favor of “Executive Director, AIIMS-Bilaspur” using the specified bank details.
    • Upload proof of fee payment with the application and retain the proof for production at the time of interview.
    • Applications without submission of application fee will not be considered and will be summarily rejected.
  • Application Form (Step-2)
    • Download the soft copy of the application form (Appendix-I) from the provided link.
    • Download the career graph form (Appendix-II) in MS Word format, fill it using Times New Roman, font size 12, and create a PDF (not scanned).
    • Download the presentation template in PPT format (Appendix-III) and fill it as per the proforma; rename the file with candidate name, post, and department as illustrated in the notification.
  • Online Application (Step-3)
    • Fill and submit the Google Form available at the link: https forms.gle/UAS4frrMvvQQFdfUA (as provided in the PDF).
    • Upload scanned copy of application forms in the prescribed format along with necessary documents and fee transaction details through the Google Form.
    • Failure to submit the online Google Form application will result in the candidature not being considered and liable to be rejected without notice.
    • Ensure that photo and signature uploaded are clearly visible; unclear or improperly sized images will lead to rejection of application.
  • Offline Application (Step-4)
    • Submit self-attested copies of all relevant certificates (Age, Qualification, Experience, Proof of Payment, Caste Certificate, EWS/PwBD Certificate, NOC, and other testimonials) along with printout of application (Appendix-I) and covering letter.
    • Ensure that the hard copy application reaches the following address on or before 27.01.2026 by 05:00 PM:
      Deputy Director (Administration), Administrative Block, 3rd Floor, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Kothipura, Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh – 174037.
    • Super-scribe the envelope as “Application for the post of ………….., Department of …………………….. for AIIMS, Bilaspur (H.P.).”
    • Applications received through Courier/Ordinary Postal Dak etc. are not acceptable; applications received after the due date will not be accepted and AIIMS Bilaspur will not be responsible for postal delays.
  • Through Proper Channel
    • Applicants already employed in Central/State Govt./Autonomous Institutions/Statutory organizations/PSUs should route their applications through proper channel.
    • Forwarding authority must certify that there is “No Objection” if the officer applies and is selected and provide Vigilance, Integrity and Penalty certificates.
    • In case of selection, the officer will join AIIMS Bilaspur only after submitting relieving or resignation certificate from the present employer.
    • Applicants may submit an advance copy of the application to avoid delay, but interview letters will be issued only after receipt of application through proper channel.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

However, the University may ask any additional documents in support of any information/document for clarity as & when so required.

  • If any candidate wants to apply for more than one post, he/she is required to apply separately with prescribed fee.
  • Age of the applicant must not be below 18 years and above 42 years. Age relaxation to the applicant under various categories shall be given as per the provisions in the General Administration Department, Haryana Govt. notification no. 22/132/2013- 1GS-III dated 22nd March 2022 or amended time to time.

  • Please read the instructions carefully before applying. Applicants willing to apply are advised to apply online through the link available on the University website www.gurugramuniversity.ac.in between 10.12.2025 (9:00 am) to 30.12.2025 (midnight).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Female/Male Nurse ANM): 10th (Matric) pass with minimum 45% marks AND 18 months ANM training course pass. Must be registered with Jharkhand Nursing Council.
  • Qualifications (Pharmacist/Compounder): I.Sc./10+2 (Science) pass AND Diploma in Pharmacist/Compounder course. Must be registered with Jharkhand State or other State Pharmacy Council.
  • Qualifications (Dresser): 10th (Matric) pass AND one year training course for Dresser post from a Government recognized institution.
  • Qualifications (X-Ray Technician): I.Sc./10+2 (Science) pass AND Diploma in X-Ray Technician course. Must be registered with Jharkhand State or other State Para Medical Council. Basic computer knowledge is essential.
  • All certificates related to eligibility must be available by the last date of online application submission.

Salary/Stipend

  • Female Nurse (ANM)/Male Nurse (ANM): Level-4 (₹25,500-₹81,100).
  • Pharmacist/X-Ray Technician: Level-5 (₹29,200-₹92,300).
  • Compounder (Mishrak): Level-2 (₹19,900-₹63,200).
  • Dresser (Parijhapak): Level-1 (₹18,000-₹56,900).

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2025)

  • Minimum Age Limit: 20 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit (as per 04.01.2021 resolution):
    • Unreserved (UR) & EWS Category: 35 years.
    • EBC (Ann-I) & BC (Ann-II) (Male): 37 years.
    • Female (UR, EBC Ann-I, BC Ann-II): 38 years.
    • SC/ST (Male & Female): 40 years.
  • Additional 10 years age relaxation for PwD candidates in all categories.
  • Additional 5 years age relaxation for Ex-servicemen.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs. 100/-.
  • Fee for SC/ST candidates of Jharkhand State: Rs. 50/-.
  • Fee is non-refundable.
  • Payment can be made online, and the last date for payment is February 9, 2026.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on the "Jharkhand State Jails Para Medical Workers Recruitment Combined Competitive Examination-2025", which will be a Computer-Based Test (CBT).
  • The exam consists of two papers (Paper I and Paper II), except for the Dresser post which only has Paper I.
  • Paper I is a qualifying general subject paper (General Knowledge, Hindi, English). Candidates must secure a minimum of 30% marks in Paper I to be considered in the merit list.
  • The final merit list will be prepared by adding marks of both Paper I and Paper II (where applicable).
  • A minimum qualifying mark in the total score is also defined for different categories (UR: 40%, SC/ST/Female: 32%, EBC-I: 34%, BC-II: 36.5%).

General Information/Instructions

  • Posts are under the Home, Prison, and Disaster Management Department of the Jharkhand Government.
  • Only applications submitted through the JSSC website portal will be accepted.
  • Reservation benefits are applicable as per Jharkhand Government rules and require valid local resident/caste certificates issued by the competent authority in the prescribed formats.
  • Candidates must upload their scanned photo and full signature during the online application process.
  • Admit Cards will be uploaded on the website; no physical admit cards will be sent via post.

How To Apply

  • Visit the JSSC official website: `www.jssc.jharkhand.gov.in`.
  • Click on the link for "Online Application for JJPSCCE-2025" and complete the registration process.
  • Log in with the registration number and password received on mobile/email.
  • Fill in detailed information and pay the examination fee online.
  • Upload a recent scanned photograph and full signature.
  • Submit the application and take a printout of the final form for future reference.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.
