Eligibility Criteria

  • The advertisement is open only for citizens of India.
  • For Assistant Professor (Engineering/Design): Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s and Master’s degree level in the appropriate branch as listed in the relevant department table.
  • For Assistant Professor (Sciences/Humanities/Arts): Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s and Master’s degree level in the appropriate branch, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or the specified exemption conditions for candidates registered for Ph.D. prior to July 11, 2009.
  • For Associate Professor: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s and Master’s level, minimum eight years of teaching/research experience in an academic/research position equivalent to Assistant Professor, and minimum seven publications in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI/ABDC indexed journals with a total research score of 75 as per the given criteria.
  • For Professor: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s and Master’s level, minimum ten years of teaching and/or research experience at appropriate levels with evidence of successfully guided doctoral candidates, and minimum ten publications in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI/ABDC indexed journals with a total research score of 120 as per the given criteria.
  • Candidates must apply in the prescribed application proforma and provide self-attested documentary evidence for all claims including scores in the academic/research score tables.
  • Reservation benefits and qualifying marks relaxation are applicable as per Government of India norms for SC/OBC (Non-creamy Layer) candidates, with an OBC certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025.

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Consolidated salary of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month plus Dearness Allowance (DA) as per applicable rates.
  • Associate Professor: Consolidated salary of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month plus DA.
  • Assistant Professor: Consolidated salary of Rs. 57,700/- per month plus DA.
  • House Rent Allowance is admissible at applicable rates; however, on-campus accommodation will not be provided.
  • No increment or additional allowances are admissible during the contract period apart from those specifically mentioned.
  • Professional Development Allowance up to a specified annual limit and certain research-related grants are available during the contract, subject to conditions.

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized based on scores filled by candidates in the summary sheet as per the specified academic and research score tables.
  • Documentary evidence must be submitted for all parameters claimed in the scoring tables, and verified scores will not exceed the claimed scores.
  • Candidates are shortlisted for participation in the selection process on the basis of their verified scores; mere fulfilment of minimum qualifications does not guarantee call for interview.
  • The selection process comprises a seminar or sample teaching session followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.
  • A maximum of 15 candidates will be called for interview against one post, and 5 additional candidates will be called for each additional post under a category.

How To Apply

  • Candidates must apply using the prescribed application proforma provided in the brochure annexures.
  • Separate applications must be submitted for each post and each department for which a candidate wishes to apply.
  • The application form must be typed, complete, and supported by self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents and proofs for claimed scores.
  • Hard copy of the application along with all enclosures must be sent by speed/registered post to the office of Dean Faculty Affairs, Punjab Engineering College (Deemed to be University), Sector-12, Chandigarh-160012.
  • The envelope containing the application must be superscribed with the name of the post and department applied for.
  • Applications will be considered subject to availability of vacancies at the time of each recruitment cycle under this rolling advertisement.

Important Dates

Notification Date 08 November 2025
Rolling Advertisement Applications will be open throughout the year and processed twice in a year (applications received up to 31st October and 30th April of every year).
Application Closing Date (1st Cycle) 30 December 2025

Instructions

  • Incomplete applications or applications without required documentary evidence will be summarily rejected.
  • Additional documents will not be accepted after submission of the application form.
  • The institute reserves the right to amend the number of posts or not to fill any advertised posts without assigning reasons.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for participation in the selection process.
  • The appointment will be on purely temporary contractual basis for three years, with no increment and no other allowances except those specified.
  • Reservation will be implemented as per the approved roster of the Chandigarh Administration.

If the remaining age after deduction does not exceed 3 years from the upper age limit as per service rules, the candidate will be considered eligible.

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Candidates who successfully apply online will be called for an Objective Type Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) written examination
  • Merit List Preparation: The merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination
  • Tie-Breaking Rules: In case of equal marks in the written examination:
    • First preference: Older candidate (based on date of birth)
    • Second preference: Higher percentage in required educational qualification
    • Third preference: Higher marks in Matriculation examination
  • Document Verification/Counseling: Based on the merit list, candidates will be called for document verification/counseling. The number of candidates called will be decided by the Board or competent authority considering category-wise vacancies
  • Final Selection: Only after successful verification of all documents and fulfillment of eligibility criteria, candidates' names will be recommended to the concerned department based on available vacancies
  • Important Note: Appearing in online application, written examination, merit list, or counseling does not guarantee selection. Final recommendation depends on complete eligibility verification and vacancy availability

General Information/Instructions

  • Punjab Domicile Mandatory: Only residents of Punjab State are eligible for reservation benefits. Valid Domicile/Residence Certificate (not older than 5 years) must be submitted during counseling

  • Category Code Selection: Candidates must carefully select category and category code while filling the online form as it cannot be changed at any stage
  • Ex-Servicemen Priority: ESM (Self) candidates will be given first preference. Only if ESM (Self) is not available, ESM (Dependent) candidates will be considered
  • Women Reservation: Recruitment will be done as per Punjab Civil Services (Reservation of Posts for Women) Rules, 2020, Notification No. G.S.R. 87/Const/Art.309 and 15/2020 dated 21/10/2020
  • Document Upload: Candidates must scan and upload required certificates in PDF format in a single file during online application
  • No Personal Communication: All recruitment-related information will be published only on the Board's website. No individual communication will be sent to candidates
  • No TA/DA: No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance will be paid for attending written examination or counseling
  • Board's Rights Reserved: The Board reserves the right to modify/cancel/increase/decrease the number of vacancies or category-wise distribution at any stage of recruitment
  • Final Decision: The decision of the Board or Committee constituted by the Board shall be final and binding on all candidates

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - Visit Official Website: Visit the official website of PSSSB at https://sssb.punjab.gov.in
  • Step 2 - Click on Online Applications: Click on "Online Applications" link on the website
  • Step 3 - Select Post: For Advertisement 16, first click on Junior Engineer post, then select one from Civil/Mechanical/Electrical as per your qualification
  • Step 4 - Registration: Fill personal and educational details carefully and complete registration. A Username will be generated after successful registration
  • Step 5 - Login and Fill Form: Login using the generated Username and complete the application form step-wise
  • Step 6 - Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of passport size photograph, signature, Matriculation certificate (for date of birth), 12th certificate, Diploma/Degree certificates, and category certificates (if applicable)
  • Step 7 - Submit Application: After uploading all documents, submit the complete application form. The form will be accepted only after successful fee payment
  • Step 8 - Fee Payment: After submitting the form (skipping one day), pay the application fee through:
    • State Bank of India branch via Challan (on any working day)
    • Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI (anytime before 31-12-2025)
  • Step 9 - Download Application Form: After successful fee payment (after 2 days), download and print the application form for future reference
  • Step 10 - No Correction After Submission: Once submitted, no changes can be made to the application form. Candidates must fill the form carefully
  • Important Note: Candidates are advised to apply themselves and not take help from cyber cafes to avoid errors. Self-application is recommended

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidate must have passed Matriculation from a recognised education board.
  • Punjabi must be passed at Matric level as a compulsory/elective subject or equivalent as per Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (all categories).

  • Upper age for Ex‑Servicemen of Punjab: as per Punjab Recruitment of Ex‑Servicemen Rules, 1982 (age after deducting military service must not exceed upper limit by more than 3 years).
  • Maximum Age for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) of Punjab: 47 years (10 years relaxation).
  • Upper age for widows, divorcees and certain other categories of married women: up to 40 years as per Govt. instructions dated 23.04.1984.

Salary / Stipend

  • All Group‑D posts (Sewadar, Chowkidar, Sweeper‑cum‑Chowkidar, Safai Sevak, Sweeper‑cum‑Mali, Mali‑cum‑Chowkidar, Fisherman, Boatman, Laboratory Attendant) carry pay scale ₹18,000 – 56,900, Level‑1 as per 7th CPC.
  • Pay, allowances and other benefits will be admissible as per instructions of the Finance Department (Personnel‑I Branch), Govt. of Punjab issued from time to time.

Selection Process

  • The selection will be based on an Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions) written examination.
  • Syllabus and exam pattern will be uploaded separately on the official website of PSSSB.
  • Admit Cards for the written exam will be available only in online mode on the Board’s website; no separate intimation by post.
  • Final merit list will be prepared purely on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination.
  • In case of tie in written marks, older candidate (by date of birth) will be placed higher in merit; if still tied, higher percentage in essential qualification will be considered; if still tied, higher Matric marks will be considered.
  • Shortlisted candidates as per merit will be called for counselling and document verification as per category‑wise vacancies.
  • Recommendation to the concerned department will be made only for those candidates who are found fully eligible in document verification.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website of PSSSB: https://sssb.punjab.gov.in and click on the “Online Applications” link.
  • Apply online only from 21-11-2025 to 03-01-2026 up to 5:00 PM; no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • For each post, submit a separate online application form and pay separate fee if applying for more than one post.
  • First select the post, then complete registration by entering basic details and educational details; a username/registration number will be generated.
  • Login again using registration details and fill the application form step‑by‑step, upload passport‑size photograph, signature and required educational certificates (Matric with date of birth, 10+2, diploma/degree as applicable).
  • Submit the online application form; fee can be paid from the next working day after form submission up to 29-12-2025.
  • Pay exam fee through SBI challan at any branch, or through Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI as available.
  • After successful fee payment, download and print the final submitted application form and keep it safely for future reference.
  • No correction will be allowed after final submission of the online application form.

Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only through the official website; applications by any other mode will be rejected.
  • Candidates are solely responsible for the correctness of information entered in the online form; no change in category, category‑code or other particulars will be allowed later.
  • All educational qualifications and category certificates must be valid and issued by recognised Boards/Universities/Authorities as per Punjab Government instructions.
  • Reservation benefits are admissible only to domiciled residents of Punjab having valid domicile/residence certificates and relevant caste/category certificates.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without required fee, or without uploading mandatory documents will be rejected.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written examination or counselling/document verification.
  • All recruitment‑related updates such as exam schedule, admit card, result, merit list, counselling schedule and corrigendum will be displayed only on the official website; no separate letters will be sent.
  • If any document or information is found false at any stage, candidature will be cancelled and legal action may be initiated as per rules.
  • The Board reserves the right to change, modify or cancel any terms, number of vacancies, or selection stages as per requirement.
  • For technical issues in online apply, candidates can contact [email protected]; for other queries they can contact the office during working hours on the notified phone numbers.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Punjabi language: All posts require knowledge of Punjabi up to Matriculation level, i.e., candidate must have passed Matric with Punjabi or equivalent exam; additionally, a qualifying Punjabi language test (Matric level) with at least 50% marks conducted by the recruiting agency is mandatory for Group-C posts.
  • Hostel Superintendent-cum-PTI: Matric in second division or 10+2; Certificate in Physical Education (C.P.Ed) from recognized institution (preference for Diploma in Physical Education); at least 2 years’ relevant experience.
  • Storekeeper: Matric second class or 10+2; National Trade Certificate/National Apprenticeship Certificate in any Engineering Trade; minimum 1-year experience of storekeeping in Engineering Stores.
  • Librarian: (Option 1) Bachelor in Library and Information Science with at least 1 year practical experience in factory/State Govt/institute recognized by Govt, OR (Option 2) B.A./B.Sc. with Diploma in Library Science and at least 3 years’ practical experience in factory/State Govt/institute.
  • Autoclave Operator/Machine Operator: Matric or 10+2 plus 2-year certificate in Mechanical trade from ITI; preference for candidates with knowledge of running and maintenance of bulk sterilizer/electrical or steam heaters.
  • Junior Technician (Civil): National Trade Certificate in Civil Draftsman trade or Diploma in Civil Engineering with 50% marks from recognized institution.
  • Junior Technician (Electrical): National Trade Certificate in Electrician trade or Diploma in Electrical Engineering with 50% marks from recognized institution.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • General category: Minimum 18 years and maximum 37 years.
  • SC/BC of Punjab: Upper age limit 42 years.
  • Punjab and Central Govt employees: Upper age relaxation up to 45 years.
  • Ex-servicemen of Punjab: Upper age as per Punjab Recruitment of Ex-servicemen Rules, 1982; effective age is actual age minus service years, subject to maximum relaxations.
  • Widows, divorcees and certain other married women categories: Upper age relaxation up to 40 years as per Govt instructions.

Salary/Stipend

  • Hostel Superintendent-cum-PTI: Basic pay Rs. 29,200/- per month (Level-5, 7th CPC) under Punjab Industrial Training Non-Ministerial Service Rules 2025.
  • Storekeeper: Basic pay Rs. 19,900/- per month (Level-2, 7th CPC) under same rules.
  • Librarian: Basic pay Rs. 29,200/- per month (Level-5, 7th CPC).
  • Autoclave Operator/Machine Operator: Basic pay Rs. 25,500/- per month (Level-4, 7th CPC) under Punjab Veterinary/Husbandry Service (Group-C) amended rules 2025.
  • Junior Technician (Civil/Electrical): Basic pay Rs. 19,900/- per month (Level-2, 7th CPC) as per Punjab State Warehousing Corporation Staff (Conditions of Service) Regulations.

Application Fee

  • General / Sports / Freedom Fighter: Rs. 1000/-
  • SC / BC / Economically Weaker Section (EWS): Rs. 250/-
  • Ex-servicemen & Dependents: Rs. 200/-
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on an Objective Type (MCQ) written examination conducted by PSSSB.
  • Merit list is prepared solely on marks obtained in the written exam; tie-breaking is done by considering age (older higher), educational percentage, and then Matric marks if needed.
  • Based on merit and category-wise vacancies, candidates are called for counselling and document verification; final recommendations are sent to the concerned departments.
  • No candidate gains an automatic right of appointment merely by appearing in the exam or being in the merit list; eligibility is finally determined at counselling/document verification.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only through PSSSB website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in under “Online Applications” from 05/12/2025 to 27/12/2025.
  • Applicants must complete registration to generate username and password, then log in and fill the step-wise online application form, uploading passport-size photo, signature and required certificates (Matric D.O.B proof, technical qualification, category certificate, etc.) in a single PDF.
  • Application will be accepted only after full fee payment; fee must be paid via SBI challan (any branch) or online via net banking/credit card/debit card/UPI up to 30/12/2025.
  • After fee payment, candidates can download the final application form on the next working day and must keep a copy safely for future reference.
  • No offline applications or late submissions will be accepted; no changes are allowed after final form submission except limited edits before first submit.

  • Candidates must produce original educational, technical, category, domicile, and experience certificates and their self-attested copies at counselling; failure will result in cancellation.

  • Written Examination: Candidates who successfully apply online will be called for an Objective Type Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) written examination
  • Merit List Preparation: The merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination
  • Tie-Breaking Rules: In case of equal marks in the written examination:
    • First preference: Older candidate (based on date of birth)
    • Second preference: Higher percentage in required educational qualification
    • Third preference: Higher marks in Matriculation examination
  • Document Verification/Counseling: Based on the merit list, candidates will be called for document verification/counseling. The number of candidates called will be decided by the Board or competent authority considering category-wise vacancies
  • Final Selection: Only after successful verification of all documents and fulfillment of eligibility criteria, candidates' names will be recommended to the concerned department based on available vacancies
  • Important Note: Appearing in online application, written examination, merit list, or counseling does not guarantee selection. Final recommendation depends on complete eligibility verification and vacancy availability

General Information/Instructions

  • Punjab Domicile Mandatory: Only residents of Punjab State are eligible for reservation benefits. Valid Domicile/Residence Certificate (not older than 5 years) must be submitted during counseling
  • Category Certificates: SC/BC/Ex-Servicemen/PWD/EWS certificates must be as per Punjab Government's prevailing instructions
  • Category Code Selection: Candidates must carefully select category and category code while filling the online form as it cannot be changed at any stage
  • Ex-Servicemen Priority: ESM (Self) candidates will be given first preference. Only if ESM (Self) is not available, ESM (Dependent) candidates will be considered
  • Women Reservation: Recruitment will be done as per Punjab Civil Services (Reservation of Posts for Women) Rules, 2020, Notification No. G.S.R. 87/Const/Art.309 and 15/2020 dated 21/10/2020
  • Document Upload: Candidates must scan and upload required certificates in PDF format in a single file during online application
  • No Personal Communication: All recruitment-related information will be published only on the Board's website. No individual communication will be sent to candidates
  • No TA/DA: No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance will be paid for attending written examination or counseling
  • Board's Rights Reserved: The Board reserves the right to modify/cancel/increase/decrease the number of vacancies or category-wise distribution at any stage of recruitment
  • Final Decision: The decision of the Board or Committee constituted by the Board shall be final and binding on all candidates

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - Visit Official Website: Visit the official website of PSSSB at https://sssb.punjab.gov.in
  • Step 2 - Click on Online Applications: Click on "Online Applications" link on the website
  • Step 3 - Select Post: For Advertisement 16, first click on Junior Engineer post, then select one from Civil/Mechanical/Electrical as per your qualification
  • Step 4 - Registration: Fill personal and educational details carefully and complete registration. A Username will be generated after successful registration
  • Step 5 - Login and Fill Form: Login using the generated Username and complete the application form step-wise
  • Step 6 - Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of passport size photograph, signature, Matriculation certificate (for date of birth), 12th certificate, Diploma/Degree certificates, and category certificates (if applicable)
  • Step 7 - Submit Application: After uploading all documents, submit the complete application form. The form will be accepted only after successful fee payment
  • Step 8 - Fee Payment: After submitting the form (skipping one day), pay the application fee through:
    • State Bank of India branch via Challan (on any working day)
    • Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI (anytime before 31-12-2025)
  • Step 9 - Download Application Form: After successful fee payment (after 2 days), download and print the application form for future reference
  • Step 10 - No Correction After Submission: Once submitted, no changes can be made to the application form. Candidates must fill the form carefully
  • Important Note: Candidates are advised to apply themselves and not take help from cyber cafes to avoid errors. Self-application is recommended
  • Technical Support: For technical issues during online application, email at [email protected]

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualifications:

Last date for applying on Google form 07 January 2026 by (05:00 PM)
Last Date of receipt of Hard Copy of Application Form 12 January 2026 by (05:00 PM IST)
Date of Interview To be notified later

Selection Process

  • Initial Screening: Based on bio-data, the Search cum Selection Committee may short-list candidates for interview
  • Written Examination: In case of large number of applicants, candidates may be asked to appear in a written examination
  • Short-listing Criteria: Short-listing will be done on the basis of educational qualification, experience etc. and/or as per the short-listing criteria as may be decided by the Competent Authority
  • Screening Test: In case large number of applications received for the Senior Resident post, a Screening Test may be conducted for short-listing of candidates. The Scheme and the method of Screening Test (Computer Based Test or Offline Test) shall be notified in due course on the website of AIIMS, Bathinda
  • Interview: Candidates called for interview will have to produce all relevant original documents in proof of details furnished in their application form
  • Final Selection: Selection will be made on the basis of interview/ written examination
  • Decision Authority: The decision of Executive Director, AIIMS, Bathinda in this regard will be final and binding

General Information/Instructions

Reservation Criteria

For PwBD (Person with Benchmark Disability) Candidates:

  • Reservation to candidates belonging to Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) category is applicable by Govt. of India Policy, which will be provided on Horizontal basis to PwBD candidates in their respective categories
  • The disability certificate should be issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospitals / Institutions and countersigned by Medical Superintendent /CMO / Head of Hospital / Institution
  • Only such persons would be eligible for reservation under PwBD quota who suffer from not less than 40% of physical disability
  • Person who wants to avail the benefit of reservation would have to submit a Disability Certificate as issued by a Competent Authority in prescribed format

For OBC Candidates:

  • Candidates applying under OBC category must produce the valid caste certificate in the format provided by the DoP&T vide O.M. No. 36036/2/2013-Estt. (Res.) dated 30.05.2014 and further clarification issued by DoP&T OM No. 36036/2/2013-Estt(Res-I) dated 31.03.2016
  • The certificate must mention the non-creamy layer status of the applicant
  • The OBC applicants who belong to the 'Non-Creamy Layer' and whose caste appears in the Central List of the OBCs shall be eligible
  • The validity of the non-creamy layer certificate shall be issued for the financial year 2025-2026 (which is the year of advertisement), issued from 1st April 2025 to 07th January 2026

For EWS Candidates:

  • Application under EWS category will be considered subject to submission of Income and Assets certificate on a prescribed format issued by the competent authority
  • A EWS certificate issued in prescribed format for employment in Central Government on the basis on income of financial year 2024-2025, issued from 1st April 2025 to 07th January 2026

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Tenure: The appointment is initially for one year and extendable up to maximum 03 (Three) years upon the recommendation of Head of the Department / discretion of the competent authority
  • Joining Period: Candidates have to join within one month from the date of issue of appointment letter. No extension will be allowed in any circumstances
  • Termination: The appointment can be terminated at any time by the Institute by giving one month notice or salary in lieu thereof
  • Full-time Position: This appointment is of full time and private practice of any kind is prohibited
  • Work Requirements: He/she will have to work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute
  • Leave: The leave entitlement of the appointee shall be governed by the Institute's leave rules as amended from time to time
  • No Benefits: The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc., or any other benefits available to Government Servants appointed on regular basis
  • NOC/Relieving Letter: If an appointee wishes to apply somewhere else or resign within the first 03 (Three) months of joining, then neither he/ she will be issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) nor he/ she will receive any Relieving Letter or Experience Certificate
  • Experience Counting: The period of experience, wherever prescribed, shall be counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification
  • Government Employees: The candidates who are in service in any Government Institutions are required to submit "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of Interview
  • Discipline: He/ she should conform to the rules of discipline and conduct as applicable to the Institute employees
  • No Travelling Allowance: No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidates for interview and joining on selection
  • Court Conviction: The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will lead to a disqualification
  • Jurisdiction: All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Court of Law at Bathinda

Important Notes

  • The candidates who applied earlier vide Advertisement No. AIIMS/BTI/RC/SR/2076 dated 18 October 2025 shall be considered, and they are not required to apply again
  • The above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The Executive Director, AIIMS, Bathinda reserves the right to vary the vacancies including reserved vacancies as per the Govt. of India rules/circulars and requirements
  • Inadequately filled/ incomplete application form will be summarily rejected and no enquiry or representation will be entertained in this regard
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy
  • Candidates who fail to produce valid category certificate OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PWBD etc. during document verification or as and when required, the candidature will be cancelled
  • The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final and no representation will be entertained in this regard

Important Dates

Date Description
09/12/2025 Notification Date
09/12/2025 Start Date for Online Application
07/01/2026 Last Date for Online Application

Selection Process

  • Selection will be on the basis of merit list prepared of all candidates who apply against the notification. The merit list will be prepared for the purpose on the basis of percentage of marks in matriculation (with minimum 50% of aggregate marks) + ITI marks in the trade in which apprenticeship is to be done. The panel will be on the basis of simple average of marks in the matriculation and ITI.
  • In case of two candidates having the same marks, the candidates with older age shall be preferred. In case the dates of birth are also same, then the candidate who passed matriculation exam earlier shall be considered first.
  • A final merit list will be prepared trade wise and community wise, equal to the number of slots in the descending order of percentage of marks obtained by the candidate.
  • Candidates finally enlisted would be subject to verification of original testimonials and being found fit in appropriate medical examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The decision of the Railway administration in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the application and mode of selection shall be final.
  • Imparting Training in Railway will not confer any right to the candidates for their absorption in Railway after successful completion of training.
  • No correspondences for engagement will be entertained.
  • CANVASSING IN ANY FORM WILL DISQUALIFY THE CANDIDATURE AND NO CORRESPONDENCE WILL BE ENTERTAINED IN THE MATTER.
  • If the marks of 10th Passed is given in CGPA the percentage of the same to be filled up in format (ONLINE Application) also.
  • Enrolment with Employment Exchange is must except for wards of employees of RCF/Kapurthala.
  • Engagement of Act Apprentices will be from the sources of candidates who have registered their names in the nearest Employment Exchanges.
  • Before applying, the candidates should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other criteria, at any stage of engagement and if erroneously engaged, such candidates shall be summarily dismissed without notice.
  • Candidature of the candidate shall be cancelled if he/she fails to produce the required original testimonials for verification or any other discrepancy noticed.
  • If it is noticed by the Railway administration that the applicant has furnished wrong/fake Certificates/ false certificates, the Railway administration reserves the right to discharge the candidate/selected candidate at any stage without notice even after his selection to undergo training.
  • The Railway administration do not undertake any responsibility for sending reply to the candidates not selected or not called for. No correspondence in respect of the application submitted shall be entertained or replied by this office to any individual or organization.
  • The Railway administration will not be responsible for any printing error.
  • A merit list will be prepared by the Committee who will then place the result before the Head of Workshop/Unit/Division for approval. The result should be declared within 15 days of the closure of receipt of application.
  • The candidates who are called for document verification are advised to bring their medical fitness certificate duly issued by Government authorized doctor (Gaz.) not below the rank of Asst. Surgeon of Central/State Hospital.
  • No daily allowance/conveyance allowance or traveling allowance will be paid to the candidate who will be called for document verification.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply ONLINE by visiting www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in Detailed instruction for filling up ONLINE applications will be available on the website.
  • Candidates are required to log on the RCF website www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in provided for filling ONLINE applications and fill up the personal details/BIO-DATA etc. carefully.
  • Candidates should ensure their name, father name, date of birth exactly match as recorded in Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Any deviation found during Document Verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and also debarment.
  • Candidates are advised to indicate their active mobile number and valid e-mail ID in the ONLINE application and keep them active during the entire engagement process as all important messages will be sent by email/SMS which will be treated as deemed to have been read by the candidates.
  • Candidates trying to submit more than one application with different particulars like Name/Father's name/community/Photo(face)/educational and/ or technical qualifications etc. or with different Email ID/Mobile Number are advised that all such applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates have to keep printout of their application. If found eligible, he/she will be called for Document Verification and the print out of Online application is required to be produced at the time of Document Verification.
  • Candidates are required to upload their passport size coloured photograph (size 3.5cm x 3.5 cm, not older than three months from the date of application in JPG/JPEG format, 100 PDI, Size of the image/file should be between 20 kb-70 kb) with clear front view of the candidates without cap and sunglasses.
  • Candidates are also required to upload their signature (size 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, size of the file should be between 20 kb – 30 kb).
  • The ONLINE application, complete in all respects, can be submitted through ONLINE process to RCF up to 07.01.2026 till 24.00 hours. No physical copy of the application is required to be sent to RCF.

This Recruitment 2025 drive invites applications for a total of 06 vacancies, including Scientist-C and Research Assistant roles, on a purely temporary basis. Eligible candidates must attend a walk-in interview on 09/01/2026, with reporting time between 09:00 AM and 10:30 AM.

The selection process for these temporary project roles involves an interview and/or written exam at the Department of Pathology in AIIMS Bathinda. Successful applicants can expect a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 18,000/- to Rs. 73,700/- per month, depending on the specific role and qualifications. Candidates should bring their completed application form, bio-data, and original documents for verification on the interview day.

  • Qualifications (Scientist-C): M.Sc. Life science/MPH/MHA/M. Pharm/Pharm. D with 4 years of experience in relevant area. Desirable: PhD degree in Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology with 2 years R&D/Teaching experience.
  • Qualifications (Research Assistant): Any Bachelor Degree from a recognized University. Desirable: Well versed in local languages (Punjabi & Hindi) and English (oral and written), experience in Cancer Registry.
  • Qualifications (Lab Technician II): Intermediate or 12th pass in science subject AND 2 years diploma in medical laboratory technician OR one year DMLT plus one year work experience OR two years field experience (BSc degree treated as 3 years experience). Desirable: Well versed in local languages (Punjabi & Hindi) and English.
  • Qualifications (Data Entry Operator Grade I): Intermediate or 12th pass with a speed test of not less than 15000 key depressions per hour. Desirable: 2 years experience in EDP work in government/PSU/recognized organization.
  • Qualifications (Multi-tasking staff): High school or equivalent from recognized institute. Desirable: Well versed in local languages (Punjabi & Hindi) and English.

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Inspector of Factories & Boilers:
    • A degree in Mechanical or Production or Power Plant or Metallurgical Engineering from a recognised University or equivalent.
    • Two years experience as technical personnel in relevant fields related to boilers/Boilers Act, 1923 implementation.
  • For Inspector of Factories (Chemical):
    • B.E.(Chemical) of a University established by law in India or equivalent qualifications.
  • General requirements for both posts:
    • Working knowledge of Hindi written in Devnagari Script and knowledge of Rajasthan Culture.
    • Required experience (for Post 1) and qualifications (for Post 2) must be obtained by the last date of online application.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Minimum Age: 23 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years
  • Age relaxation is provided as per rules for various categories of Rajasthan state residents, such as SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Women/Ex-servicemen.
  • There is no upper age limit for Widow and Divorcee Women applicants.

Application Fee

One Time Registration (OTR) fees are as follows:

  • General (Unreserved) / Backward Classes Creamy Layer / More Backward Classes Creamy Layer: ₹600/-
  • Reserved Categories (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer/MBC Non-Creamy Layer/EWS/Sahariya): ₹400/-
  • Persons with Disabilities (PH): ₹400/-

Salary/Stipend

  • The posts are on Pay Matrix Level L-14.
  • During the probation period (Parivikshakaal) as per state government rules, a fixed monthly remuneration (Fix Pay) will be payable.

Selection Process

  • The selection of candidates will be made through a written examination.
  • Scaling/moderation/normalization methods may be adopted by the Commission if necessary.
  • The examination will be objective type (Offline/Online) with multiple choice questions.
  • Negative marking shall be applicable (one-third of marks for every wrong answer).
  • The exam duration is 2 hours and 30 minutes, consisting of 150 questions for 150 marks.

How To Apply

  • Candidates must apply online through the RPSC website (https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in) or the SSO Portal (https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in).
  • One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory for all candidates.
  • Candidates must verify their details (Name, Father's Name, DOB, Gender, etc.) carefully during OTR, as these cannot be changed later.
  • Candidates must upload a live photo, signature, and left thumb impression scan during the application process.
  • After final submission, candidates must take a printout of the application form for future reference.

BEML Limited has announced a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST and OBC candidates, aiming to fill 50 backlog vacancies across various positions in Group A, Group B, and Group C categories. The recruitment includes roles such as Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer, Asst. Engineer, Diploma Trainee, and Office Assistant Trainee.

Candidates applying for these positions must meet specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications such as a First Class full-time Engineering Degree, MBA, CA/ICWA, or a Diploma for certain posts. The salary scales range from ₹90,000 to ₹2,40,000 for higher positions like Dy. General Manager and Asst. General Manager, while Diploma Trainees will receive a stipend ranging from ₹17,000 to ₹25,500 depending on the contract year. The age limit for applicants varies by post and category, with relaxations for SC/ST and OBC candidates, as well as an additional 10-year age relaxation for PwD candidates. Interested candidates must apply online by 7th January 2026.

Company Name BEML Limited (BEML)
Post Name Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC – Group ‘A’ (Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer), Group ‘B’ (Asst. Engineer) & Group ‘C’ (Diploma Trainees, Office Assistant Trainees) Backlog Vacancies

Age Limit Grade VII – 50 years (SC/ST), 48 years (OBC); Grade VI – 47/45 years; Grade V – 44/42 years; Grade IV – 39/37 years; Grade II – 34/32 years; Grade I – 34/32 years; Wage Group S1 & B – 34/32 years; PwD: additional 10 years; maximum age with relaxation not beyond 57 years.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, Qualification and Experience should be as on 07th January 2026.
  • Under qualifying marks, First Class is reckoned at 60% aggregate (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST & PwD); candidates with CGPA/credits must provide conversion formula.

  • PwD candidates must submit PwD certificate in the prescribed format; age relaxation of additional 10 years is applicable for PwD with minimum 40% disability.

  • Online application form can be accessed in the career page at www.bemlindia.in; online registration site is available till 18:00 Hrs on 07th January 2026.
  • Candidates must have a valid e-mail ID and mobile number for registration and further correspondence; change of e-mail or mobile will not be entertained during the recruitment process.
  • A Registration number will be generated and should be noted for all future correspondence.
  • While filling online application, experience section should first list latest experience, followed by previous experiences; a brief pen picture of experience relevant to the position must be written.
  • Candidates must upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, category certificates, academic certificates and mark sheets, identity proof, experience documents, detailed resume, current reporting structure and latest pay-slip as per checklist.
  • Experienced candidates must provide detailed pen picture of each experience; all experience documents must clearly indicate start and end dates of each employment.
  • OBC candidates (except SC/ST/PwD) must pay the non-refundable Rs. 500/- fee through the link at the end of application form.

ITI Limited Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 215 Contract Posts

Advertisement

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization ITI Limited (A Govt. of India Undertaking)
Department Corporate Office & Various Units of ITI Limited
Exam Name Young Professional Recruitment 2026
Post Young Professional – Graduate / Technician / Operator / Generalist / Official Language
Total Vacancies 215 Posts
Mode of Application Online

Educational Qualification BE/B.Tech/MBA/PG/ Diploma/ITI/Graduation depending on post and domain
Age Limit Upper age limit generally 35 years for YP Technician/Generalist; internal candidates relaxation up to 45 years
Selection Process Shortlisting + GD & PI for Graduates; Shortlisting + Skill Test for Technicians & Operators
Official Website itiltd.in

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification from ITI Limited specifies the advertisement date and the last date for receipt of online applications. Candidates should strictly adhere to the application deadline and regularly visit the official website for any corrigendum or addendum regarding the schedule.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

ITI Limited has announced a total of 215 Young Professional vacancies across multiple domains including Projects, Project Management, IS & IT, Computer Lab/Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, Production/Manufacturing, HR, Marketing, Finance and Hindi Cell. Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates wishing to apply for the Young Professional posts must ensure that they fulfil the required eligibility criteria in terms of educational qualification, relevant experience and age as prescribed by ITI Limited in the notification. Only Indian Nationals with qualifications from recognized universities/institutes (AICTE/UGC/other statutory authorities) are eligible to apply.

Educational Qualification

The educational qualifications for various Young Professional categories and domains are summarised below.

For YP – Graduate (Projects):
BE/B.Tech in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil or MCA/M.Sc. (Electronics/CS/IT) from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Technician (Projects):
Diploma in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Projects):

For YP – Technician (IS & IT):

ITI Trade Certificate in Electronics/Electronic Mechanic with minimum 2 years’ experience and VSSC Soldering School certification; or ITI Fitter with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience.

For YP – Graduate (TSTL):
BE/B.Tech in ECE/CS/Telecommunications or MCA/M.Sc.(CS/IT)/M.Sc. Cybersecurity from a recognised University/Institute with minimum 2–5 years post-qualification experience (depending on slot) and industry-recognised certifications in IT/Telecom Security Testing desirable.

Candidates applying for Young Professional posts must satisfy the prescribed upper age limits as on the date of advertisement, with relaxations for internal candidates as per ITI rules. Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Diploma Posts): First Class Diploma in relevant Engineering (3-year regular program, consistent First Class scores >65%).
  • Qualifications (Graduate Posts): First Class B.E / B.Tech in relevant Engineering branch (4-year regular degree program, consistent performance scores >65%).
  • Essential qualifications: Full-time course only. Minimum 65% aggregate marks from Class X onwards and in qualifying examination. Relaxed to 60% for SC/ST in qualifying exam.
  • Desirable: Specific desirable experiences mentioned for certain posts (e.g., experience in testing as per ASME/ISO standards, NI CLAD/CLD certification, FEA).
  • Experience: Minimum two years experience in the relevant field is essential.

Salary/Stipend

Selected personnel will be paid a consolidated remuneration with no other allowances (PF, HRA, CCA, etc. are not applicable).

Tenure Post 1st Year Remuneration 2nd Year Remuneration 3rd Year Remuneration
Associate Project Engineer (Graduate) Rs. 35,000/- per month Rs. 39,000/- per month Rs. 43,000/- per month

Event Date
Notification Date 20.11.2025
Applications Starting Date 26/11/2025

Selection Process

  • Method of Recruitment involves a Test and Interview.
  • Candidates must score a minimum of 30% marks in the Test to qualify for the interview.
  • The test will be a multiple-choice question type based on specific experience criteria, aptitude in relevant engineering discipline, and general aptitude (logical reasoning, numerical ability).
  • Candidates must produce all original documents for verification at the time of interview/written test; failure to do so results in disqualification.

General Information/Instructions

  • Positions are on a short-term tenure contract basis (1-year contract, extendable up to a maximum of 3 years). Tenure is co-terminus with the project.
  • Selected incumbents shall not have any preferential claims/rights for future regular employment.
  • Candidates must be Indian Nationals and willing to work anywhere in India on any shift duty.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/written examination.
  • Notice period of 3 months is applicable for resignation before contract completion or 3 months pay in lieu.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly visit the FCRI website for all updates/corrigendum regarding dates of Test/Interviews, as no other announcements will be made in newspapers.

How To Apply

  • Download the "Application Form" from the FCRI website, fill it up, and sign it.
  • Scan the completed Application Form (as a non-image PDF file) and all required enclosures (certificates for DOB, marks sheets, degree, caste, experience) into a SINGLE PDF file.
  • Email the application and enclosures to [email protected] with the correct subject line: "Assistant Project Engineer (Diploma)" or "Associate Project Engineer (Graduate)".
  • No physical copies of applications need to be sent.

MGU IIRBS Assistant Professor (Physics) 2025 Vacancy Details

The notification invites applications for 1 post of Assistant Professor on Contract in Physics at IIRBS, Mahatma Gandhi University for the academic year 2025–2026. The post is categorized as OC (Open Competition) and is purely on contract basis till the end of the current academic year.

Note: Reservation rotation is mentioned generally; this particular post is marked OC.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • Qualifications must be as per UGC norms for Assistant Professor in Physics (IIRBS).
  • Candidates are required to provide:
    – Degree and mark lists (UG & PG in relevant subject),
    – NET/UGC qualification proof (if applicable),
    – Ph.D. details where applicable,
    – Proof that journals are UGC-approved/peer-reviewed and impact factor details for published articles,
    – CGPA to percentage conversion proof if needed.
  • Degrees obtained from Universities/Institutions outside Kerala must be accompanied by equivalency/eligibility certificate from Mahatma Gandhi University.

2. Age Limit

  • As per UGC Regulations for appointment of Assistant Professors.
  • Maximum age limit: 70 years as on 01/01/2025, including retired teachers from Colleges/Universities.

3. Other Conditions

  • Reservation rotation is specified against vacancies; candidates applying under community/PH/EWS quota must attach valid certificates.
  • Natives of states other than Kerala are not eligible for posts notified exclusively under community reservation quota (not applicable to this OC post, but stated in general conditions).

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made based on scrutiny of:
    – Educational qualifications and UGC eligibility,
    – Teaching and research experience,
    – Publications and impact factor,
    – Other academic achievements as detailed in the proforma.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be considered as per Mahatma Gandhi University norms; detailed interview process is not described, but selected candidates must execute an agreement with the University.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the notification.

How To Apply

  • Download and fill the proforma (application form) attached with the notification for the post of Assistant Professor on Contract at IIRBS.
  • Scan and attach the following original documents:
    – Proof of age and date of birth,
    – Community and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (for community reservation, PH/EWS as applicable),
    – Educational qualification mark lists and degree certificates (UG, PG, Ph.D.),
    – Proof that journals are UGC-approved / peer-reviewed and impact factor details of published articles,
    – Experience certificates,
    – Awards and other additional qualifications,
    – Proof for CGPA to percentage conversion,
    – Equivalency/eligibility certificate for degrees from outside Kerala, if applicable.
  • Email the duly filled proforma and all necessary scanned documents to:
    [email protected]
  • The email subject must be labelled exactly as:
    “Application for the post of Assistant Professor on Contract(Physics) at IIRBS”
  • Applications must reach by email within 15 days from the date of this notification (24/12/2025).
  • Applications without scanned copies of certificates to prove age, community, creamy layer status, qualification, experience, CGPA conversion, impact factor, equivalency/eligibility etc. will be summarily rejected.

Important Dates

Event Date / Timeline
Notification Date 24/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 24/12/2025
Online Application End Date Within 15 days from 24/12/2025

  • UGC qualified candidates: Consolidated pay of ₹40,000 per month.
  • Non-UGC candidates: In the absence of UGC qualified candidates, non-UGC candidates will be considered with consolidated pay of ₹33,000 per month.
  • Remuneration is purely consolidated for the contract period of the academic year 2025–2026.

Instructions

  • The engagement is purely on contract basis for the current academic year, up to 15 April 2026.
  • Candidates under community reservation must attach Community and Non-Creamy Layer certificates; PH/EWS candidates must attach relevant certificates as per State Government criteria; SC/ST candidates need not submit Non-Creamy Layer Certificate.

  • Selected candidates must execute an agreement with Mahatma Gandhi University as per existing norms.
  • Applications lacking mandatory proofs (age, community, qualification, experience, CGPA conversion, impact factor, equivalency) will be rejected without notice.

Name of the Post Number of Post Category

Event Date

  • Do not send the online application printout or certificates by post.

ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 is 22 posts. The post-wise and category-wise vacancy distribution is as follows:

Eligibility Criteria for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

1. Super Specialist (Entry Level)

Essential Qualifications:

  • A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second Schedule or Part-II of the third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956
  • Holders of educational qualifications included in Part-II of the third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956)
  • MCh/DM/DNB or equivalent in the concerned Super specialty
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Entry Level: No specific experience mentioned

2. Super Specialist (Senior Consultant)

Essential Qualifications:

  • A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second Schedule or Part-II of the third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956
  • Holders of educational qualifications included in Part-II of the third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956)
  • MCh/DM/DNB or equivalent in the concerned Super specialty
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Candidates with at least five years post super specialty qualification experience will be considered for engagement as Consultant (Senior Level)

3. Specialist (Junior)

Essential Qualifications:

  • Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in concerned speciality after MBBS with TCMC registration
  • For Casualty/ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine and registered with Medical Council
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Three years experience in respective specialty for degree holders, OR
  • Five years experience in respective specialty for Diploma holders

4. Specialist (Senior)

Essential Qualifications:

  • Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma after MBBS with TCMC registration
  • For Casualty/ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine and registered with Medical Council
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Five years experience in respective specialty for degree holders, OR
  • Seven years experience in respective specialty for Diploma holders

5. Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

Essential Qualifications:

  • For Superspeciality departments: DM/DrNB in concerned superspeciality is preferred over MD/DNB in General Medicine
  • For Specialty departments: Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in concerned specialty after MBBS with TCMC registration is required
  • For ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine/Critical care medicine and registered with Medical Council is required
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • No specific experience mentioned for Senior Resident

Salary/Stipend for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

1. Super Specialist (Full Time)

  • Entry Level: Rs. 2,00,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Senior Level: Rs. 2,40,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Working Hours: 09:00 AM to 04:00 PM on weekdays and 09:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays
  • Contract Duration: One year or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Should attend emergency calls and visit as and when required
  • Remuneration revisable as per ESIC Headquarters instruction from time to time

2. Super Specialist (Part Time)

  • Entry Level: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 20,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 1,200/- for additional every hour, beyond 16 hours subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Consultant (Sr. Level): Rs. 1,50,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 20,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 1,500/- for every additional hour work beyond 16 hours (4 days × 4 hours) a week subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Working Hours: 4 hours session per day × four days in a week (16 hours)
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Remuneration revisable as per ESIC Headquarters instruction from time to time

3. Specialist (Full Time)

  • Junior Specialist (Level 11): Rs. 1,38,108/- per month (Approximate amount as per HQ instruction dated 08.12.2022)
  • Senior Specialist (Level 12): Rs. 1,60,752/- per month (Approximate amount as per HQ instruction dated 08.12.2022)
  • Working Hours: 09:00 AM to 04:00 PM on weekdays and 09:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Should attend emergency call as and when it is required
  • Remuneration Revisable as per ESIC HQ instruction from time to time

4. Specialist (Part Time)

  • Remuneration: Rs. 60,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 15,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 800/- for additional every hour beyond 16 hours, subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Working Hours: 4 hours session per day × four days in a week (16 hours)
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Remuneration Revisable as per ESIC HQ instruction from time to time

5. Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

  • Total Emoluments (Level 11 as per VIIth CPC): Approximately Rs. 1,38,108/- per month (For PG Degree holders)
  • An amount of Rs. 1,350/- will be deducted for SRs who possess only Diploma
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • To work as per ESIC norms for Senior Residency
  • Remuneration will be paid as per orders issued by ESIC Headquarters from time to time

Age Limit (as on 07/01/2026)

Super Specialist (Full Time/Part Time)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed
  • No minimum age specified

Specialist (Full Time/Part Time)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed
  • No minimum age specified

Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxation for SC, ST & OBC as per rules
  • No minimum age specified

Application Fee for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

Category Application Fee
General & OBC Candidates Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty only)
SC/ST Candidates Rs. 50/- (Rupees Fifty only)
PWD/Female Applicants Exempted (No Fee)

Mode of Payment:

  • Application fee to be paid by way of Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Employees' State Insurance Fund – Account No 1" payable at Kollam
  • The Demand Draft should be submitted at the time of interview along with application form

Selection Process for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

The selection process for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 will be based on the following criteria:

  • Walk-in Interview: The selection will be based on qualification, experience & interview
  • The interview will be conducted at ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam on 07/01/2026
  • Candidates will be assessed based on their educational qualifications, post-qualification experience, and performance in the personal interview
  • All original documents will be verified at the time of interview
  • Only shortlisted candidates based on qualification and experience will be called for final selection
  • The decision of the interview committee will be final and binding

General Information and Instructions for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

  • The applicants should bring along application in the prescribed proforma, all original documents including caste certificate (if applicable), one set of Xerox copies of all original documents, two recent passport size photographs (one affixed on the application) and the requisite application fee in the form of demand draft at the time of interview
  • Application forms, printing, or photocopying facilities will not be provided at the interview venue under any circumstances
  • Those who belong to OBC/SC/ST category should produce valid caste certificate issued by the Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer
  • OBC certificate should be in the prescribed form as per Government of India instructions which should certify that the candidates do not belong to Creamy layer
  • EWS certificate must be valid and issued by Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer in the prescribed form as per Government of India instructions
  • Candidates applying in PWD Category must possess disability certificate issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Government Hospitals/Institutions
  • Candidates who have already completed Senior Residency for 3 years in any Central Institutions are not eligible for the post of Senior Resident
  • Private practice of any kind will not be allowed except for Part time Superspecialists/Part time Specialists
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for Interview
  • Vacancies indicated may change as per actual requirement on the date of interview
  • Canvassing in any form shall be a disqualification
  • The Selected Specialist/Super Specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period of contractual engagement. The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a result of error and omissions committed by them while rendering professional services
  • The minimum sum assured per annum should be:
    • Rs. 30 lakh for Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeons, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc.
    • Rs. 20 lakhs for General Surgeons, Gynecologists, Obstetricians etc.
    • Rs. 10 lakhs for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc.
  • A copy of the Insurance & Premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to terminate the service of appointee at any time even before the tenure without assigning any reason by giving one month notice or immediately in case of any disciplinary action
  • Similarly, the engaged person will have to give one month prior notice before resigning or will have to pay an amount equivalent to one month's remuneration in lieu of the notice period
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the offer/advertisement without assigning any reason thereof
  • In case of selection, the candidate has to enter into an agreement with Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model & Super specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 200/-
  • The selected candidate has to submit a security deposit of Rs 15,000/- as DD in favour of ESIC Account No 2 payable at Kollam at the time of joining, which is refundable after successful completion of contract & production of no-due certificate
  • In case of applicants who are working in Central government/State government institutions, NOC should be obtained from the authority concerned and to be submitted in due course
  • Part time Engagement of one contractual employee in two ESIC hospital at the same time shall not be permissible
  • PWD candidate will be selected against suitable/notified posts as per government rules
  • The hospital is in the process of getting accreditation for conducting in house DNB training courses in various specialities

How to Apply for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

This is a Walk-in Interview process. Candidates need to follow these steps:

  • Step 1: Download the official notification from ESIC website: https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments
  • Step 2: Download the application form (Annexure 1) from the notification PDF
  • Step 3: Fill the application form completely in CAPITAL LETTERS ONLY with all required details:
    • Personal Information (Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Date of Birth, Category, Age)
    • Educational Qualification details with Year of passing, University, and Percentage of Marks
    • Experience details with Name of Hospital, Post Held, Period (From-To), Total Period
    • MCI Registration Number and Name of Medical Council
    • Present and Permanent Address
    • Contact Number & Email ID
    • Place where presently working
    • Particulars of DD (Number and Date)
  • Step 4: Affix one recent passport-size photograph on the application form
  • Step 5: Prepare Demand Draft for application fee:
    • Rs. 250/- for General/OBC candidates
    • Rs. 50/- for SC/ST candidates
    • PWD/Female candidates are exempted
    • DD should be drawn in favour of "Employees' State Insurance Fund – Account No 1" payable at Kollam
  • Step 6: Prepare all required documents in original and one set of self-attested Xerox copies:
    • MBBS Degree certificate
    • MCI/Central Council Registration Certificate (For basic and additional Qualifications)
    • Matriculation certificate in support of Date of Birth
    • PG Degree/Diploma Certificate (Qualification prescribed for the post)
    • Experience Certificate
    • Caste Certificate and Non creamy layer certificate, if applicable
    • PWD Certificate, if applicable
    • LPC/No Due Certificate from previous employer, if applicable
    • Any other relevant document
    • 2 Passport Size Photos
  • Step 7: Report to the interview venue on 07/01/2026 at 09:00 AM
  • Step 8: Registration will be done from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM at Conference Hall, ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam
  • Step 9: Submit the filled application form along with all original documents, one set of Xerox copies, two passport-size photographs, and Demand Draft at the registration counter
  • Step 10: Attend the interview as per the schedule

Important Notes:

  • Application forms, printing, or photocopying facilities will NOT be provided at the interview venue under any circumstances
  • Candidates must bring their own filled application form and all documents
  • Late arrivals after registration time may not be entertained
  • Check the official website regularly for any corrigenda or updates

  • Desirable: Higher qualifications can be mentioned in the application form.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years for Technical Assistant roles, and minimum of ITI certification or 2-3 years experience for Technician roles.

Salary/Stipend

Total Emoluments means approximate total emoluments on minimum of Pay Level inclusive of Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) etc. in Class 'Y' City.

  • Technical Assistant (Level-06): Rs. 35,400-1,12,400 (Total Emoluments approx. Rs. 66,500/- per month).
  • Technician (1) (Level-02): Rs. 19,900-63,200 (Total Emoluments approx. Rs. 37,000/- per month).

  • Age Relaxation: Up to 05 years for SC/ST, up to 03 years for OBC (NCL) candidates for reserved posts.

  • Those who qualify in the Trade Test will be invited for a competitive Written Examination.
  • The written exam is OMR Based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination (English and Hindi, except for English language questions).
  • The exam consists of Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 questions, 1 hour, no negative marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 25 questions each, 30 minutes, negative marking), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 100 questions for TA / 50 questions for Tech(1), 90/60 minutes respectively, negative marking).

  • After final submission, no changes will be permitted to the application form.
  • Candidates should retain a printout of the completed application form and payment details for their records, but should NOT send a hard copy initially.

  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.
