  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.

The primary objective of this project is the restoration and improvement of the Narmada river system's ecological health. This temporary and contractual role is crucial for data collection and analysis, and it demands the commitment of highly motivated candidates who are prepared for extensive field visits within the Narmada River Basin.

Successful candidates will receive a fellowship of INR 20,000 monthly plus HRA, with the initial appointment duration set for one year, subject to extension based on performance. Applicants must hold a relevant B.Tech., B.Sc., or M.Sc. degree in fields like Environmental Science or Civil Engineering, and must be proficient in both Hindi and English. Interested candidates are required to submit their applications online via the specified Google Form link by the deadline of December 27, 2025, to be considered for the online interviews scheduled for January 8, 2026.

Eligibility Criteria for CSL Workmen 2025

1. Educational Qualification

For Senior Ship Draftsman (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation):

  • Three year Diploma in relevant Engineering discipline from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum two years post qualification experience as Ship Draftsman or Draftsman in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Ship Design Company, Government or Semi-Government Company
  • Desirable: Experience in 3D modeling software like Tribon, CADMATIC or CAD software

For Junior Technical Assistant (Mechanical):

  • Three year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in installation and commissioning of mechanical systems in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Government or Semi-Government Company
  • Desirable: Experience in HVAC, Fire Fighting System, Cranes, Air Compressors, Pumps, Piping systems

For Junior Technical Assistant (Electrical):

  • Three year Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in installation and commissioning of electrical systems
  • Desirable: Experience in PLC/SCADA/DCS Systems, HT/LT switchgear panels, power management systems

For Junior Technical Assistant (Electronics):

  • Three year Diploma in Electronics Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in installation and commissioning of control systems and electronic systems
  • Desirable: Experience in electronics systems manufacturing, microprocessor based embedded systems, wireless communication systems

For Junior Technical Assistant (Civil):

  • Three year Diploma in Civil Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in civil construction, maintenance of infrastructure projects, and must be computer savvy

For Junior Technical Assistant (Instrumentation):

  • Three year Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in Instrumentation works in Shipyard or Engineering Company and must be computer savvy

For Laboratory Assistant (Mechanical):

  • Essential: Three year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Metallurgical Engineering with minimum 60% marks
  • Desirable: Radiographer Certificate Level-1 from BARC or PCN/ISNT/ASNT Level II qualification in four NDT methods
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in Testing Laboratory or Quality Control activities

For Laboratory Assistant (Chemical):

  • Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc) in Chemistry from recognized University with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in Metal/Water/Oil/Fuel/Paint testing Lab preferably NABL Accredited
  • Desirable: Experience in handling instruments like Optical Emission Spectrometer, Mass Spectrometer, Gas Chromatograph

For Storekeeper:

  • Graduate with Post Graduate Diploma in Materials Management OR Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical or Electrical)
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in storekeeping in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Government or Semi-Government Company
  • Desirable: Exposure in materials management and ERP packages

For Assistant:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Arts (other than Fine Arts/Performing Arts) or Science or Commerce or Computer Applications or Business Administration with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in office work, ERP system, data entry, record maintenance in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Commercial Organization, Government or Semi-Government Company
  • Desirable: Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Tally, SAP

Important Note: Applicants with higher qualifications like B.Tech, M.Sc etc. without prescribed diploma qualification shall not be considered.

Age Limit for CSL Workmen 2025

The age limit for CSL Workmen Category Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 12/01/2026 (Candidates should be born on or after 13/01/1991)
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years for reserved posts
  • Age Relaxation for SC: 5 years for reserved posts
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (Storekeeper & Assistant posts): As per Government of India guidelines (Maximum age after all relaxations: 45 years for UR, 48 years for OBC, 50 years for SC)
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-servicemen: As per Government of India guidelines (Maximum 45 years after relaxation)

Other Benefits:

  • New Pension Scheme
  • Contributory Provident Fund
  • Gratuity
  • Accident Insurance Coverage
  • Medical Assistance Scheme

Selection Process for CSL Workmen 2025

For Senior Ship Draftsman Posts:

  • Phase I: Objective Type Online Test - 70 marks (75 minutes duration)
  • Phase II: Practical Test in CAD - 30 marks
  • Total Marks: 100 marks
  • Minimum Pass Marks: 50% for UR/EWS, 45% for OBC, 40% for SC (in each phase separately)

For Junior Technical Assistant, Laboratory Assistant, Storekeeper & Assistant Posts:

  • Part 1: Objective Type Online Test - 70 marks (75 minutes duration)

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates wishing to apply for the Young Professional posts must ensure that they fulfil the required eligibility criteria in terms of educational qualification, relevant experience and age as prescribed by ITI Limited in the notification. Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

1. Screening & Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on the details furnished in the NATS portal such as educational qualification, marks, year of passing, and domicile criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for certificate verification, where original documents for age, qualification, percentage of marks, caste, disability etc. along with self-attested copies must be produced; failure to produce originals results in rejection.

NMPA Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

One post of Chief Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay of Rs. 100000-260000 in New Mangalore Port Authority will be vacant with effect from June 1, 2026. The post is to be filled by absorption through a composite method from officers of Major Ports.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Essential):
    • Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
    • Fifteen years experience in executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking.
  • For absorption through composite method: Officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department in a Major Port Trust shall be eligible. The feeder post is Deputy Chief Engineer in the pay scale of Rs.80000-220000/-.

Salary/Stipend

  • Initial Scale of Pay: Rs. 100000-260000.
  • Note: The pay scale will be upgraded to the scale of pay of Rs.120000-280000/- after completion of three years regular service in the post, subject to fulfilling relevant conditions.

Age Limit (as on 01 June 2026)

  • There is 45 upper age limit specified for candidates applying via the absorption through composite method.
  • The crucial date for eligibility criteria will be the date of arising of the vacancy, i.e., June 1, 2026.

Selection Process

  • The selection is by merit, for which the benchmark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports/APARs will not be below "Very Good" for the last five years (2020-2021 to 2024-2025).
  • Selection is made by the Services Selection Committee.
  • Port officials who withdraw their candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Ports for a period of two years.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only applications submitted through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) shall be accepted.
  • No application other than those submitted through OAP shall be accepted.
  • The administrative Ports are required to forward the hard copy applications with required documents (certified APARs, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance, NOC, etc.) to NMPA by January 30, 2026.
  • Incomplete applications or those received after the due date will not be considered.

How To Apply

  • Register and apply online through the 'online Application Portal' (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at `https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in` between December 16, 2025, and January 15, 2026.
  • Take a print-out of the online application form uploaded in OAP.
  • The print-out should be signed and sent through the proper channel (via the administrative Port Authority Secretary/Chairperson) along with certified copies of educational qualifications, experience, PPOs, and attested APARs for the last 5 years.
  • The envelope containing the hard copy must be superscribed "Application for the post of Chief Engineer (Civil) in New Mangalore Port Authority".
  • The hard copy must reach The Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010 before January 30, 2026.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Common Age Limits:
    • Senior Project Associate (Sr. PAT): Maximum 40 years (as on 31.12.2025).
    • Project Associate-I / II (PAT-I / PAT-II): Maximum 35 years (as on 31.12.2025).
    • Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women, 3 years for OBC as per Govt. of India instructions.
  • Emoluments (per month, consolidated):
    • Senior Project Associate (Sr. PAT): Rs. 42,000/- + HRA.
    • Project Associate-I (PAT-I):
      • Rs. 31,000/- + HRA to scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET (incl. Lectureship/Assistant Professorship)/GATE or national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments/Agencies/Institutions.
      • Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.
    • Project Associate-II (PAT-II):
      • Rs. 35,000/- + HRA to scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET (incl. Lectureship/Assistant Professorship)/GATE or national-level examinations as above.
      • Rs. 28,000/- + HRA for others.
  • Post Code: PAT I/II/07/2025/01 – Project Associate I or II (MMP055202)
    • Essential Qualification – PAT-I:
      • Master’s degree in Physics / Atmospheric Science / Oceanography / Meteorology / Climate Science / Marine Science or equivalent from a recognized university.
    • Essential Qualification – PAT-II:
      • Master’s degree in Physics / Atmospheric Science / Oceanography / Meteorology / Climate Science / Geoinformatics / GIS / RS / Marine Science or equivalent from a recognized university, and
      • 2 years research experience in relevant area in recognized R&D/industrial/academic/S&T organization.
    • OR M.E./M.Tech. in Atmospheric Science / Meteorology / Climate Science or equivalent from a recognized university.
    • Desirable:
      • Experience with Unix/Linux OS.
      • Working knowledge of GrADS, Ferret, MATLAB, GIS.
      • Programming skills in FORTRAN, C++, Python, R, NCL, Shell scripting.
      • Experience handling multi-source, multi-format hydro-meteorological data and NWP model simulation.
      • Experience with AI/ML tools for data analytics; NET/GATE qualification.
    • Job Description:
      • Analysis of hydro-meteorological data, NWP model simulations and AI/ML-based data analytics, working in a team environment.
  • Post Code: Sr. PAT/07/2025/02 – Senior Project Associate (GAP001033)
    • Essential Qualification (any one):
      • Master’s Degree in Physics / Atmospheric Sciences / Mathematics / Computer (Information) Sciences or equivalent from a recognized university and 3 years’ R&D experience in Industrial/Academic/Science & Technology organizations.
      • OR Doctoral degree in Physics / Atmospheric Sciences / Remote Sensing / Computer Sciences or equivalent from a recognized university.
      • OR Masters / Integrated Masters in Engineering with specialization in Computer (Information) Science / Atmospheric Sciences or equivalent from a recognized university.
    • Desirable:
      • Good programming skills in advanced Python and R.
      • Experience in Machine Learning and Deep Learning tools for predictive data analytics.
    • Job Description:
      • Development of dynamic prediction models, AI/ML-based predictive modelling and data modelling.
  • Post Code: PAT I/07/2025/03 – Project Associate-I (GAP001033)
    • Essential Qualification:
      • Master’s Degree in Physics / Mathematics / Statistics / Environmental Sciences / Atmospheric Sciences or equivalent from a recognized university.
      • OR Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with specialization in Environmental Science / Remote Sensing or equivalent from a recognized university.
    • Desirable:
      • Working experience in Linux, Python Programming, R Programming.
      • Experience in mathematical modelling.
    • Job Description:
      • Multi-scale data analytics and development of Machine/Deep Learning models.
  • Post Code: PAT I/II/07/2025/04 – Project Associate I or II (MMP015203)
    • Essential Qualification – PAT-I:
      • B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in any of the following areas (or equivalent):
        • Robotics / Mechatronics
        • Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
        • AI / ML / Data Science (DS)
        • Mechanical Engineering
    • Essential Qualification – PAT-II (any one):
      • B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in above areas with 2 years’ experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities/services.
      • OR M.E./M.Tech./Integrated M.Tech. in the above areas.
    • Desirable:
      • Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with ML libraries (e.g. PyTorch).
      • Hands-on experience with sensor-based data sources (LiDAR, camera, stereo etc.) on autonomous vehicles/ADAS.
      • Familiarity with Reinforcement Learning and Computer Vision techniques; knowledge of simulators like CARLA.
      • Experience in setting up and analysing experiments for ML/RL; familiarity with version control (Git).
      • At least one peer-reviewed publication in AI/ML/CV/NLP; CSIR-UGC NET (including Lectureship) / GATE qualified; MS (by Research)/BS & MS (Dual Degree) desirable.
    • Job Description:
      • Running experiments in RL simulators and real vehicles, benchmarking, dataset generation.
      • Field work for data collection on autonomous vehicle platforms.
      • Writing reports, presentations, documentation, research articles and any other project-assigned work.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Project Associate (Sr. PAT): Rs. 42,000/- per month + HRA (consolidated as per project rules).
  • Project Associate-II (PAT-II):
    • Rs. 35,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE or equivalent national-level exam qualified candidates.
    • Rs. 28,000/- + HRA for others.
  • Project Associate-I (PAT-I):
    • Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE or equivalent qualified candidates.
    • Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.
  • All emoluments are purely project-based, temporary and without any claim to regular CSIR/CSIR-4PI posts.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Senior Project Associate (Sr. PAT): Maximum 40 years.
  • Project Associate-I / Project Associate-II: Maximum 35 years.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit: 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 3 years for OBC candidates, or as per Govt. of India instructions.

Application Fee

  • The advertisement does not specify any application fee for these project staff positions.

Important Dates

Advertisement Date 17 December 2025
Last Date for Receipt of Online Applications 31 December 2025
Cut-off Date for Eligibility (Qualification, Age, etc.) 31 December 2025

Selection Process

  • Engagement is purely temporary and contract-based, initially for one year and co-terminus with the project; extendable based on project tenure and performance.
  • Selection will be based on screening of applications followed by personal interview.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications; only shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview through online mode.
  • Interview details (date, mode, link) will be intimated by email to shortlisted candidates.
  • A written test may be conducted if necessary, depending on the number and suitability of applicants.
  • CSIR-4PI reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of posts, downgrade positions to suitable level if no eligible candidates are found, and draw a panel of selected candidates valid for one year for similar project requirements.
  • Performance of project staff will be reviewed every six months; unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for these positions.
  • Engagement of project staff is as per CSIR guidelines / funding agency guidelines; no implicit or explicit claim for absorption or regular CSIR/CSIR-4PI posts.
  • Applications with incomplete information, received after the last date, submitted through modes other than email, or containing multiple post codes in a single form will be rejected.
  • Result awaited candidates are not eligible for interview.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • CSIR-4PI reserves the right to relax any provisions in this advertisement on reasonable grounds and to reject any or all applications without assigning reasons.
  • Selected candidates must produce all original certificates (educational, experience, ID proof, etc.) at the time of joining; discrepancies may lead to cancellation.
  • Currently employed candidates must provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of joining/interview, as applicable.

How to Apply

  • Download the prescribed application proforma from the CSIR-4PI website (www.csir4pi.res.in).
  • Carefully fill all columns of the application form, indicating clearly the post and post code being applied for (separate application for each position, if applying for more than one post code).
  • Affix one passport size photograph on the application.
  • Scan the completely filled application form into a single PDF file.
  • Attach scanned copies of:
    • Govt-issued Photo ID proof.
    • SSLC/Class-10 certificate (Date of Birth proof).
    • All semester mark sheets and degree/provisional/convocation certificates for required qualifications.
    • Experience certificates (if applicable).
  • Email the application PDF and supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 31 December 2025.
  • The email subject line must be exactly: “Application for the position of …… (Post Code ………………..)”.
  • Candidates must apply separately for each post code; combined applications for multiple posts will not be considered.
  • CGPA/SGPA/OGPA grades should be converted to percentage using the formula prescribed by the respective university/institute.

NABARD Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Discipline/Post Name Total Vacancies Location
Climate Action & Sustainability 3 Mumbai (1), Lucknow (1), Shimla (1)

Project Monitoring 4 Mumbai (1), Chennai (2), Chandigarh (1)

UI/UX Designing 1 Mumbai (1)
Software Testing 1 Mumbai (1)
Total 44

Note: A candidate shall be permitted to apply only for one discipline/location. Multiple applications under the same/different disciplines shall lead to cancellation of candidature.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science/Climate Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Economics: Post Graduate Degree in Economics/Applied Economics/Financial Economics/Statistics/Data Science/Finance/Public Policy with minimum 55% marks
  • Data Science: B.E./B.Tech in Information Technology/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication/Artificial Intelligence & Data Science with minimum 60% marks
  • Cyber Security: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Electronics and Communications Engineering with minimum 60% marks OR Postgraduate degree with minimum 55% marks
  • Academic Administration: Bachelor's degree in Education/Business Administration/Computer Science/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Master's degree in Education (M.Ed.)/Educational Management/HRD/MBA (HR)/PGDM-HR with minimum 55% marks
  • Graphic Designing: Bachelor's degree in Digital Media/Multimedia/Graphic Design with minimum 60% marks
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Post graduate degree in Mass Media/Development Communication/Visual Communication/Journalism with minimum 55% marks
  • Information Technology: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Computer Applications/Information Technology with minimum 55% marks
  • Geoinformatics: Post graduate degree in Geoinformatics/Geography/Remote Sensing/Environmental Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Development Management: Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate degree in Social Work/Rural Development/Rural Management/Development Studies/Development Management/Development Administration/Project Management/Business Management with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Project Monitoring: Bachelor's Degree or Post Graduate Degree in Agriculture/Soil Science/Agronomy/Horticulture/Land/Water resources with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Finance: BBA (Finance/Banking)/BMS (Finance/Banking) with 60% marks OR Two years full time PGDM (Finance)/Full time MBA (Finance)/MMS (Finance) with minimum 55% marks OR Bachelor of Financial and Investment Analysis with 60% marks OR Bachelor's degree with Membership of ICAI obtained on or before 01-11-2025
  • UI/UX Designing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Software Testing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation

Essential Qualifications

  • Required educational qualification must be possessed as on 01-11-2025
  • Result of final term/semester/year examination must have been declared on or before 01-11-2025
  • Candidates whose final year/semester results declared after 01-11-2025 are not eligible
  • All degrees must be from recognized University/Institution
  • Minimum percentage as specified for each discipline is mandatory

Desirable

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Certifications in climate change management, sustainable development, or environmental policy
  • Economics: Working knowledge of Visualisation tools (Tableau & Power BI), advanced quantitative and econometrics skills, knowledge of Stata/R, Excel
  • Academic Administration: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in learning and development, Certification in Instructional Design, LMS, ICT in Education
  • Graphic Designing: Certifications in E-Learning tools, Adobe Certified Professional, UX Design, LMS, Articulate or Captivate certifications, SCORM/xAPI training
  • Information Technology: Proficiency in Programming languages (Python, Java), knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, familiarity with web hosting, APIs, wireframing tools like Figma
  • Geoinformatics: Certification in GIS tools like QGIS or ArcGIS
  • UI/UX Designing: Relevant certification in UI/UX design/development

Experience (Mandatory)

  • All Disciplines: Prior relevant experience of minimum 1 year in reputed organizations
  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Minimum 1 year in climate change mitigation, adaptation, or sustainability
  • Economics: Minimum 1 year in forecasting, financial modeling, preparation of impact balance sheets, exposure to domestic and international databases
  • Data Science: Minimum 1 year, preference for projects involving banking technologies
  • Cyber Security: Minimum 1 year in Information and Cyber security domain (preferably having worked in SOC)
  • Academic Administration: Minimum 1 year in training, instructional design, learning experience design & learning and development
  • Graphic Designing: Minimum 1 year in Graphic design, animation, e-learning tools, LMS, Adobe Creative Suite
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Minimum 1 year in developmental filmmaking/social work outreach
  • Information Technology: Minimum 1 year with experience in creating BRD or FSD, analyzing processes and designing workflows
  • UI/UX Designing: Minimum 1 year as UI/UX designer and developer
  • Software Testing: Minimum 1 year in reputed organization

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹70,000/- (All Inclusive)
  • Income tax or any other tax liable will be deducted at source as per applicable rules before effecting payment
  • The stipend is paid during the entire engagement period including training
  • Young Professionals engaged on purely contractual basis

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Candidate must be an Indian citizen
  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 01-11-1995 and not later than 01-11-2004
  • No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Application Fee

  • Application Fee cum Intimation Charges: ₹150/- (exclusive of applicable GST)
  • Application Fee is Non-Refundable
  • Application Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances
  • Bank Transaction charges for Online Payment will have to be borne by the candidate
  • Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 26th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 26th December 2025
Last Date for Online Application 12th January 2026
Payment of Application Fee/Intimation Charges 26th December 2025 to 12th January 2026
Qualification & Experience Date As on 01-11-2025
Age Calculation Date As on 01-11-2025

Note: NABARD reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Application Screening
    • Applications received from interested eligible candidates shall be placed before the Screening Committee
    • Screening for interview based on matrix of identified indicators like academic performance, relevance of work experience, overall profile, statement of intent
  • Step 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted applications shall be placed before Young Professional Selection Committee (YPSC)
    • Final selection based on combined marks in Presentation and Interview conducted by YPSC
    • Interview will be conducted at respective NABARD Regional Offices of the States against which vacancies have been announced
  • Medical Fitness: Final appointment subject to being declared medically fit by Medical Officer(s) appointed/approved by the Bank
  • Document Verification: NABARD shall verify eligibility at stage of interview/joining
  • Final Decision: Final appointment based on decision of Selection Committee constituted for the purpose
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria shall not vest any right to candidate for being called for interviews
  • Decision of NABARD shall be final in all matters
  • Travel for Interview: Candidates may be reimbursed to and fro 2AC rail fare for shortest route for attending interviews

General Information/Instructions

Program Duration

  • Duration of engagement is 1 (one) year, extendable upto maximum three years
  • Extension depends on performance of Young Professional and organizational requirements

Legal Status

  • Young Professionals selected on short-term contract basis
  • Shall not be considered as "staff member" or "official" of NABARD
  • Engagement shall not establish relationship of employee and employer between NABARD and Young Professional
  • No right/claim for placement in NABARD by virtue of engagement under Young Professional Program
  • Appointed on full-time basis and shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement period

Leave Facility

  • Young Professionals entitled to maximum 30 days leave in a calendar year during engagement period
  • Leave provided on proportionate basis

Medical Facility

  • Medical facility available for self only at NABARD Dispensary

Office Facilities

  • Lounge facility, Tea/Coffee provided as per entitlement of officers of the bank
  • NABARD will provide Office Space, Internet Connectivity, and other support facilities

Conduct, Discipline and Confidentiality

  • Services governed by code of conduct as prescribed by NABARD
  • Internal data must be kept confidential
  • NABARD entitled to all intellectual property rights including patent, copyright, trademark developed during engagement
  • Must furnish undertaking for maintenance of secrecy before commencement
  • Subject to provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
  • Shall not use name, letterhead, emblem or official seal of NABARD without prior permission

Termination

  • NABARD can terminate contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
  • In normal course, NABARD may terminate engagement by giving one month's notice in advance
  • Young Professional can also seek termination by giving one month's notice
  • If notice period not served, Young Professional required to pay sum equivalent to one month's pay
  • Unauthorized absence of more than 8 days (not including public holidays and weekends) without valid explanation can lead to termination

Travel and Official Benefits

  • For official domestic travel, eligible for halting, boarding and incidental allowances same as Grade A officer of NABARD
  • In event of death, injury or illness during engagement, neither Young Professional nor dependents entitled to any compensation or employment
  • Young Professionals solely responsible for maintaining adequate insurance (life, health) at own expense

Mentorship and Review

  • Each Young Professional attached to mentor/supervising officer who acts as Project Guide
  • Mentor responsible for regularly overseeing progress
  • Assessment done jointly by Officer in Charge of Department/RO/TE and supervising officer
  • Letter of Experience/Recommendation given at end of engagement period

Application Guidelines

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens
  • Candidates should check eligibility carefully before applying
  • Applications accepted through ONLINE mode only on www.nabard.org
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Should not suppress any material information
  • If found guilty of misconduct/unfair means, liable to disqualification/debarment/termination
  • Bank reserves right to increase/decrease/modify/cancel any provisions of vacancy/recruitment process
  • No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible and non-selected candidates
  • Bank's decision shall be final and binding on all matters

For Government/PSU Employees

  • Applicants serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Nationalized Banks required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from employer at time of interview
  • Before appointment, proper relieving letter indicating date of relief and no dues pending must be produced

Legal Jurisdiction

  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai
  • Courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only shall have sole & exclusive jurisdiction

Communication

  • Notice/communication displayed on Bank's website or sent by Registered/Speed Post or email shall be deemed sufficient
  • Check www.nabard.org regularly for updates
  • Any corrigendum or announcements published only on Bank's website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit NABARD website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Under Career Notices, click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • Step 3: Choose "Click here for New Registration" tab
  • Step 4: Enter Name, Contact details and Email-id
  • Step 5: System will generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Step 6: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (will also be sent via Email & SMS)
  • Step 7: Before starting, prepare scanned documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 200x230 pixels
    • Signature (with black ink) - 10kb-20kb, jpg format, 140x60 pixels
    • Left thumb impression (on white paper with black/blue ink) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 240x240 pixels
    • Hand written declaration (on white paper with black ink) - 50kb-100kb, jpg format, 800x400 pixels
    • Latest CV/Resume in PDF format - 500KB
  • Step 8: Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Step 9: Use "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to save data and continue later if needed
  • Step 10: Carefully fill and verify all details in online application
  • Step 11: Upload Photo & Signature as per specifications
  • Step 12: Fill other details of Application Form
  • Step 13: Click on Preview Tab to verify entire application
  • Step 14: Modify details if required
  • Step 15: Click 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' only after verifying all details are correct
  • Step 16: Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment
  • Step 17: Pay application fee of ₹150/- (plus GST) using Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets
  • Step 18: Wait for intimation from server after payment - DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH
  • Step 19: On successful payment, e-Receipt will be generated
  • Step 20: Click 'Submit' button to complete application
  • Step 21: Take printout of e-Receipt and online Application Form for future reference

Important Points for Online Application

  • Apply only for ONE discipline/location - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted
  • Application will be rejected if only photo uploaded without signature
  • Left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged
  • Hand written declaration must be in candidate's handwriting and in English only
  • Keep valid personal email ID and mobile number active till completion of recruitment
  • Name should be spelt correctly as in Certificates/Mark sheets/Identity proof
  • No change possible after clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' button
  • Photo must be uploaded at place of photo and signature at place of signature
  • If photo not uploaded properly, admission for examination will be rejected/denied
  • For any problem, use "Candidate Grievance Lodging and Redressal Mechanism" at https://cgrs.ibps.in/
  • Mention "NABARD – Recruitment of Young Professionals" in subject of email

Action Against Candidates Found Guilty

  • Do not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Using unfair means will lead to disqualification
  • Impersonating or procuring impersonation will lead to criminal prosecution
  • Misbehaving in examination/interview hall will lead to disqualification
  • Carrying mobile phones or electronic devices in examination/interview hall not allowed
  • May be debarred permanently or for specified period from any examination conducted by bank
  • If already joined, services may be terminated

Eligibility Criteria

  • Assistant Professor (Forensic Sciences): Ph.D. in relevant discipline; first class in preceding degree i.e. M.Sc. in Forensic Sciences or equivalent with specialization in Forensic Biology/Biotechnology/Genetics/Molecular Biology/Forensic Anthropology/Criminology; additional requirement of a minimum of two publications in renowned journals of repute.
  • Assistant Professor (Computer Science/Cyber Security/Digital Forensics): Ph.D. in relevant discipline; first class in preceding degree i.e. ME/M.Tech with specialization in Computer Science & Engineering/Cyber Security/Information Security/Network Technology/Information Technology/Quantum Security/Blockchain/Hardware Security; minimum of two publications in renowned journals of repute and certifications in Ethical Hacking or Cyber Security.

Salary/Stipend

  • Assistant Professor (when NET not conducted in desired subject, with Master’s degree and very good academic record): Consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 68,000/- per month.

Selection Process

  • The application received in response to the advertisement will be scrutinized and only shortlisted candidates will be considered for the further selection process.

  • Mode of selection includes personal interview and, if conducted, screening test; candidates who appeared for interview may be considered for a lower post if otherwise suitable.

General Information/Instructions

  • The filling up of the advertised posts shall be on need basis and purely temporary; engagement does not confer any right or title to claim permanent appointment at the University.

  • The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all the posts without assigning any reason and to accept or reject any application.
  • The University shall verify antecedents and documents submitted by candidates at the time of appointment; if documents are found fake or information suppressed, services are liable to be terminated.
  • NFSU Dharwad Campus reserves the right to offer the post at a level lower than advertised, draw reserve panels, consider candidates in-absentia, relax qualifications/experience, or increase/decrease number of posts.
  • The interview will be conducted in offline mode only; online interview requests will not be entertained and no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
  • These recruitments shall be made in compliance with the Reservation Policy of the Government of India and upper age limit will be reckoned as on last date of application.
  • Qualifications must be obtained from UGC recognized universities/deemed universities or RCI/BCI/PCI/AICTE approved autonomous institutions and should be equivalent to AIU-recognized courses where applicable.
  • Papers published only in UGC Care approved list, SCOPUS, Thomson Reuter, Emerald, ABDC or other internationally renowned journals will be considered.
  • Candidate will be required to produce all original documents relating to educational qualifications, experience and other essential requirements at the time of interview, failing which candidature stands cancelled.

How to Apply

  • All candidates are required to fill the application form available on university website (https://nfsu.ac.in/career).
  • Apply through the given online link and upload the filled application form along with other required documents in a single PDF file before the last date of application.
  • The incomplete application form will not be entertained; hard copy of the application form with other documents will be required to be submitted at the time of interview.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post should pay the application fee separately and submit separate applications for each post, otherwise the application will be summarily rejected.
  • The candidates will be shortlisted for interviews based on the eligibility criteria and information will be placed on the university website and forwarded to candidates’ registered email.
  • All communication to eligible candidates will be by email only; for queries, candidates may contact NFSU Dharwad Campus authorities via email at [email protected].

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Under graduation (Regular – Full time) in any discipline from a University / Institution recognized by AICTE / DOTE / UGC. The candidates should have appeared for the examination, passed and received the degree certificate in any of the years from July 2021 to 2025.
  • Essential qualifications: Candidates must have passed their Graduation not earlier than 01.07.2021. Candidate with 100% complete profile on the Apprenticeship portal only are eligible to apply.
  • Experience: The candidate possesses one year or more of work experience in any Government, Government Undertaking, or Private Organization as on 01.12.2025. (Not eligible if have experience)

Salary/Stipend

  • A monthly stipend of Rs. 9,000/- shall be paid to the apprentice during the period of apprenticeship training. The Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances/ benefits.
  • United India Insurance Company will make a payment of 4,500/- into the apprentices account on a monthly basis.
  • Government share of Stipend of Rs. 4500 will be directly credited to the Apprentices Bank account through DBT mode as per extant guidelines.
  • The stipend shall be paid to Apprentices each month after adjusting Loss of pay, If any.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age—21 years
  • Maximum Age -28 years
  • [i.e. candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.12.1997 and not later than 01.12.2004 (both days inclusive)]
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates.

Important Dates

Activity Date
Online Application Starting Date 18.12.2025
Last date for applying “UNITED INDIA INSURANCE CO. LTD” 20.01.2026
Physical appearance for verification of documents of shortlisted candidates at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd Call letter will be sent through Registered Email ID

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish the details while filling in application.
  • Company reserves right to reject ineligible candidate's applications at any stage of the selection process.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

A6. No, there is no negative marking in the Computer Based Test; all 100 questions are objective type with 1 mark each.

Q7. Can I edit my IOCL Non-Executive application form after submission?
A7. No, once the final online application is submitted and registration is completed, no change or correction is permitted; candidates must verify details carefully before final submission.

Q8. What is the salary of IOCL Non-Executive posts?
A8. Selected Non-Executive personnel are placed in the pay scale of Rs. 25,000–1,05,000/- with industrial DA and are eligible for HRA/housing, medical facilities, performance incentives, PF, gratuity, LTC, education allowance and other benefits as per IOCL rules.

Q9. Is any specific score like GATE required for this recruitment?
A9. No, the IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025 notification does not prescribe GATE or any external score; selection is based on IOCL’s own CBT followed by SPPT and medical fitness.

Q10. Where will the IOCL Non-Executive examination be conducted?
A10. The CBT will be conducted at multiple test cities across India such as Visakhapatnam, Guwahati, Vadodara, Delhi/NCR, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata and others listed in Annexure II of the notification.

  • Step 4: Click on "Apply now" and then "Skip"
  • Step 5: Fill "Personal Details" carefully (fields with red asterisk * are mandatory)
  • Step 6: Fill "Educational Details"

  • Step 10: Verify all details and click "Confirm Application" (No changes allowed after confirmation)
  • Step 11: Download and print the Application Form and Fee Receipt

Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics) Level 7 01
Junior Scientific Officer (DNA Forensics) Level 7 01
Senior Scientific Assistant (Multimedia Forensics) Level 6 01
Laboratory Assistant Level 5 24#

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior Scientific Officer (both Centres): Not more than 40 years of age; Ph.D. in relevant discipline OR Master’s degree in Forensic Psychology/Psychology/Criminology/Neuropsychology/Clinical/Investigative Psychology or other Psychology discipline; Ph.D. holders need minimum 2 years’ experience, Master’s degree holders need minimum 5 years’ analysis/research experience in eligible government/research/forensic/industry organizations; desirable experience in polygraph, BEOS, SDS, Eye Detect & LVA.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Centre for Happiness and Wellbeing): Not more than 35 years; Master’s in Psychology/Criminology/Neuropsychology/Forensic/Clinical/Investigative Psychology or any Psychology/Forensic Psychology discipline or Master’s in Forensic Science with specialization in Psychology/Criminology; 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant fields in government/research/forensic labs or industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research experience; desirable Ph.D. and experience in polygraph, BEOS, SDS, Eye Detect & LVA.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics): Not more than 35 years; BE/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/IT/Electronics/EEE/Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security) OR Master’s in Computer Science/IT/Electronics/Physics/Forensic Science (with physical sciences)/Cyber Forensics/Digital Forensics/Information Security/Cyber Security/Multimedia Forensics/ICT/AI/Data Science/Cyber Security Management; 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant field in forensic labs/recognised institutes/industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research; desirable Ph.D., familiarity with forensic audio-video tools and FSL experience.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (DNA Forensics): Not more than 35 years; Master’s in Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Genetics/Human Genetics/Molecular Biology/Life/Biological Sciences/Forensic Biotechnology/Forensic Science (Biology/Biotechnology) OR BE/B.Tech in Biotechnology; 3 years’ analytical/research experience in relevant field in government/recognised labs/research institutes/industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research; desirable Ph.D., knowledge of forensic DNA technology and FSL experience.
  • Senior Scientific Assistant (Multimedia Forensics): Not more than 30 years; BE/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/IT/Electronics/EEE/Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security) OR same set of relevant Master’s degrees as JSO (Multimedia Forensics) with Forensic Science (physical sciences) eligibility; desirable experience with forensic audio-video tools and FSL work.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Age between 18 and 27 years (relaxable for Govt. servants up to 40 years); Bachelor’s Degree in any one of Physics, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Physical Anthropology, Genetics, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pharmacy, Forensic Science or Criminology from a recognised University/Institute.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Scientific Officer posts are in Pay Level 10 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with corresponding monthly pay and allowances as per NFSU/GoI rules.
  • Junior Scientific Officer posts are in Pay Level 7; Senior Scientific Assistant in Pay Level 6; Laboratory Assistant in Pay Level 5, all with pay and allowances as applicable to NFSU technical staff.
  • All posts are regular direct recruitment positions with probation and service conditions as per University norms.

Age Limit (as on 18-01-2026)

  • The date for determining eligibility including age shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of online application i.e. 18/01/2026.
  • Upper age: 40 years for Senior Scientific Officer; 35 years for all Junior Scientific Officer posts; 30 years for Senior Scientific Assistant; 18–27 years for Laboratory Assistant with relaxation for Government servants up to 40 years.
  • Upper age limit relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/Disabled/Ex-servicemen as per Government of India rules; current employees of Central/State/UT Government/University/Board/Corporation are exempt from the specified upper age limit for some posts as mentioned.

Application Fee

  • Gen/EWS/OBC category applicants: Rs. 500/- plus GST and applicable transaction charges; application fee is non-refundable.
  • SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.
  • Separate online applications with separate fees must be submitted for each post applied.

Selection Process

  • Selection for Senior Scientific Officer posts (Sr. No. 1 and 2) will be based on overall record and performance in interview; University may conduct a screening test and/or apply higher qualification/experience norms to shortlist candidates.
  • Selection for Junior Scientific Officer, Senior Scientific Assistant and Laboratory Assistant posts (Sr. No. 3 to 7) will be based on merit of marks obtained in written test; University may conduct a screening test and/or shortlist based on experience.
  • Call letters for screening test/written test/interview will be sent only to shortlisted candidates via email/Samarth portal; interviews will be conducted only in physical mode.
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD will be as per Government of India norms, including latest requirements for OBC-NCL (non-creamy layer) and EWS certificates issued on/after 01-04-2025.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens and must apply only through the online Samarth portal; incomplete applications or those without requisite documents will not be considered.
  • Experience will be counted only from the date of acquiring the essential qualification; qualifications from UGC-recognised universities or approved institutions only are considered valid.
  • The University reserves the right to fill or not fill any or all posts, to withdraw or modify the advertisement, and to increase or decrease the number of posts without notice.
  • Reservation claims must be supported by valid certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD) issued within specified dates; PwBD disability must be permanent and at least 40%.
  • Age, educational qualification, experience, and other details will be verified at the time of interview/document verification; if documents are found false or candidates have suppressed information, services may be terminated.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending screening test/written test/interview; selected candidates may be posted at any NFSU Campus and transfers across campuses are possible.
  • All updates, corrigenda and communication regarding recruitment will be published only on NFSU website and/or sent via email; candidates must regularly check their email and Samarth dashboard.

How to Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates must submit applications using the online Samarth portal accessible via NFSU website’s Career > Regular Recruitment section.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate online applications and pay the application fee separately for each post (if applicable).
  • Before applying, candidates should carefully read “Details of Minimum Qualification and Experience” and “Instructions to the Candidates” sections in the advertisement.
  • At interview/document verification, candidates must produce all original documents related to educational qualifications, category, experience and other essential requirements, along with self-attested copies.
  • Candidates already in service must submit No Objection Certificate and Vigilance Clearance from their employer at the time of interview/document verification as per rules.
  • For any queries, applicants may contact via email at [email protected]; online application link (Samarth) is https://nfsunt.samarth.edu.in.

Eligibility Criteria

For Veterinary Officer:

  • Essential Qualification: Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc. & A.H.) from a University established by law in India or equivalent qualification as defined in Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984
  • Must be duly registered with the Uttar Pradesh Veterinary Council
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree/diploma or higher qualification, served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, or obtained 'B' certificate of National Cadet Corps

For Vetting Officer:

  • Essential Qualification: Bachelor of Arts degree (with English or Hindi Literature) or Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Commerce with minimum 50% marks AND three years Bachelor of Laws with minimum 50% marks; OR Five years Bachelor of Laws with minimum 50% marks
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, obtained 'B' certificate of NCC, or Post-graduate degree in Law

For Swasthya Shiksha Adhikari:

  • Essential Qualification: Master's Degree from a recognised University in Sociology or any subject of Social Science (includes Sociology, Anthropology, Psychology, Social Psychology, Political Science, Geography, History, and Economics)
  • Desirable: Experience of Extension Work, Training under Family Welfare, served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Inspector of Drugs:

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Pharmacy or Pharmaceutical Sciences or Medicine with specialization in Clinical Pharmacology or Microbiology from recognized University
  • 18 months experience in manufacture OR testing of substances specified in Schedule 'C' to Drug and Cosmetics Rules 1945 in approved laboratory OR 3 years experience in inspection of firms manufacturing substances in Schedule 'C' as Drug Inspector
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Dental Surgeon:

  • Essential Qualification: B.D.S. (Bachelor of Dental Surgery) degree from recognised university or equivalent qualification recognised by Indian Dental Council
  • Rotary Internship completed before last date of application
  • Registration with U.P. Dental Council
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Ayurved):

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Ayurveda from University established by law in India OR Five years degree or diploma in Ayurvedic from Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • Registration as Vaidya with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience of State Ayurvedic or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Ayurvedic from recognized institution

For Medical Officer Community Health (Ayurvedic and Unani):

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Ayurveda or Unani Tib from University established by law in India or equivalent qualification
  • Registration as Vaidya or Hakeem with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience in State Ayurvedic, Unani or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Ayurveda or Unani Tib from recognised institution, served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Unani):

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Unani Tib from University established by law in India OR Five years degree or diploma in Unani Tib from Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • Registration as Hakeem with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience of State Unani or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Unani Tib from recognized institution

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Homoeopathic):

  • Essential Qualification: Recognised degree in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 5 years OR Recognised Diploma in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 4 years (preference to degree holders)
  • Must be registered with Homoeopathic Medicine Board, U.P.
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Homoeopathic Medical Officer:

  • Essential Qualification: Recognised degree in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 5 years OR Recognised Diploma in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 4 years
  • Must be registered with Homoeopathic Medicine Board, U.P.
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

  • Maximum Age: 40 years

Selection Process

  • Screening Examination: Commission will hold Screening Examination (Objective Type) for selection of suitable candidates for admission to interview
  • Question Paper: Objective type multiple choice questions with four alternatives for each question
  • Negative Marking: For each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty
  • If question is left blank, no penalty will be imposed
  • If more than one answer is given, it will be treated as wrong answer with same penalty
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: SC/ST candidates must secure minimum 35% marks, other category candidates must secure minimum 40% marks in screening examination
  • Candidates securing less than minimum efficiency standard will be disqualified
  • Final Merit: Determined by adding 75% marks in screening test and 25% marks in interview
  • Only candidates qualifying in Screening Examination will be entitled for Interview as per Commission's standard
  • Interview: Original certificates required for verification at the time of interview
  • Candidates serving under Central/State Government must produce "No Objection Certificate" at interview

General Information/Instructions

  • Application Mode: Online application only through O.T.R. (One Time Registration) based system. Applications through any other medium will not be accepted
  • O.T.R. Mandatory: Candidates must obtain O.T.R. Number from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submission of online application
  • Knowledge of Hindi: Essential for all posts
  • Domicile: Only domiciled persons of U.P. are entitled for reservation benefits
  • EWS Certificate: Valid for application year only; must be for previous year from application year with gross annual income from all sources
  • Caste Certificate: Must be issued by District Magistrate/Additional District Magistrate/City Magistrate/SDM/Tehsildar in prescribed format
  • Document Verification: Hard copy of online application with self-attested copies of all marksheets and certificates to be submitted when asked
  • No Change After Submission: Any request for change in qualification and category after receipt of application will not be entertained
  • Wrong Information: Candidates furnishing wrong information will be debarred from this selection and all future examinations up to maximum 5 years
  • Vacancy Numbers: May increase/decrease depending upon circumstances/requirements
  • Commission's Decision Final: Decision of Commission regarding eligibility/candidature/selection shall be final
  • Anti-Malpractice: Provisions of Uttar Pradesh Examination (Prevention of unfair Means) Act-2024 dated 06 August 2024 will be applicable
  • Candidates must visit Commission website continuously for updates
  • All future information/instructions will be sent to registered mobile number and email ID linked in O.T.R. by SMS or email

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - O.T.R. Registration: Obtain One Time Registration (O.T.R.) Number from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before applying
  • Step 2 - Visit Official Website: Go to https://uppsc.up.nic.in and click on "All Notifications/Advertisements"
  • Step 3 - Read Instructions: Go through User Instructions and View Advertisement thoroughly
  • Step 4 - Click Apply: Click on "Apply" button and authenticate with O.T.R. using O.T.P. received on registered mobile/email or O.T.R. password
  • Step 5 - Fill Application Part-1: Personal details will be auto-filled from O.T.R. Fill essential qualification required for the post
  • Step 6 - Fill Application Part-2: Click 'Submit Details' under 'Application Part-2'. Permanent and correspondence address will be auto-displayed. Choose Yes/No for preferential qualifications
  • Step 7 - Fee Payment: Click 'Proceed for fee payment' and pay through NET BANKING/CARD PAYMENTS/OTHER PAYMENT MODES via SBI MOPS
  • Step 8 - Take Print: After successful payment, take print of Payment Transaction Slip and submitted application form
  • Step 9 - Modification: If needed, modification in qualification can be done only once till last date for correction through 'Candidate Dashboard Login'
  • Important: Complete all stages of online application (O.T.R., Fee payment, Final submission) before last date
  • Preserve Records: Keep soft/hard copy of all information regarding all stages for future reference

Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of Applications. All the applications received from the candidates will be scrutinised subject to the eligibility criteria and necessary documents as mentioned above and only the candidates whose applications are shortlisted will be issued with admit card. The admit card of the shortlisted candidates will be sent by post in the envelope enclosed with the application. Further, a list of the shortlisted candidates will be published on Indian Coast Guard website.
  • Document Verification. All the shortlisted candidates issued admit card will undergo document verification. Candidates will be required to bring their original documents and self-attested photocopies (02 Sets) of the same as per the directives/ instructions given in their admit cards. All the documents should be issued prior closing date of application i.e 20 Jan 26.
  • Written Examination. All the shortlisted candidates will undergo written examination on the basis of educational qualification prescribed for the post. The written examination will be pen-paper based. The question paper (bilingual) for written examination will consists of 80 objective type questions with one mark for each correct answer and there will be no negative marking. The detailed syllabus, pattern of written examination and marking scheme for question paper is given at succeeding paragraphs.
  • Exact Date/time and venue of written examination will be communicated on the admit card issued to the candidates. Exam centers will be in Kolkata and Port Blair, candidate can choose the center in the application form.
  • Merit list will be prepared strictly based on merit position as per marks obtained in written examination and will be published on the Indian Coast Guard website alongwith necessary instructions.

How to Apply

  • The application with duly affixed self-attested colour photograph should be accompanied by Xerox copies of the documents listed below, duly self-attested with name and date. No original certificates are to be forwarded alongwith the application form.
  • Aadhar card
  • Matriculation or equivalent marksheet and certificate
  • UG/PG/Diploma marksheet and certificate as per the essential eligibility.
  • Latest Category Certificate {SC /EWS} for reserved category candidates.
  • Experience Certificate as mentioned.
  • NOC from the employer for candidates presently serving in any government organization (if applicable).
  • Two latest passport size colour photographs.
  • Applicants are to enclose a separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp (pasted on the envelope) addressed to themselves with the application.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Experience: Minimum 07 years of post-qualification experience in Optical Fibre Cable (OFC) project execution and network management.
