  • Essential Skills: Preventive and corrective maintenance, planning of OFC networks including OTDR-based fault diagnostics and fusion splicing.
  • Essential Skills: Strong understanding of fibre optic transmission, signal propagation and cable management practices.
  • Essential Skills: Experience in SLA / KPI monitoring, fault resolution and performance optimization of telecom networks.
  • Desirable / Preferred Skills: Familiarity with GIS, ABD, RFMS and Network Management Systems (NMS).
  • Desirable / Preferred Skills: Working knowledge of OTDR, Power Meters, Fusion Splicers and Visual Fault Locators (VFL).
  • Desirable / Preferred Skills: Proficiency in MS Office and basic network monitoring / reporting tools.
  • General Condition on Qualification: All qualifications must be from a recognized University / Institution approved by AICTE / UGC / Government of India and only full-time regular courses shall be considered.
  • Experience Counting: Experience shall be counted after acquiring the minimum prescribed qualification.
  • Crucial Date for Eligibility: 19.12.2025 (Date of notification).
  • Note on Experience: Internship / Apprenticeship / Training / Teaching / Academic / Freelancing experience shall not be treated as qualifying experience.

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly consolidated remuneration shall be negotiable and commensurate with educational qualification, relevant experience and market benchmarks.
  • Documents relating to last drawn remuneration need to be provided at the time of finalisation of engagement.
  • Statutory deductions such as EPF (employee's share), Income Tax, Professional Tax etc. shall be made as applicable.
  • Employer's contribution towards EPF shall form part of the CTC.

Age Limit (as on 19-12-2025)

  • Maximum age: 40 years as on 19.12.2025 (Date of notification).
  • Age relaxation shall be applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC / ST / OBC (NCL) / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen.
  • If a candidate is eligible for age relaxation on two or more grounds as mentioned in Annexure-II, only the highest admissible age relaxation shall be applicable.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the advertisement.

Important Dates

Event Date

Crucial Date for Eligibility (age, qualification, experience) 19.12.2025

Walk-in Interview Date for OBC 14.01.2026 (Wednesday)
Walk-in Interview Date for UR 15.01.2026 (Thursday)
Reporting Time for Walk-in Interview 10:00 Hrs

Selection Process

  • Engagement shall be based on Walk-in Interview, assessment of experience, domain knowledge and overall suitability for the assignment.
  • RVNL reserves the right to assess candidates as per organizational and project requirements.
  • No request for postponement of interview shall be entertained.
  • Engagement shall be purely on contract basis for an initial period of one (01) year, extendable up to three (03) years based on project requirement and satisfactory performance.
  • The engagement shall automatically cease on expiry of the contract period unless extended by RVNL.
  • One-month advance notice shall be required from either side for termination of contract.
  • Selected candidates shall be required to execute a Service Bond equivalent to two months' consolidated remuneration to serve RVNL for a minimum period of one year. If the candidate fails to complete the bond period, they will be liable to pay the entire bond amount as specified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates working in Government / PSU / Autonomous bodies shall produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview or submit an undertaking to produce proper relieving order at the time of joining in case of selection.
  • Engagement on contract basis shall not confer any right for regular appointment or continuation in RVNL.
  • Candidature shall be provisional and subject to verification of documents and eligibility.
  • For availing reservation, EWS, SC, ST & OBC-NCL candidates should furnish necessary certificate (in original) during walk-in interview in the standard prescribed format.
  • Candidates belonging to the OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category must submit a caste certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the format prescribed for appointments under the Government of India. OBC certificates issued for State Government services shall not be accepted and the certificate must be issued during the current financial year clearly indicating that the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer.
  • In the case of EWS candidates, an Income and Asset Certificate for 2024-25 issued by the Competent Authority during the current financial year only shall be accepted as valid proof for availing reservation under the EWS category.
  • In the case of PwBD candidates, a PwBD Certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the prescribed Government of India format (where applicable) must be produced.
  • In case the Caste/Category certificate is issued in a language other than Hindi or English, the candidate shall be required to produce a certified translation of the same in Hindi or English at the time of Interview/Document Verification/Joining, as applicable.
  • RVNL reserves the right to modify, restrict, increase or decrease the number of posts or cancel the engagement process at any stage.
  • No correspondence shall be entertained from candidates found ineligible or not selected.
  • The candidate will give an undertaking at the time of interview to the effect that he/she will be de-barred for participation in all types of future assignments in RVNL, if they refuse to join after issue of offer of appointment.
  • Candidates shall produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies in support of age, qualification, experience, caste/category, PwBD status (if applicable), identity and address proof. Any discrepancy or false information shall result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates must be medically fit and selected candidates shall have to undergo medical examination as per RVNL policy at their own cost before joining.
  • No travelling, lodging or boarding expenses shall be reimbursed for attending the Walk-in Interview and candidates shall make their own arrangements.

Eligibility by Gender

  • 33⅓% of the vacancies in each category are reserved for Women under Direct Recruitment on horizontal basis

Educational Qualifications

  • For Post Code No. 47 (Traffic Supervisor Trainee): Must possess a Graduate Degree awarded by any university in India, established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, Provisional Act of State or of any Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any other equivalent qualification as on 1st July 2025
  • For Post Code No. 48 (Mechanical Supervisor Trainee): Must have passed Diploma in Automobile/Mechanical Engineering conducted by the Department of Technical Education, Government of Telangana or its equivalent qualification in the same discipline as on 1st July 2025
  • Candidates possessing higher qualification of BE/B Tech/AMIE in the discipline of Automobile/Mechanical Engineering are also eligible for Post Code 48
  • Candidates who possess higher qualification than the prescribed one will also be considered for Post Code 47

Essential Qualifications

  • All educational qualifications must be obtained as on 1st July 2025
  • Degrees must be from universities in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, Provisional Act of State or from institutions recognized by the University Grants Commission
  • Diploma must be from the Department of Technical Education, Government of Telangana or equivalent

Desirable

  • For Departmental Candidates: Must have completed 5 years of service on regular basis as an approved probationer as on 25th December 2025

Experience

  • No specific experience mentioned as mandatory for external candidates
  • Departmental candidates must have 5 years of regular service in TGSRTC as on the date of notification

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: ₹27,080 – ₹81,400 per month
  • During Training Period (12 months): Selected candidates shall be eligible for stipend i.e., minimum of the time scale of Deputy Superintendent (Traffic)/Deputy Superintendent (Mechanic)
  • After Training: On successful completion of training, candidates will be appointed in the regular post as Deputy Superintendent (Traffic)/Deputy Superintendent (Mechanic)
  • During both regular and extended training period, candidates will receive the stipend amount

Age Limit (as on 1st July 2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 25 years
  • Upper Age Limit Relaxation: Government of Telangana vide GO Ms No. 30 dated 08-02-2024 have raised the upper age limit by 12 years (making it 37 years) for direct recruitment

Additional Age Relaxations

  • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years in addition to the length of service rendered in the Armed Forces (Indian Army/Indian Navy/Indian Air Force/Indian Territorial Army)
  • SC, ST, BC and EWS Category: 5 years
  • Departmental Employees (SC/ST/BC): Age relaxation to the extent of service rendered in the Corporation on regular basis, subject to maximum age not exceeding 45 years as on 1st July 2025
  • Departmental Employees (Other than SC/ST/BC): Age relaxation up to maximum of 10 years regular service, subject to maximum age not exceeding 40 years as on 1st July 2025

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: All eligible registered candidates shall be required to appear for Written Exam in one paper (three hours duration) for 200 marks (200 Questions - MCQs)
  • Paper Pattern for Traffic Supervisor Trainee (Post Code 47):
    • Supervisory Aptitude: 60 Questions
    • Numerical Aptitude: 40 Questions
    • Reasoning: 40 Questions
    • General English: 30 Questions
    • General Knowledge: 30 Questions
    • Total: 200 Marks
  • Paper Pattern for Mechanical Supervisor Trainee (Post Code 48):
    • Supervisory Aptitude: 60 Questions
    • Engineering Aptitude: 40 Questions
    • Reasoning: 40 Questions
    • General English: 30 Questions
    • General Knowledge: 30 Questions
    • Total: 200 Marks
  • Language of Question Paper: Questions will be set in English, Telugu and Urdu languages (except General English and Engineering Aptitude which will be in English only)
  • Answer Sheet: Candidates have to answer questions on an OMR answer sheet using Blue/Black Ball Point Pen only
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • OC including EWS: 40%
    • BC Category: 35%
    • SC/ST Category: 30%
  • Merit Determination: Selection shall be made strictly on relative merit based on score in Written Examination
  • Zone-wise Selection: First 5% of posts filled following combined Qualified Candidates List, remaining 95% filled by local candidates of respective zones
  • Tie-Breaking: When two or more candidates obtain equal marks, preference given to candidate who was born earlier
  • Certificates Verification: Candidates must produce original documents for verification
  • Medical Examination: Provisionally selected candidates will undergo medical fitness examination
  • Biometrics: Fingerprints and photographs will be taken at the time of Written Examination and whenever required

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted through ONLINE mode only on TSLPRB Website (www.tgprb.in)
  • Candidates must check their eligibility carefully before applying
  • Only online applications will be considered
  • Candidates should not furnish any false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • All testimonials issued by competent authorities must be produced when required
  • Claims regarding Age, Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications, Community etc. are accepted provisionally
  • If under-aged or over-aged candidates apply, their candidature will be rejected at any time
  • Candidates must use their personal mobile number as User ID which should remain active throughout recruitment process
  • No relevant column of Online Application Form should be left blank
  • Once submitted, no corrections can be made to the Online Application Form
  • Passport size photo and specimen signature must be combined as one file/image in jpg format (30kb to 100kb)
  • Application will be rejected if candidate uploads only photo without signature
  • Candidates should not submit more than one application
  • Giving false information will result in disqualification and prosecution
  • Candidature is provisional at all stages
  • TSLPRB reserves right to reject candidature at any stage without notice
  • Impersonation will be viewed adversely and prosecuted criminally
  • Candidates must behave in orderly and disciplined manner during examinations

Medical Standards

  • Candidate must be in good health mentally and bodily
  • Persons with disabilities are not eligible
  • Vision Test/Standards:
    • Distant Vision: Naked Eye vision 6/24 in each eye, corrected vision 6/9 with glasses in each eye
    • Near Vision: J1 with Glasses
    • Colour Vision: Normal (Colour blindness is disqualification)
    • Field of Vision: Normal
    • Fundus: Normal
  • Provisionally selected candidates will be referred to District Headquarters Hospital for medical examination
  • Candidates declared unfit in eye issues will be referred to Sarojini Devi Eye Hospital, Hyderabad
  • Candidates advised to have medical examination before applying

Reservation Information

  • Reservation as per Rule 22 and 22(A) of Telangana State & Subordinate Service Rules, 1996 applicable
  • 33⅓% vacancies reserved for Women on horizontal basis
  • Reservation for Local Candidates as per Presidential Order, 2018 and Regulation 8 of TGSRTC Recruitment Regulations
  • SC, ST and BC candidates must be local to Telangana to claim reservation
  • SC candidates must submit Community Certificate as per Act No. 15 of 2025 dated 14.04.2025 with sub-classification
  • BC candidates must submit Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • EWS candidates must submit Income and Asset Certificate issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • BC-E Group relaxation subject to adjudication of litigation and government orders

  • EWS Certificate (if applicable) issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • PPO/Discharge Book (for Ex-servicemen)
  • Service Certificate from TGSRTC (for Departmental candidates)

Training and Service Bond

  • Selected candidates will undergo 12 months training
  • Provisionally selected candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond to serve the Corporation for 5 years after training

Disqualification Grounds

  • Suppression of material facts
  • Canvassing for support
  • Having more than one spouse
  • Previously dismissed from government service
  • Convicted by court of law for offence involving moral turpitude

General Information/Instructions

  • These posts carry usual allowances i.e. Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) etc., as admissible to the Central Government employees and as made applicable to CSIR employees at the place of posting. Council employees are also entitled to accommodation according to the CSIR Residence Allotment Rules, subject to availability. If council or government accommodation is utilized, HRA will not be provided.
  • In addition to the emoluments, benefits such as reimbursement of Medical Expenses, Leave Travel Concession and Children’s Education Allowances etc. are also available as per CSIR/Govt. of India (GoI) Rules as applicable to the Council servants.

Enquiries asking for advice as to eligibility will not be entertained.

The duly constituted Screening Committee will adopt its own criteria for short-listing the candidates. Candidates will be allowed to take the written examination / trade test only in the medium they have opted for. If any candidate does not indicate the medium, the option will be deemed to be for English medium. The Choice of medium given by the candidates in the Online Application Form shall be applicable for written examination / trade test and treated as final, and no change in the medium will be entertained.
  • The screening of candidates will be conducted on the basis of the documents and information provided in the online application only. If at any stage it is discovered that a candidate does not meet the prescribed eligibility criteria or has submitted incorrect or false information in the application form; their candidature will be cancelled, even after selection and CSIR-NGRI will not be responsible for any consequences resulting from the submission of such false/inaccurate information. Therefore, the candidates must ensure that all information provided in the online application is accurate and correct.
  • In respect of equivalent clause in Essential Qualifications, if a candidate is claiming a particular qualification as equivalent as per the requirement of advertisement, then the candidate is required to produce order/letter in this regard, indicating the Authority (with number and date) under which it has been so treated as equivalent otherwise the application is liable to be rejected. The decision of the Director, CSIR-NGRI, shall be final and binding with regard to equivalence of qualification(s) and recognition of Universities/Institutes.

Selection Process

  • The Combined Technical Services Examination (Interview Posts) comprises of two stages: Written Examination and Interview
  • Candidates shall be admitted to the written examination based on the claims made in the online application
  • Onscreen certificate verification will be conducted before admission to the physical certificate verification and interview
  • Candidates will be admitted to onscreen certificate verification in the ratio of 1:3/1:4 (posts not requiring experience) and 1:10 (posts requiring experience)
  • After onscreen certificate verification, based on the marks obtained in the written examination and subject to the rule of reservation of appointments, candidates shall be admitted to physical certificate verification and interview
  • The objective of the Interview is to assess the suitability of the candidate for the post by judging the candidate's personality, bearing, aptitude, general knowledge, technical knowledge etc.
  • Marks obtained by the candidates in the Written Examination (Part B and Part C of Paper I and Paper II) and Interview would determine final ranking
  • Appearance in Paper I, Paper II and the Interview is compulsory

  • The number of vacancies and distribution of vacancies are tentative and liable for modification before the publication of results
  • The Commission reserves the right to include additional posts with different nomenclature and having similar eligibility conditions
  • Candidates should possess adequate knowledge in Tamil on the date of notification
  • Candidates not belonging to SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s, and BCMs, who have put in 5 years or more of service are not eligible to apply (except for posts requiring experience and Accounts Officer Class-III)
  • Persons with benchmark disabilities are not eligible for Deputy Manager (Mechanical), Deputy Manager (Electrical), and Deputy Manager (Materials) posts
  • Candidates selected for appointment will be required to submit a certificate of physical fitness to the Appointing Authority at the time of joining
  • The admission to all stages of examination will be purely provisional, subject to satisfying eligibility conditions
  • The Commission reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage after due process
  • All recruitments by TNPSC are purely merit-based
  • Candidates are solely responsible for their claims in the online application
  • Mobile phones, pagers, electronic equipment, programmable devices, or any banned items are not allowed in the examination hall

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates are required to apply online using the Commission's website www.tnpscexams.in
  • Step 2: Register at the One Time Registration (OTR) platform by paying Rs. 150 as registration fee (valid for five years). If already registered, proceed to fill online application
  • Step 3: Fill in the online form with all relevant correct details. Choose the subject paper(s) in which you have obtained educational qualification
  • Step 4: Upload recent colour photograph (20KB-50KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) and signature (10KB-20KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) as per specifications
  • Step 5: Upload all required documents including educational certificates, community certificate (if applicable), experience certificates (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), and other supporting documents
  • Step 6: Choose two district centres as preference for Written Examination (candidates with benchmark disability can choose only one)
  • Step 7: Pay examination fee of Rs. 200 through online mode (Net Banking/Credit card/Debit card/UPI) unless exemption is claimed
  • Step 8: Preview the application carefully and make necessary corrections if required
  • Step 9: Finally submit the application by clicking the 'SUBMIT' button
  • Step 10: Take printout of the application for future reference
  • Important: Candidates need not send the printout of online application or any supporting documents to the Commission by post unless specifically asked
  • Note: Linking the Aadhaar number with One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory for candidates

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification:

Candidates must possess ONE of the following qualifications as per 10+2+3/4 pattern:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Commerce from any University or Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission - 9 Posts
  • Bachelor of Engineering / Technology Degree in Civil or Electrical or equivalent recognized by AICTE from any University or Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission - 4 Posts

Cooperative Training Eligibility:

Candidates will be eligible for Cooperative Training if they have completed any of the following:

  • Diploma in Cooperative Management conducted by Tamil Nadu Cooperative Union
  • Higher Diploma in Cooperative Management conducted by Chennai National Cooperative Union and Madurai Cooperative Union
  • Diploma in Rural Home Management (Cooperation) from Vaikundam National Cooperative Institute

  • M.Com (Cooperation)
  • M.A (Cooperation)
  • Cooperative Studies diploma awarded by any University recognized by UGC
  • B.A (Cooperation)
  • M.Com (Cooperation)

Note: Candidates who have not completed the above-mentioned courses but have studied Book Keeping, Banking, Cooperation, and Auditing subjects can be considered eligible for Cooperative Training.

Important: Ex-Servicemen who have served in Indian Army without any break and possess any Bachelor's Degree will be considered eligible for posts requiring "Any Bachelor's Degree" qualification but NOT for posts requiring B.E/B.Tech in CS/IT/ECE, Law, Commerce, or Civil/Electrical Engineering.

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (cannot be reduced)
  • Maximum Age: 32 years (cannot be reduced)
  • Age Relaxation:
    • PWBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities): 42 years
    • Ex-Servicemen: 50 years
    • Destitute Widows: No upper age limit

For SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s and BCMs married to SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s and BCMs:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (cannot be reduced)
  • Maximum Age: No upper age limit
  • Age Relaxation:
    • PWBD: No upper age limit
    • Ex-Servicemen: No upper age limit
    • Destitute Widows: No upper age limit

Note: As per GO (Ms) No. 3(j) of Tamil Nadu Government Employees (Conditions of Service) Act 2016, the above age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen is applicable only for those who have already been selected for any category or post or job.

Important: "No upper age limit" means that on 01.07.2025 or on the date of notification or on the date of appointment, the candidate should not have completed 60 years of age.

Category Fee Amount
SC, SC(A), ST, Destitute Widows, PWBD Rs. 250/-

Selection Process

  • The selection will be based on a two-stage examination process: Written Examination and Personal Interview
  • Written Examination:
    • OMR-based written test
    • Duration: 3 hours
    • Total Marks: 200
    • Degree Level Question Papers: 170 marks
    • Personal Interview: 30 marks
  • The written examination will be conducted only in Chennai
  • Questions will be in both Tamil and English languages
  • The examination will cover:
    • Cooperative Management
    • Cooperative Credit and Banking
    • Cooperative Accounting
    • MIS and Computer Application/Computer Fundamentals
    • General Knowledge
    • Mental Ability
    • Aptitude and Reasoning
    • Tamil
  • Candidates will be shortlisted for personal interview based on their performance in the written examination
  • The final merit list will be prepared based on the combined marks of written examination and personal interview
  • In case of tie, the older candidate will be given preference
  • If age is also same, the candidate who applied earlier to the SRB will be given preference

  • State Recruitment Bureau, Chennai is conducting direct recruitment examination for filling up 50 Assistant posts in Tamil Nadu State Cooperative Union with headquarters at Chennai

  • Candidates must bring their Admission Ticket to the examination hall; otherwise, they will not be allowed to appear for the examination
  • Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website www.tncoopsrb.in for updates

      • Recent passport-size photograph (JPEG/JPG format, 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm, max 50 KB)

    7. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI
    8. Verify all entered details in the preview before final submission

The Security Guard recruitment in W‑3 grade is specifically for NLCIL’s Neyveli Units, offering ex-servicemen an opportunity to join a well-established organisation known for its extensive mining, thermal power and township infrastructure.

Through this Security Guard recruitment drive, NLCIL aims to leverage the discipline, field experience and physical standards of former personnel from the Indian Army, Navy and Air Force to secure its critical industrial assets at Neyveli. The post carries a structured pay scale of ₹20,000–81,000 with an annual CTC of about ₹5.47 lakhs and associated benefits, aligning with NLC’s position as a major central public sector employer in the southern region

NLCIL Security Guard Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Grade Total Vacancies Reservation
Security Guard W-3 30 UR – 15, EWS – 2, OBC(NCL) – 8, SC – 5 (ST candidates can apply against UR vacancies and will be considered under general standard of merit without age relaxation).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates must have served in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force, holding the rank of Havildar / Petty Officer / Sergeant or below ranks in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force respectively, before discharge.
  • Candidates must possess minimum educational qualification of Pass in X Std. / SSLC / Matriculation from a recognized Board.
  • Candidates should have worked in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force for at least 15 years as on the crucial date and should also have registered with the District Sainik Welfare Board as on the crucial date.
  • Only those candidates whose Performance Rating is at least ‘Very Good’ and Medical Category is “AYE” or “SHAPE – I” on retirement, as mentioned in the Discharge certificate/Book from Indian Armed Forces, are eligible to apply.
  • Desirable qualifications include proficiency in reading, writing and speaking the local language (Tamil) and knowledge of playing band instruments in the Armed Forces.
  • Only Indian Nationals who have acquired the notified qualification from appropriate statutory authority in India are eligible to apply.

Salary/Stipend

  • The pay scale for the post of Security Guard in W-3 grade is ₹ 20,000 – 81,000.
  • The approximate Cost to Company (CTC) per annum is ₹ 5.47 lakhs.
  • In addition to the CTC, selected candidates will be eligible for Unified Incentive Scheme (annually) as per rules.
  • Medical treatment for self and dependents and Group Insurance will be provided as per company rules.
  • Eligible type of unfurnished residential accommodation will be provided at standard rent in Company Townships, subject to availability.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Upper age limit for Security Guard (W-3) as on 01/12/2025: UR – 43 years, EWS – 43 years, OBC(NCL) – 46 years, SC – 48 years, ST – 43 years.
  • Age relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and SC candidates is as per Government of India guidelines and is applicable only when valid caste certificates are uploaded at the time of registration.
  • Candidates belonging to ST category can apply against UR vacancies and will be considered under general standard of merit without age relaxation.
  • OBC(NCL)/SC/ST candidates applying against UR vacancies will be considered under general standard of merit and no age relaxation will be extended.

Application Fee

  • Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Ex-servicemen candidates are required to pay a non-refundable amount of INR 236/- (inclusive of 18% GST) towards processing fee.
  • Payment of processing fee must be made through the prescribed online mode within the time limits specified in the important dates section.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Opening of Online registration of application 22/12/2025 at 10:00 Hrs
Closing of Online registration of application 20/01/2026 at 17:00 Hrs
Last Date for Online payment of Fees 20/01/2026 at 23:45 Hrs
Last date for Online submission of application for candidates already registered and paid fees within time limit 21/01/2026 at 17:00 Hrs

Selection Process

  • Only candidates who produce all necessary original documents and are found eligible during document verification will be allowed to attend the further selection process (Written Test & Physical Test).
  • Selection will be based on Written Test (100 marks – 70% weightage), Service Weightage and Performance Rating (20 marks – 15% weightage) and Physical Test (30 marks – 15% weightage).
  • The Written Test will be for 100 marks with three parts: Part-I (40 questions of General Awareness), Part-II (30 questions of Quantitative Aptitude) and Part-III (30 questions of Logical Reasoning), comprising 100 objective type questions with equal marks and no negative marking; duration is 120 minutes and the question paper will be in English language only.
  • Service Weightage is awarded based on years of service: above 20 years – 10 marks; above 18 years and up to 20 years – 8 marks; above 15 years and up to 18 years – 5 marks; Performance Rating based on entry in Discharge Book: Excellent/Outstanding – 10 marks, Very Good – 8 marks (maximum 20 marks).
  • Physical Test consists of Walk/Run (1.6 kms), Sit-up and Push-up, each graded as Excellent, Good and Pass with marks 10, 7 and 5 respectively, for a maximum total of 30 marks; candidates must pass all three tests to be considered for final selection.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in Written Test are 50 out of 100 for UR/EWS candidates and 40 out of 100 for SC/OBC(NCL) candidates against reserved posts; only those who secure minimum qualifying marks in Written Test are eligible for Physical Test.
  • Project Affected Persons (PAPs) of NLCIL Neyveli Projects will be allowed 20 bonus marks in the Written Test, limited to one beneficiary per award, subject to prescribed conditions and supporting documents.
  • Final selection will be in order of merit based on total marks in Written Test, Service Weightage & Performance Rating and Physical Test, subject to candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in each component and meeting category-wise requirements; tie cases will be resolved first by date of birth (elder candidates placed higher) and then by alphabetical order of first name.

General Information/Instructions

  • NLC India Limited is a premier ‘NAVRATNA’ Government of India Enterprise, and applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of Security Guard in W-3 grade for NLCIL Neyveli Units.
  • Only Indian Nationals who have passed the notified qualification are eligible to apply, and the notified qualification must have been acquired from appropriate statutory authority in India.
  • NLCIL reserves the right not to fill up any or all posts notified and vacancies may be increased or decreased depending upon organizational requirements.
  • Candidates permitted to appear for the Written Test are eligible for reimbursement of to and fro travelling expenses to the extent of sleeper class rail fare by shortest route, on production of travel proof including reservation and tatkal charges, if any.
  • Candidates removed, terminated or who deserted their employment from any organisation will not be considered; persons already resigned from NLCIL may apply if they fulfil eligibility criteria.
  • Scrutiny of applications and shortlisting will be based solely on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of online application; failure to upload legible and complete documents may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement or related to applications can be instituted only in Chennai, and the jurisdiction will be courts/tribunals/forums at Chennai.
  • NLCIL’s Appointing Authority’s decision in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, selection, posting and related issues will be final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Candidates should apply only through online mode in NLC India Limited website www.nlcindia.in.
  • Before registering or applying online, candidates should ensure that they have a mobile number and valid, active personal email ID and keep them active for the entire selection process, as all communications will be sent via SMS/email.
  • Candidates have to upload required scanned copies of documents/certificates in prescribed format to establish their eligibility; applications without required documents are liable for rejection.
  • Candidates should submit only a single application for the post; in case of multiple applications, the last registered application will be considered.
  • After uploading required documents, candidates should submit their application online, take a printout of the registration-cum-application form and produce it along with self-attested copies of certificates/documents at the time of document verification.
  • No manual or paper applications will be entertained and candidates should not send hard copies to NLCIL.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

The documents fulfilling the deficiency must be submitted at the time of document verification and the same must be issued in relation to the deficiency notified, with the purpose of substantiating the claim made in the application by such candidate; however, the date on the same shall not be later than the of date of document verification (submission of documents with regard to category status including OBC-NCL and EWS will continue to be governed as per the ‘Relaxation & Concessions’ section of this advertisement, to be read along with clause 8 under ‘How to Apply’ section of this advertisement).

Candidates will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies.

  • Departmental candidates of RITES and Candidates working in any organization shall be allowed to join RITES only after being properly relieved from their parent organization.
  • Before applying, the Candidates must satisfy themselves about their eligibility for the post applied for.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact (s), his/her candidature is liable for cancellation. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after appointment, his/her services are liable to be terminated.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum to this advertisement will be displayed only on the Company’s website www.rites.com. Therefore, applicants are advised to keep checking the Company’s website for any update.
  • Offer letter is not considered as proof of experience and candidate has to submit joining & relieving order / experience certificate for claiming the experience.
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Delhi in case of any dispute 9. No fares / TA / DA shall be payable.

  • All questions will be objective type

ITI Limited Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 215 Contract Posts

Advertisement

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

Q7. Is this a permanent job in ITI Limited?
A7. No, Young Professionals are engaged on a purely temporary/contract basis initially for 1 year, extendable up to a maximum of 3 years based on performance, with no obligation on ITI to offer regular employment.

Q8. What are the main posting locations for ITI Young Professional 2026?
A8. Posting locations include ITI units at Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini, Palakkad, Rae Bareli and multiple project/marketing locations such as Leh/Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Jodhpur, Bareilly, Kolkata, Tezpur, Delhi, Lucknow, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati, Ahmedabad and North Eastern states, subject to company requirements.

Q9. What is the job nature and working hours for Young Professionals?
A9. Young Professionals are engaged full time to provide professional services in specific spheres and will follow the same working hours as ITI employees; no extra remuneration is paid for work beyond office hours or on holidays.

Q10. Where can I contact ITI Limited in case of technical issues with the application?
A10. For any queries or technical issues related to the online application, candidates can email at [email protected] as mentioned in the notification.

Disclaimer: Candidates should refer to the original ITI Limited Young Professional 2026 notification (Ref. No. ITI/CRP/HR/2025/1534 dated 22-12-2025) and official website www.itiltd.in for exact terms, updates and any corrigendum before applying.

Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 Notification Out for 71 Posts

Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi (AUD), a State University established by the Government of NCT of Delhi, has released the detailed Advertisement No. AUD/55-1(49)/Rect./2025 dated 03 December 2025 for recruitment to various Teaching and Other Academic Staff posts on regular basis. This recruitment covers Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Librarian, Assistant Librarian and Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports positions across multiple Schools and disciplines with a total of 71 teaching plus 4 other academic staff posts. The online application process will commence from 20 December 2025 and will remain open till 09 January 2026 on the University website https://aud.delhi.gov.in, while hard copy of the online application with documents must reach by 16 January 2026.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Notification 2025 Out

Advertisement

The Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment to Various Teaching and Other Academic Staff Posts 2025 has been issued by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi to fill faculty positions (Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) and other academic posts (Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports) on a regular basis.

Before applying, candidates must carefully read the notification PDF to understand school-wise and discipline-wise vacancies, pay levels, eligibility conditions as per UGC/AICTE/NCTE/other regulatory bodies, reservation including PwBD, application procedure, and selection process for the AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025. Applicants are required to apply online and then send the printed application with self-attested documents to the specified address within the last date, following all instructions given in the advertisement.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Notification 2025 PDF - Click to Download

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 - Overview

Organization Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi (AUD)
Department Government of NCT of Delhi (State University)
Exam Name Recruitment to Various Teaching and Other Academic Staff Posts 2025
Post Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports
Total Vacancies 71 
Mode of Application Online application + submission of hard copy with documents
Registration Dates 20 December 2025 to 09 January 2026 (online); hard copy up to 16 January 2026 (17:30 hrs)
Application Fee UR/OBC/EWS: Rs. 1000/-; SC/ST/PwD/Women: Nil (no fee)
Selection Process Shortlisting/screening as per UGC norms, followed by interview / presentation / seminar by duly constituted Selection Committees
Official Website https://aud.delhi.gov.in

Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025

The Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi invites applications from eligible candidates for 71 faculty posts (20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, 24 Assistant Professor across various Schools and disciplines) and 4 other academic staff posts (Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports) on regular basis. The University focuses on humanities and social sciences and offers programmes across four campuses at Kashmere Gate, Karampura, Lodhi Colony and Qutab Institutional Area, aiming to reconceptualise social sciences through innovative curriculum and pedagogy.

This recruitment offers attractive academic pay levels under the 7th CPC, including Pay Level 14 for Professor and Librarian, Level 13A for Associate Professor, and Level 10 for Assistant Professor, Assistant Librarian and Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports, with salary ranges up to Rs. 2,18,200/- depending on the post. The posts are distributed across Schools such as Culture and Creative Expressions, Design, Development Studies, Education Studies (including ITEP), Global Affairs, Public Policy & Governance, Human Ecology, Legal and Socio-Political Studies, Letters, Management, Undergraduate Studies, Vocational Studies, and Heritage Research & Management.

Interested and eligible candidates must first submit their application form online through the AUD website from 20 December 2025 to 09 January 2026 and then send a hard copy of the filled online application along with self-attested supporting documents to the Deputy Registrar (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), AUD, Kashmere Gate Campus, so as to reach by 16 January 2026 up to 17:30 hrs. Applications will be shortlisted in accordance with UGC Regulations 2018 and applicable norms, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for interviews or presentations, with details notified on the University website and via email.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 Important Dates

The Detailed Advertisement No. AUD/55-1(49)/Rect./2025 clearly mentions the schedule for online application, last date and receipt of hard copies for the Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025. Candidates must adhere strictly to these dates as applications received after the deadlines will be summarily rejected and the University will not be responsible for postal delays.

Event Date
Notification (Detailed Advertisement) Date 03 December 2025
Commencement of Online Application 20 December 2025 (on University website)
Last Date to Apply Online 09 January 2026 (up to 23:59 hrs)
Last Date for Receipt of Hard Copy of Application 16 January 2026 (up to 17:30 hrs)
Screening/Shortlisting of Applications After last date, as per UGC/AUD norms (internal process)
Publication of Eligible / Not-eligible List To be uploaded on AUD website after scrutiny
Window for Grievances on Eligibility Within stipulated deadline after publication of list (as notified by University)
Interview / Presentation Schedule To be notified on University website and communicated by email to shortlisted candidates only.
Final Selection / Issue of Offer After completion of interviews and approval by competent authority.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

The University has notified 20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, and 24 Assistant Professor posts across various Schools, along with 1 Librarian, 2 Assistant Librarian, and 1 Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports posts, making a total of 71 vacancies. Certain posts marked with an asterisk are backlog reserved vacancies for specific categories, and there is horizontal reservation of 7 posts for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) across various categories (a to e) as per DoPT OM dated 15.01.2018 and related notifications.

Post Category Total Posts
Professor (Pay Level 14) 20
Associate Professor (Pay Level 13A) 23
Assistant Professor (Pay Level 10) 24
Librarian 1 (UR)
Assistant Librarian 2 (UR-01, OBC-01)
Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports 1 (UR, Women only)
Total 71

PwBD reservation covers categories such as blindness and low vision, deaf and hard of hearing, locomotor disability including cerebral palsy and related conditions, autism and intellectual disability, and multiple disabilities, with functional requirements regulated as per Gazette of India notification dated 07.01.2021 and DoPT guidelines. The notification also clarifies that candidates who had applied earlier for certain Assistant Professor posts in Social Science & Humanities and Global Studies against previous advertisement must apply afresh but are exempted from paying application fee with reference to earlier payment.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Eligibility Criteria 2025

Candidates willing to apply for the Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and other academic staff posts must ensure that they satisfy the eligibility criteria as per UGC Regulations 2018 and applicable NCTE/AICTE/other regulatory body norms. The notification clearly states that eligibility conditions regarding qualifications, experience, research publications and research score will be as per the latest UGC/NCTE/AICTE rules and the detailed discipline-wise criteria given in the advertisement.

✨ Educational Qualification

The educational and professional qualifications vary by post and discipline but broadly follow UGC Regulations 2018 and related bodies.

For Professor (various disciplines):
An eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, actively engaged in research with minimum 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations 2018, along with at least 10 years of teaching/research experience at University/National Level Institutions including supervision of doctoral candidates. Alternatively, an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and significant contribution to the field with at least 10 years’ experience and a national award instituted by Government of India and conferred by the President of India may be considered in specific cases as detailed in the notification.

For Associate Professor (various disciplines):
A good academic record with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, Master’s degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade), and minimum 8 years of teaching/research experience equivalent to Assistant Professor in a University/College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with at least 7 publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations 2018. Additional discipline-specific desirable qualifications such as experience with quantitative techniques, data handling, or interdisciplinary law and social science backgrounds are mentioned for some posts.

For Assistant Professor (various disciplines):
A Master’s degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or equivalent foreign degree, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or exemption through Ph.D. in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations 2009/2016, with detailed conditions for candidates registered before 11 July 2009 (including viva voce, external evaluation, publications, and paper presentations) certified by the concerned University. In professional/technical disciplines such as Design or Management, qualifications include Ph.D. with First Class at Bachelor’s or Master’s level, specified industry/teaching experience, and minimum numbers of SCI/UGC/AICTE-approved journal publications, as detailed in relevant sections of the advertisement.

For Librarian and Assistant Librarian:
Librarian requires a Master’s Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% marks, at least 10 years’ experience as Librarian at University/College/teaching level or College Librarian, evidence of innovative library services including ICT, and a Ph.D. in Library/Information/Documentation/Archives & Manuscript-Keeping. Assistant Librarian requires Master’s in Library/Information/Documentation Science with at least 55%, knowledge of computerization, and NET or exemption through Ph.D. meeting UGC norms, with detailed pre-2009 Ph.D. conditions.

For Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports (Women only):
Master’s Degree in Physical Education and Sports or Physical Education or Sports Science with 55% marks, record of representing University/College at Inter-University/Inter-Collegiate competitions or State/National championships, and NET (or Ph.D.-based exemption) in Physical Education/Physical Education & Sports/Sports Science. An alternative qualification is being an Asian Games or Commonwealth Games medal winner with at least a Post-Graduation degree, along with physical fitness test norms detailed for women candidates.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Selection Process 2025

The selection process for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 is based on merit through all-India advertisement and recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees, as per UGC Regulations 2018 and AUD norms. Applications will be scrutinised and shortlisted according to academic qualifications, research publications, research score, and other criteria, and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, presentation or seminar or a combination thereof as decided by the University.

The selection process is carried out in the following stages:

1. Scrutiny / Screening of Applications: A Scrutiny/Screening Committee will examine all applications and prepare a list of eligible and not-eligible candidates based on stipulated guidelines, eligibility conditions and shortlisting criteria as per UGC Regulations and University norms. The lists of eligible and not-eligible candidates (with reasons for ineligibility) will be uploaded on the University website, and candidates shown not-eligible will have an opportunity to submit grievances/clarifications with documentary evidence within a stipulated time.

2. Final Shortlisting & Interview Call: After considering grievances, the Committee will finalise the list of eligible candidates, and on the basis of academic record, publications, experience and research score, a reasonable number of candidates will be called for interview. If the number of applications is large, the University may restrict candidates by applying higher qualifications/experience than minimum prescribed, and in some cases may postpone interviews if there are not enough candidates.

3. Interview / Presentation / Seminar: Shortlisted candidates will be required to appear before the Selection Committee for interview and may be asked to give a presentation or seminar as part of the selection process. Candidates residing outside India may be interviewed via video conferencing (e.g., Skype or other modes) if requested in advance.

Final Merit: Final selection will be based on performance in the interview (and presentation/seminar where applicable), with academic/research scores used only for shortlisting, not for final selection. Appointments will be made in accordance with UGC Regulations 2018 and subsequent amendments, and the University reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel posts, and any dispute will fall under the jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Application Fee 2025

Applicants are required to pay a non-refundable application fee depending on their category while submitting the online application form. The fee must be paid online through the payment gateway (credit/debit card/net banking) provided on the University website and proof of payment should be retained by candidates.

Category Application Fee
UR / OBC / EWS Rs. 1000/- (Non-refundable)
SC / ST Nil (No application fee)
PwBD Nil (No application fee)
Women Candidates Nil (No application fee)
  • Payment must be made online only through the University portal; other modes are not accepted.
  • Candidates who had applied earlier for specified re-advertised posts are exempted from paying fee again against reference of their previous payment, subject to conditions mentioned in the notification.
  • Application fee once paid is non-refundable, and incomplete applications or those without fee (where applicable) will be rejected.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Salary 2025

All posts carry UGC pay scales under the 7th Central Pay Commission along with admissible allowances as per University, Government of India and GNCTD norms. The notification provides clear academic pay levels and corresponding pay scales for various teaching and other academic staff positions.

Component Details
Post Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports
Pay Level – Professor Academic Pay Level 14: Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200/-
Pay Level – Associate Professor Academic Pay Level 13A: Rs. 1,31,400 – 2,10,800/-
Pay Level – Assistant Professor Academic Pay Level 10: Rs. 57,700 – 92,500/-
Pay Level – Librarian Academic Pay Level 14: Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200/-
Pay Level – Assistant Librarian Academic Pay Level 10: Rs. 57,700 – 92,500/-
Pay Level – Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports Academic Pay Level 10: Rs. 57,700 – 92,500/-
  • Along with basic pay, selected candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and other benefits as per applicable government and University rules.
  • Conditions of service, including age of superannuation and career advancement, will follow UGC/Government of India/GNCTD norms and AUD Statutes and Ordinances.

How to Apply for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 and subsequently submit hard copies as per the instructions. The step-by-step application process is as follows.

  1. Step 1: Visit the official University website https://aud.delhi.gov.in on or after 20 December 2025.
  2. Step 2: Click on the recruitment/careers/notification link for “Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment to Various Teaching and Other Academic Staff Posts – AUD/55-1(49)/Rect./2025”.
  3. Step 3: Read the detailed advertisement carefully, including school-wise posts, eligibility qualifications, UGC/AICTE/NCTE norms, reservation and instructions.
  4. Step 4: Click on “Apply Online” and complete registration using a valid email ID and mobile number.
  5. Step 5: Fill the online application form with personal details, educational qualifications, teaching/research experience, publications and research score details as required.
  6. Step 6: Select the appropriate post, School, discipline and category; if applying for more than one discipline/post/category, submit separate applications and fees as applicable.
  7. Step 7: Upload scanned copies of relevant documents (certificates, mark sheets, experience letters, category certificates, Ph.D. compliance certificates Annexure I/II where required, etc.) as per the specified format and size.
  8. Step 8: Pay the non-refundable application fee online through credit/debit card/net banking/payment gateway, if applicable for your category.
  9. Step 9: Submit the application form online and take a printout of the successfully submitted online application.
  10. Step 10: Arrange self-attested copies of all supporting documents and index/paginate them in the order of essential eligibility criteria, and enclose with the printed application in an envelope clearly mentioning the name of post/discipline on top.
  11. Step 11: Send the hard copy by Registered/Speed Post so as to reach on or before 16 January 2026 (17:30 hrs) at: Deputy Registrar (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), Room No. 31A, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Lothian Road, Kashmere Gate Campus, Delhi – 110 006.

Important Links:

  • Official Notification PDF: Download Here
  • Apply Online: https://audrec.samarth.edu.in/

Important Instructions for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025

  • Application form must be submitted in online mode only within the prescribed time limit; hard copy of the online application with self-attested documents must also reach the University by the specified date and time.
  • Applicants applying for more than one discipline or for multiple categories of the same post must submit separate online applications and pay separate fees where applicable, selecting all relevant categories before final submission.
  • Hard copy applications must include proper indexing and pagination of all annexed documents in the order of essential eligibility criteria, failing which the application may not be taken up for screening and may be rejected without assigning reasons.
  • Applicants must possess the prescribed qualifications, experience and eligibility as on the closing date of application and should upload/submit specific certificates (including Ph.D. compliance certificates Annexure I/II) as required.
  • The University will shortlist/screen applications strictly as per UGC Regulations 2018, relevant regulatory body norms and AUD rules; academic and research score calculated online is indicative and subject to scrutiny.
  • The mere possession of minimum qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for interview; the University may restrict the number of candidates called for interview by prescribing higher criteria.
  • All communications, including lists of eligible/not-eligible candidates, interview dates and any updates, will be published on the University website and/or communicated via email; candidates must regularly check the website and email.
  • The University may verify authenticity of certificates/documents at any time; if any information is found false or suppressed, services of the candidate may be terminated without prejudice to further action.
  • The University reserves the right to increase, decrease, or cancel the number of advertised posts, and its decision in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding.
  • Any legal dispute in connection with this recruitment will fall under the territorial jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A1. The last date to apply online is 09 January 2026 up to 23:59 hrs, and the hard copy of the application must reach the University by 16 January 2026 up to 17:30 hrs.

Q2. What is the age limit for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A2. Age and service conditions, including age of superannuation, are as per University/UGC/Government of India/GNCTD norms; candidates must satisfy these norms as on the closing date of application.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A3. There are 67 teaching posts (20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, 24 Assistant Professor) and 4 other academic staff posts (1 Librarian, 2 Assistant Librarian, 1 Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports), totaling 71 posts.

Q4. What is the selection process for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A4. Selection is through scrutiny/screening of applications using UGC norms and academic/research scores, followed by interview and possibly presentation/seminar before duly constituted Selection Committees, with final selection based on interview performance.

Q5. What is the application fee for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A5. UR/OBC/EWS candidates must pay Rs. 1000/- (non-refundable), while SC, ST, PwBD and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

Q6. Is there any written examination in this recruitment?
A6. The notification specifies recruitment on the basis of merit through advertisement and interviews by Selection Committees; it does not mention a separate written examination, and the process is primarily based on screening and interview.

Selection Process

  • The examination will comprise:
    • Part-A: Computer Based Examination (200 marks).
    • Part-B: Short Hand Skill Test in Hindi or English (200 marks).
    • Part-C: Evaluation of Record of Service (APARs) carrying a maximum of 100 marks.

  • Part-C – Evaluation of Record of Service:

    • Category-wise qualifying standards in Skill Test will be fixed by the Commission.
    • Candidates qualifying Skill Test will be considered for final selection on the basis of merit in Computer Based Examination, Skill Test and APAR evaluation.
    • Separate select lists will be prepared for each participating cadre/service to the extent of available vacancies, subject to reservation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must apply online on the new SSC website https://ssc.gov.in; earlier OTR on https://ssc.nic.in will not be functional for the new website.
  • Online application process has two parts: One Time Registration (OTR) and filling of Online Application Form; detailed instructions are given in Annexure-IV and Annexure-V.
  • Candidates should submit only one application; multiple applications may lead to rejection.
  • OTR requires mobile number, email ID, Aadhaar or other ID, and Matriculation details; data must match Matriculation certificate.
