MEA Policy Specialist Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name No of Posts
Policy Specialist in MER Division 02

Eligibility Criteria

  • The applicant should only be an Indian national.
  • The applicant should possess a higher qualification (Masters’ and above) from a reputed Indian or International Institution/University in Economics/Development Cooperation/Development Partnership/International Relations/International Law/International Development /Strategic Studies /Public Administration /International Trade/Environment and Climate/Trade/Agriculture/Labour Economics/Energy/Health/Disaster Management/ Anti corruption.
  • At least three years of experience in handling multilateral work in UN agencies or International Organizations or International consultancy/Consultancy Organizations /Government of India as Consultant/Advisor, in relevant fields.
  • The applicant should preferably have experience of participating in international meetings.
  • The applicant should possess good writing and analytical skills and have experience in policy making or advocacy. Experience in speech writing, analytical writing and preparing negotiation strategy.
  • The applicant must be proficient in the use of computers (Word, Excel, Power Point etc.)

Salary/ Stipend

  • The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 2.25 lakh per month each and deduction of applicable taxes. The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 16-01-2026)

  • The applicant should not be more than age of 40 years as on the last date submission of applications.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 24/12/2025
Last Date for Receiving Applications 16/01/2026 (1730 Hrs)

Selection Process

  • Ministry of External Affairs will review the applications and shortlist the candidates for interview / written test. The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email.
  • The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed through email at the email address provided by the applicants.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

General Information/Instructions

  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidates.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.
  • No HRA shall be admissible.
  • The engagement of the Consultant is on full time basis. Normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs. Working hours is subject to change from time to time. Saturdays/Sundays will remain closed as weekend off. In exigencies, he/she may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays. No extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible. He/She shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise in government or private sector or in any other organization of any kind during the term of engagement with this Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Accumulation of leave beyond a calendar year may not be allowed. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave will not be allowed for more than 10 days at a time. Discretion is reserved to the Head of Division to refuse or revoke leave in the public interest. Leave encashment will not be permissible on unspent leave. Unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period. No other leave of any kind shall be admissible to him/her. In case he/she remains absent from duty beyond entitled leave, a proportionate deduction from the consolidated fee as applicable will be made.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of his/her duties, the Ministry will take care of his/her travel, accommodation and per-diem costs, as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format w.e.f. the actual date of engagement as Consultant.
  • Incomplete application and those received without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to Applicants for attending interview.
  • Applications received after the closing date and time or without the prescribed documents or otherwise found incomplete or not in the prescribed proforma will be rejected and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.

How to Apply

  • The applicants who fulfil the eligibility criteria may submit application indicating their interest in working for the Ministry of External Affairs as per proforma at Annexure I.
  • Documents / certificates in support of educational qualifications, experience in Govt. service should be attached with the application.
  • Applications along with supporting documents can be submitted to the Ministry through either of the following modes:
  • OFFLINE MODE:- By registered post in an envelope labelled as “Application for the position of Policy Specialist in the MER Division of Ministry of External Affairs”. This is to be sent to the following address. Under Secretary (PF&PG) Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011
  • ONLINE MODE:- Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position against which the application is being submitted. The email is to be sent to the following email address: [email protected]

Advertisement
Examination Name Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) 11th Food Analyst Examination

FSSAI 11th Food Analyst Exam 2025-26 Details

Examination Stage Details
Computer Based Test (CBT) 8th March 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-I) 25th & 26th April 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-II) 2nd & 3rd May 2026
Mandatory Training 25th May 2026 to 5th June 2026 (Two Weeks)
Certificate Issuance 5th June 2026

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Educational Qualification

  • The candidate should hold a Bachelor's or Master's or Doctorate degree in Chemistry or Biochemistry or Microbiology or Dairy Chemistry or Agriculture Science or Animal Science or Fisheries Science or Biotechnology or Food Safety or Food Technology or Food and Nutrition or Dairy Technology or Oil Technology or Veterinary Sciences from a university established in India by law
  • Or is an associate of the Institution of Chemists (India) by examination in the section of Food Analysts conducted by the Institution of Chemists (India)

Essential Experience

  • The candidate should possess not less than three years' experience in the analysis of food in any institution, research institutions, or research laboratory after attaining the minimum essential academic qualification specified above for 11th FAE 2025
  • The qualified Junior Analysts after acquiring 3 years' mandatory experience in analysis of food can appear only in Practical Examination of 11th FAE 2025 conducted after the Computer Based Test
  • The opportunity for appearing in Practical examination for Junior Analysts after acquiring 3 years of experience will be provided only once
  • Upon qualifying the practical examination, the Junior Analyst will become eligible to be declared as Food Analysts
  • This opportunity is available to qualified JAE only once in a lifetime

Age Limit (as on 22nd January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: No Age Limit
  • Maximum Age: No Age Limit
  • There is no age limit for appearing in the 11th FAE 2025

Application Fee

Examination Stage Fee Amount
Computer Based Test (CBT) ₹2,500 plus 18% GST (Total: ₹2,950)
Practical Examination ₹5,000 plus 18% GST (Total: ₹5,900)
  • The fee should be submitted through online mode which is non-refundable
  • There is no reservation in whatsoever form since this is not for employment

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening of online portal for application submission 23rd December 2025
Last date for receipt of online application 22nd January 2026
Date of issue of admit card for CBT (online downloadable) 24th February 2026
Computer Based Test (CBT) Examination Date 8th March 2026
Publication of Answer Key and opening of challenge window 10th March 2026
Closing of Answer Key challenge window 20th March 2026
Announcement of CBT results 23rd March 2026
Opening of online portal for Practical examination application 3rd April 2026
Last date for receipt of Practical examination application 10th April 2026
Date of issue of admit card for Practical Examination 10th April 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-I) 25th & 26th April 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-II) 2nd & 3rd May 2026
Declaration of Practical Examination results (Batch-I) 26th April 2026
Declaration of Practical Examination results (Batch-II) 3rd May 2026
Two Weeks Food Analysts mandatory training 25th May 2026 to 5th June 2026
Issuance of certificate after training completion 5th June 2026

Selection Process

  • The 11th Food Analyst Examination will be conducted in two stages: Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Practical Examination
  • Only candidates who qualify the Computer Based Test (CBT) as per the laid down criteria and fulfil the eligibility requirements will be allowed to appear in Practical Examination
  • Dates of Practical examination will be intimated separately to qualified candidates
  • The examination comprises both theoretical knowledge assessment through CBT and practical skills evaluation through hands-on practical examination
  • Upon successful completion of both CBT and Practical Examination, candidates must complete a two-week mandatory Food Analysts training from 25th May 2026 to 5th June 2026
  • Certificates will be issued to successful candidates after completion of the mandatory training on 5th June 2026
  • Candidates successfully completing all stages will be certified as Food Analysts by FSSAI

General Information/Instructions

  • The 11th Food Analyst Examination is conducted under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Food Safety and Standards (First Amendment) Rules, 2022
  • This is a certification examination and not for employment purposes
  • There is no reservation in whatsoever form since this is not for employment
  • Candidates must have relevant educational qualifications from universities established in India by law
  • Three years of mandatory experience in food analysis is essential after obtaining the required educational qualification
  • Junior Analysts who have acquired 3 years of mandatory experience can appear only in the Practical Examination after qualifying CBT
  • The opportunity for Junior Analysts to appear in Practical examination after acquiring 3 years of experience will be provided only once in a lifetime
  • All application fees are non-refundable once submitted
  • Candidates must complete the registration and application process online through the official portal only
  • Admit cards will be available for download from the official website on the specified dates
  • Answer key will be published after the CBT examination and candidates can submit challenges during the specified window period

How to Apply

Step 1: Registration Process

  • Visit the official Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Portal at https://fssai.formsubmit.in
  • Click on the "Register" menu on the homepage
  • Enter your full name as per official documents
  • Create and set your username for profile login
  • Provide a valid and active email ID
  • Enter your mobile number during registration
  • Set a strong password for profile login
  • Click on the "Sign Up" button to proceed
  • Enter the OTP received on your registered email and mobile number to complete the registration process
  • Once registration is successful, you will receive a user ID and password via email

Salary/Stipend

Event Date / Time

  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to applicants for attending interview.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

  • The period of consultancy is 01 (one) year; the contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and requirement.
  • The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof; unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • The selected consultants will be attached to dedicated BRICS Working Groups like Trade, Industry, Finance, Agriculture, Energy, Environment, ICT, Labour etc., and will develop concept notes, analytical notes and background documents for India’s BRICS Chairship.
  • They will assist in preparing draft outcome documents for BRICS meetings, help with negotiation process including drafting documents during negotiations, and keep track of country positions on relevant subjects.
  • They will keep track of the state of play on issues discussed in BRICS Working Groups and work towards proposals that may garner consensus in BRICS.
  • They will cover meetings and perform liaison duties with various Line Ministries/Departments of Government of India, Think Tanks, International Organizations and BRICS member and invitee countries, and perform any other task assigned by the Head of Division.

  • Online mode: Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position against which the application is being submitted, to email address: [email protected].

Selection Process

  • As per The Selection Tests Rules, 2025, through a two-stage process as under:
  • Stage 1: Eligibility Test - A multiple-choice questions (MCQ) based screening test examining general awareness, analytical ability, aptitude, and logical ability
  • Stage 2: Selection Test - Qualifiers from Stage 1 (or exempted) will appear for a grade-specific written test on domain knowledge in civil engineering, infrastructure projects, and related areas
  • Personal Interview - Conducted by a nominated Selection Committee for shortlisted candidates based on written test scores
  • Special Provision: Applicants with experience of working in NHIDCL for a total period of 5 years (i.e. 1825 days or more) as on the date of this advertisement shall be exempted from Stage-1: Eligibility Test. However, they must undergo Stage-2: Selection Test (Specific Written Test and meet all other eligibility criteria
  • Syllabus for Eligibility Test and Specific Written Test: The detailed syllabus is available on the NHIDCL website
  • Final Selection: Final selection shall be based on NHIDCL Cadre Rules

General Information/Instructions

  • One post of Sr. Manager for category D (autism, intellectual disability, Specific Learning Disability, mental illness etc.) and one post of Dy. General Manager for category B (deaf & hard of hearing) under PwBD reservation will be made applicable for the above vacancies horizontally
  • Eligibility for Availing Reservation: To avail community reservation, candidates must belong to a caste listed in the Central Government reserved communities list. Candidates would be required to submit valid SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificates at the time of document verification
  • PwBD category reservation will be limited to under mentioned disabilities: B. Deaf & hard of hearing D. Autism, intellectual disability, Specific Learning Disability, mental illness etc
  • Functional Requirements for PwBD Categories are: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Bending, Jumping, Climbing, Manipulation by Fingers, Reading & Writing, Seeing (SE), Communication (C)
  • Reserved Category candidates applying for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any relaxations
  • Name variations in certificates should be supported by such legal documents, as may be required under provisions of law/guidelines
  • Government/PSU candidates are required to submit NOC / relieving letter from their current organizations at the time of document verification prior to issuance of "Offer of Employment"
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease based on NHIDCL requirements
  • Selected Candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad. NHIDCL at present operates through 14 Regional Offices in different States/UTs with its Corporate HQ at New Delhi
  • NHIDCL at any stage may cancel the advertisement or selection process without assigning any reasons
  • Candidates must keep their email ID active for one year; no change in the email ID would be allowed
  • Corrigendum/addendum/errata will be posted only on NHIDCL's website at www.nhidcl.com under the heading "Career/Current Vacancies"
  • Canvassing or external influence will disqualify the candidate from selection
  • Candidates should avoid middlemen / recruitment agents / consultants and fraudulent job promises
  • All disputes are subject to Delhi High Court jurisdiction, with the English version prevailing for interpretation
  • All appointments in NHIDCL shall be subject to the successful completion of a background verification process (BGV). The BGV may inter alia include verification of the candidate's identity, address, educational and professional qualifications, character antecedents and any other information as deemed necessary by NHIDCL
  • If at any point of time, before or after the appointment, the outcome of the background verification is found to be unsatisfactory, NHIDCL reserves the right to withdraw or cancel the offer of employment/ appointment
  • The personal information collected during the verification process/selection process shall be handled in accordance with applicable laws, rules, and NHIDCL's policies. It shall be used only for purpose of assessment and verification relevant to employment
  • For detailed information, candidates may refer to NHIDCL Cadres (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Rules, 2025, which are available on the NHIDCL website. It may be noted that provisions of these rules shall apply and supersede any of the instructions given in this Recruitment Notice, if found to be contradictory
  • In case of any doubt & queries please contact to: [email protected]

How to Apply

Eligibility Criteria

Advertisement

Post-wise Educational Qualifications

  • Research Associate I: PhD in Biological or Chemical Sciences/Life Sciences is essential; 0–1 year postdoctoral experience in the relevant field with at least one research paper published in an SCI journal and laboratory experience is desirable.
  • Project Research Scientist: Master’s degree in Life Sciences with relevant research experience supported by high-quality publications; preference for candidates with hands-on expertise in animal handling, parasite cell culture, processing clinical samples, and especially malaria parasite culture.
  • Administrative Consultant: Graduate with demonstrated experience in research operations and the ability to manage complex logistics to ensure timely project execution; preference for applicants with one or more years of experience in administrative coordination or management.
  • Data Manager: Bachelor’s or higher degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Data Science, Computer Science, or related discipline from a recognized institution; preference for candidates with experience in database development and management, large-scale biological data analysis, data mining/data science techniques applied to biological questions, and strong expertise in bioinformatics tools, high-throughput data analysis, and relevant programming and scripting for server-side tools.

Vacancy Details

Various positions are available in the Structural Parasitology Group, ICGEB, New Delhi, for multiple externally funded projects.

Post Name No. of Positions
Research Associate I 1
Project Research Scientist 2
Administrative Consultant 1
Data Manager 1

Selection Process

Candidates must meet the required essential qualifications and experience criteria to be considered for the positions. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted via email with further details regarding the interview, and applicants who do not possess the essential qualifications will not be considered for the posts.

The mode of interview is online only, and further information about the interview process will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

How To Apply

Interested candidates must apply by email with the following documents:

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) of not more than three pages clearly elaborating research experience in detail.
  • Contact details of three academic referees, including name, affiliation, email address, and phone numbers.
  • A cover letter of one page.

The complete application should be sent to the email address: [email protected].

Important Dates

Event Date
Last Date to Apply 31 December 2025

Instructions

  • Candidates must strictly meet the required experience and essential qualification criteria to be eligible to apply.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email with further details regarding the interview.
  • Applicants who do not possess the essential qualifications will not be considered for the positions.
  • The place of work will be the ICGEB campus, New Delhi, in the Structural Parasitology Group.

BEL Director (Marketing) 2025 Vacancy Details

The PDF is an advertisement for a single, specific Board-level position (Director Marketing). It does not list multiple vacancies or category-wise distribution; it focuses on the eligibility for this high-level post.

Eligibility Criteria for BEL Director (Marketing) 2025

1. Educational Qualification

The applicant should be an Engineering Graduate or a Graduate with MBA/PGDM in Marketing or a related subject from a recognized University/Institution with a good academic record.

2. Age Limit

The age criteria are based on residual service until the age of superannuation (60 years):

  • Minimum Age: 45 years.
  • Maximum Age: 2 years residual service as on the date of vacancy for internal candidates, and 3 years residual service for others as on the date of vacancy. The date of the occurrence of the vacancy is 01.07.2026.

3. Experience

The applicant should possess cumulative experience/exposure of at least 5 years during the last ten years in Product Development/ Marketing/ Market Research/ Business Development/ Sales Forecasting and Planning. Experience in the Electronics Sector is preferred.

4. Employment Status

Applicants must be employed in a regular capacity (not contractual/ad-hoc) in a Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), Central Government (Group 'A' Officer level or equivalent), State PSE (with turnover of Rs. 5,000 crore or more), or Private Sector company (with turnover of Rs. 5,000 crore or more).

Salary/Stipend

The position is in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 180000 – 340000.

Selection Process for BEL Director (Marketing) 2025

The selection process is based on an Interview conducted by the Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB). The Board reserves the right to shortlist applicants for the interview.

How to Apply for BEL Director (Marketing) Recruitment 2025?

Eligible candidates can apply online only through the PESB website by the specified deadline.

  1. Visit the official PESB website: pesb.gov.in.
  2. Find the job description for "Director (Marketing)" in Bharat Electronics Limited.
  3. Fill up the application form online.
  4. After online submission, applicants must forward the application through their proper channel (e.g., Cadre Controlling Authority, Administrative Ministry, or directly to PESB for private sector applicants).

Important Dates for BEL Director (Marketing) 2025

Event Date
Notification Release Date 19.12.2025
Online Application End Date 09.01.2026 (by 3:00 PM)
Last Date for Nodal Officers to Forward Applications 19.01.2026 (by 5:00 PM)

Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted online through the PESB website only.
  • Applications must be routed through the proper channel as specified in the notification based on the current employment sector.
  • Applicants from the private sector must submit additional documents, including annual reports of their company and proof of working at the required level.
  • The appointment is on a contractual basis for five years or until superannuation, whichever is earlier.
  • Candidates must provide an undertaking that they will join if selected; unwillingness to join after the interview or offer of appointment results in debarment for a period of two years.
  • Incomplete or late applications will be rejected.

Eligibility Criteria for BEL Director (Human Resources) 2026

Details of candidates shortlisted for Documentation/ Personal Interview will be posted on PHL website only. Call Letters to shortlisted candidates will also be sent to their registered e-mails IDs.

During Document Verification, the candidate will have to produce his/her all Original Certificates in support of age, caste, qualification, experience etc. along with a proof of identity and one set of self-attested photocopies of the Certificates. If the identity of the candidate is in doubt or he/she is not able to produce the requisite documents or there is mismatch of information in the documents, his/her candidature will be rejected. No additional time will be given for producing original documents.

Candidates already working in Central Government/State Government/Autonomous Body/Public Sector Undertaking are required to submit their application through proper channel or produce "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer on the day of interview, failing which his/her candidature will not be considered. Other claims such as undertaking to resign in the event of selection, acknowledged copy of application for NOC/resignation letter, experience certificates etc. shall not be considered in place of NOC.

In case a candidate does not appear for Document Verification along with original documents, he/she shall not be eligible for further selection procedure and his/her candidature shall summarily be rejected.

After Document Verification, the provisionally shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by an approved panel of 5-6 members.

Final selection will be made in order of merit prepared on the basis of marks obtained by the candidates in interview subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria prescribed for the post.

Name of the candidates provisionally selected for appointment will be declared on PHL website. The Offer of Appointment shall be issued to the provisionally selected candidates on their Registered email IDs only.

Selection of candidates shall be provisional, subject to verification of documents relating to eligibility criteria, character and antecedents and other documents submitted by the candidate and is also subject to his/her meeting the requisite medical standards for the post and other requirements applicable for appointments under the rules of PHL.

Appointment of successful candidates will be subject to further verification of concerned documents related to Age, Qualification, Caste & Medical fitness certificates etc. from the issuing authorities so that the candidate is suitable in all respects for appointment to the service/post.

In case of subsequent change in name, candidates should indicate their changes only in the Online Application. However, other details should match with the Matriculation Certificate. Gazette Notification or any other legal document as applicable should be submitted at the time of Document Verification.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian nationals having requisite qualification and experience are eligible to apply.
  • Essential educational qualification: Master’s degree in Water Resources Management, Hydrology, Erosion (River/Coastal) Risk Management, Disaster Management or any other disciplines related to disaster management such as geography, geology, environment, civil/geo-technical engineering.

  • Post-qualification experience: Minimum 5 years’ experience in Erosion (River/Coastal) risk management or related subject.
  • Duration of research work (Ph.D./Post Doctoral) will be counted for work experience (actual duration or 5 years, whichever is less).
  • Field experience in community-based approaches to Erosion (River/Coastal) risk management and in projects with substantial use of disaster risk reduction and mitigation will be given more weightage in the selection process.
  • Both educational qualifications and work experience must prove the credentials of the applicant as an established expert in the field.
  • The applicant should not be more than 50 years of age for Senior Consultant; in case of retired Government employee, maximum age limit is 62 years.

Salary/Stipend

  • Remuneration band: Rs. 1,25,000/- to Rs. 1,75,000/- per month for Senior Consultant.
  • Remuneration in respect of retired Government employee engaged as a Consultant shall be regulated as per Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.III.A dated 09 December 2020.
  • The remuneration is consolidated and inclusive of all applicable taxes and no other allowance shall be provided, as per the recruitment handbook description and ToR.

Age Limit (as on last date of application)

  • Maximum age limit is 50 years for Senior Consultant.
  • In case of retired Government employees, maximum age limit is 62 years for engagement as Senior Consultant.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Date of advertisement 24/12/2025
Application window Within 20 days from date of publication of advertisement on NDMA website

Selection Process

  • Essential/desirable educational qualifications and experiences will be verified with original certificates.
  • Applications will be considered only when submitted through NDMA job portal; incomplete applications will not be considered and NDMA reserves the right to reject such applications without assigning any reason.
  • Detailed terms and conditions and eligibility criteria are available in the Terms of Reference (ToR) on the NDMA website; selection will be based on the criteria and processes outlined therein.

General Information/Instructions

  • NDMA is the apex-level institution for disaster management in India, mandated under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 to lay down policies, plans and guidelines for disaster management and implement related programmes.
  • The Disaster Management Act, 2005 provides for constitution of National, State and District Disaster Mitigation Funds to allocate resources for mitigation measures; large-scale structural interventions should be pursued through regular development schemes, while local and community-based interventions are supported by mitigation funds.
  • The position of Senior Consultant (Erosion-River-Coastal) is in the Mitigation Division, focusing on Erosion (River/Coastal) as one of the key areas of mitigation due to its frequency, geographical impact, and associated human and physical losses.
  • Senior Consultant will work full time and shall not take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy with NDMA.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required; high-order skills in operating spreadsheets and databases and skill in making presentations are required competencies.
  • Allowances such as TA/DA, lodging and boarding expenses etc. for official tours/visits will be provided as per rules/regulations of Government of India/NDMA.
  • The engagement is temporary; NDMA can terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason, though normally one month’s notice will be given; Senior Consultant can also seek termination by giving one month’s notice.
  • Senior Consultants will be engaged for a fixed period not exceeding three years, with continuation contingent on satisfactory Annual Performance Review; extension beyond three years may be considered under exceptional circumstances, but no extension will be given beyond age 65 years.

How to Apply

  • Interested individuals may apply for the position online through NDMA website (http://ndma.gov.in) within 20 days from the date of publication of advertisement on NDMA website.
  • Applications will be considered only when applicants apply through the NDMA job portal; no other means of application will be considered.
  • Essential/desirable educational qualifications and experience documents must be uploaded and will be verified with original certificates at the appropriate stage.
  • For any assistance to apply online, applicants may call 9958136496 or 9873997934.
  • Incomplete applications will not be considered and NDMA reserves the right to reject such applications without assigning any reason.

  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications:

  • Discipline Code 107 - Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 108 - Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT

  • Discipline Code 101 - Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 102 - Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 103 - Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 104 - Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 105 - Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 106 - Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 112 - Graduate Apprentice: Regular full time Graduate in any discipline (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 113 - Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/Board
  • Discipline Code 114 - Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Skilled Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/Board. Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government

Essential Conditions:

  • The qualification prescribed shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course in relevant disciplines
  • Qualification acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning mode shall render the candidate NOT ELIGIBLE
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, only those applicants who have acquired the prescribed qualification between 01.04.2022 and 31.12.2025 shall be considered eligible
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator) only those applicants who have acquired the prescribed qualification between 01.04.2021 and 31.12.2025 shall be considered eligible
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA or equivalent or MCA/CA/ICWA, LLB or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining the apprenticeship training shall NOT BE ELIGIBLE
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute
  • Candidates possessing Diploma in Engineering in relevant trade/discipline under a recognized lateral entry scheme shall also be considered eligible subject to meeting prescribed percentage of marks

Previous Apprenticeship Training Conditions:

  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training, and the second training shall not be in the same trade
  • There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed
  • No gap shall be required in the case of termination of previous apprenticeship training due to failure on the part of the employer
  • Where an apprentice has terminated a previous apprenticeship contract due to health or financial hardship or relocation, transportation or career changes or language barrier, the waiting period of three month shall apply before the apprentice shall enter into another contract of apprenticeship with the same employer or any other employer and there shall be no waiting period for women

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time
  • The exact stipend amount will be communicated at the time of engagement
  • Stipend will be paid on monthly basis during the apprenticeship training period

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years (maximum age up to 29 years)
  • Age Relaxation for OBC-NCL: 3 years (maximum age up to 27 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: 10 years (maximum age up to 34 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years (maximum age up to 39 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC-NCL): 13 years (maximum age up to 37 years)
  • Date of Reckoning: 31.12.2025

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the notification
  • The application process is completely online and free of cost

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 10/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 10/12/2025 (10:00 AM onwards)
Last Date for Registration in NAPS/NATS Portal 09/01/2026 (5:00 PM)
Last Date for Microsoft Form Submission 09/01/2026
Date of Reckoning (Age & Qualification) 31/12/2025
Period of Apprenticeship Training 12 Months

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for selection process
  • No Written Test/Interview: There will be no written test or interview for the selection
  • Merit-Based Selection: Merit list of all the candidates who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the post
  • The shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification
  • Candidates will have to complete Pre-engagement medical fitness test for being adjudged suitable for engagement
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format
  • Shortlisted candidates whose documents including Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting process shall be considered for filling by eligible and qualifying candidates from the panel cum merit list from the same opportunity

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates are advised to register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the NAPS/NATS portals under the respective State as per their Trades
  • Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator) must register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
  • Technician Apprentice (Diploma) must register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Graduate Apprentice must register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Candidates need to LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings with the Establishment ID: NATS - EWBKOC000077, NAPS - E05201900011
  • Candidates MUST ensure their profile (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in application
  • Candidates have to apply for ANY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one discipline Code will not be considered
  • The candidature of the applicant would be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to his/her being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation
  • The decision of the Management will be final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the applications
  • Applications which are incomplete or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected"
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such apprentices
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and Mobile number which must be valid for at least 1 year as all future communications will take place through email alerts
  • Candidates must have PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, and Bank Account linked with Aadhar
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence shall be shared only on the website
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL-Non-Creamy Layer) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to their fulfilling the standards applicable to General category
  • Reservation for PwBD shall be applied on horizontal basis, across all categories, as per Government guidelines
  • PwBD are not eligible to apply for Discipline Code 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on NAPS/NATS Portal based on your category:
    • Trade Apprentice - ITI/Data Entry Operator: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
    • Technician Apprentice - Diploma: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Graduate Apprentice: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID
  • Step 3: Apply for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Marketing Division)-Eastern Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: EWBKOC000077
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E05201900011
  • Step 4: Ensure all profile details (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, aggregate percentage etc.) are appearing correctly in the application
  • Step 5: After applying on NAPS/NATS portal, candidates MUST also furnish few details including choice of 3 (three) locations for training and document verification through Microsoft Form at https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/4846hcLHPE latest by 09.01.2026
  • Step 6: Submit the application before the last date: 09.01.2026 @ 5:00 PM
  • Step 7: Keep scanned copies ready of the following documents:
    • 10th std/Matriculation certificate and marksheet as proof of Date of Birth
    • Marksheet and Certificate of prescribed Educational Qualification (ITI/Diploma/HSC/Graduation)
    • Caste certificate in prescribed central format (if applicable)
    • PwBD certificate in prescribed central format (if applicable)
    • EWS certificate in prescribed central format (if applicable)
    • PAN Card/Aadhar Card
    • Recent colour passport size photograph
    • Signature in blue ink
  • Important: Apply for only ONE DISCIPLINE CODE. Multiple applications will lead to rejection
  • Note: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted. Candidates must complete both NAPS/NATS application and Microsoft Form submission
  • For Queries: Contact via email at [email protected]

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

  • The company may introduce additional selection procedures such as written test / group discussion, and reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies or cancel the selection process.

  • Work experience will be reckoned based on documents enclosed by the candidate; candidates must enclose proper experience / service certificates or appointment/joining/relieving letters.
  • Age of applicants will be determined as per Matriculation/Class 10th certificate.
  • Incomplete, illegible or unsigned applications and applications not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected.
  • The company reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, use the panel/wait list for future vacancies, or cancel the advertisement/selection process without prior notice.
  • List of selected candidates and wait list/extended panel will be published on the company website under “Careers”.
  • Work performance of selected candidates will be reviewed periodically; re-engagement will depend on company requirements and performance, including discipline.
  • If any information or document submitted by a candidate is found to be incorrect, false or misrepresented, the candidate’s contract is liable to be terminated immediately.
  • Canvassing in any form, directly or indirectly, will lead to immediate disqualification from the selection process.
  • Any corrigendum to the advertisement and information regarding interview dates will be notified on the company website under “Careers”.
  • Applications received after the last date will not be entertained.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement or recruitment process shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts at Kolkata.

How to Apply

  • Download/obtain the prescribed Application Format (Annexure – A) given in the advertisement.
  • Fill in the Application Format completely, self-certify it and paste a recent colour passport size photograph without cap/hat (do not sign across the photograph).
  • Attach self-certified copies of Aadhar card, Matriculation certificate, valid caste/category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL, if applicable), minimum educational qualification degree/certificates, work experience/service certificates or appointment/joining/relieving letters and latest payslip (if applicable).
  • Scan the filled-in application form and all supporting documents together as a single PDF file.
  • Send the single PDF by e-mail to [email protected] within 15 (fifteen) days from the date of notification/publication of the advertisement in Employment News.
  • Mention clearly in the application the post applied for (Assistant Engineer – Civil/Mechanical/Electrical or Assistant Officer – HRM).
  • Ensure that a valid e-mail ID and mobile phone number are provided in the application form for communication regarding shortlisting, interviews and other updates.

DH&FWS Alipurduar NHM Various Posts 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for DH&FWS Alipurduar NHM Recruitment 2025 is 9 posts. All posts are unreserved (UR), one post each in the following designations:

  • District Manager Quality Assurance (QA) – 01 (UR)
  • District Consultant Quality Monitoring (QA) – 01 (UR)
  • District PPM Coordinator (NTEP) – 01 (UR)
  • TB HV (NTEP) – 01 (UR)
  • Dental Technician (NOHP) – 01 (UR)
  • Dental Hygienist (NOHP) – 01 (UR)
  • Psychiatric Nurse (NMHP) – 01 (UR)
  • Community Nurse (NMHP) – 01 (UR)
  • Physiotherapist (NPCDCS) – 01 (UR)

Note: Reservation/category details beyond UR are not specified for these posts; all are shown as UR in the notification.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • District Manager Quality Assurance (QA): MBBS/Dental/AYUSH/Nursing Graduate with Masters in Hospital Administration/Health Management (MHA – full time or equivalent) with 2 years’ experience in Public Health/Hospital Administration. Training/experience in NABH/ISO 9001:2000/Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen preferred; previous health quality experience an added advantage.
  • District Consultant Quality Monitoring (QA): Degree in Statistics with good academic record from a reputed University. Specialization in Biostatistics and experience in Health/Hospital preferred.
  • District PPM Coordinator (NTEP): Post Graduate in any discipline with one year experience in Communication/ACSM/PPP/Health projects/programme; permanent two-wheeler driving licence; working knowledge of computer.
  • TB HV (NTEP): Graduate in Science with minimum 1 year completed experience as MPW/LHV/ANM/Health Worker and certificate course in computer operations (minimum 2 months). Training course for MPW preferred.
  • Dental Technician (NOHP): 10+2 (Higher Secondary) with Physics, Chemistry, Biology from WBCHSE or equivalent; 2-year Diploma in Dental Technology from recognized institution; valid registration from West Bengal Dental Council; 1-year post-diploma experience in WB Govt. hospital or licensed clinical establishment.
  • Dental Hygienist (NOHP): Diploma in Dental Hygienist course from DCI recognized institution; valid registration from West Bengal Dental Council; at least 2 years’ experience in DCI recognized Dental College/CE registered clinic.
  • Psychiatric Nurse (NMHP): B.Sc in Psychiatric Nursing/M.Sc in Psychiatric Nursing/DPN; previous health/hospital experience preferred.
  • Community Nurse (NMHP): GNM from institution recognized by Nursing Council of India or West Bengal Nursing Council with 1 month training in Psychiatric Nursing from recognized institution; previous health/hospital experience preferred.
  • Physiotherapist (NPCDCS): Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years’ working experience in a hospital; Master degree in Physiotherapy preferred.

2. Age Limit (as on 01/01/2025)

  • District Manager QA & District Consultant Quality Monitoring: Upper age limit 40 years.
  • District PPM Coordinator (NTEP): Minimum 21 years, Maximum 40 years.
  • TB HV (NTEP): Minimum 21 years, Maximum 40 years.
  • Dental Technician (NOHP): 18 to 40 years.
  • Dental Hygienist (NOHP): 22 to 40 years.
  • Psychiatric Nurse (NMHP): Upper age limit 40 years.
  • Community Nurse (NMHP): Upper age limit 40 years.
  • Physiotherapist (NPCDCS): Upper age limit 40 years.
  • Age Relaxation: For reserved candidates as per existing norms (ToR) of Government of West Bengal.

3. Other Conditions

  • The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal.
  • The applicant must have knowledge of local languages.
  • All essential qualifications must be completed within the date of application; experience is counted after acquiring the required qualification.

Selection Process

  • District Manager QA & District Consultant Quality Monitoring: Total 250 marks – Written Examination (200), Computer Skill Test (40), Interview (10).
  • District PPM Coordinator (NTEP): Merit-based scoring (Class X, XII, Graduation, Post Graduation, Social Science/Mass Media/Communication/Rural Development qualifications, length of experience in Govt/Pvt, Computer Test) as per detailed table in notification.
  • TB HV (NTEP): Merit-based scoring (Class X, XII, Graduation, MPW training, experience in Govt/Pvt, Computer Test) as per notification.
  • Dental Technician (NOHP): Total 100 marks – Class XII, Diploma in Dental Technology, higher qualification, experience (1 mark per completed year upto 5), Written Test, Interview.
  • Dental Hygienist (NOHP): Total 100 marks – Class X, XII, Diploma in Dental Hygienist, experience slabs (2–4+ years), Interview.
  • Psychiatric Nurse (NMHP) & Community Nurse (NMHP): Total 100 marks – Educational qualification (60, proportionate), experience slabs (upto 1 year, 1–2 years, above 2 years – 25 marks), Interview (15).
  • Physiotherapist (NPCDCS): Total 50 marks – Class X, XII, Bachelor in Physiotherapy, Master in Physiotherapy (additional), experience slabs in Govt/Pvt, Interview (5).
  • Selection will be conducted by District Level Selection Committee (DLSC), Alipurduar; DLSC & DH&FWS reserve the right to cancel recruitment at any stage.

Application Fee

  • Rs. 100/- (one hundred) for UR and EWS categories.
  • Rs. 50/- (fifty) for reserved categories.
  • Fee is non-refundable and to be paid via Demand Draft in favour of “DH & FWS, ALIPURDUAR, NON NHM ACCOUNT”, payable at Alipurduar.
  • No other mode of payment (Money order, Cheque, Cash etc.) will be accepted.

How To Apply

  • Apply online through www.wbhealth.gov.in under “e-governance (Online recruitment)”.
  • Fill in the online application form correctly and upload proper photograph and signature; incomplete or improperly filled forms will be rejected.
  • Take a printout of the filled online application.
  • Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents (age proof, educational qualifications, experience certificates, caste/EWS certificate, address proof etc.).
  • Enclose the original Demand Draft of applicable fee.
  • Send the hard copy of application along with all documents and DD by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier only to: Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health & Member Secretary, DH & FWS, Babupara, Maya Talkies Road, Ward No-12, District-Alipurduar, Pin: 736121.
  • Hard copy must reach by 02/01/2026 within 5:00 pm; applications by hand will not be accepted and department is not responsible for postal delay.
  • Visit www.wbhealth.gov.in (Recruitment section) and www.alipurduar.gov.in regularly for updates/instructions.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 19/12/2025
Starting date of Form fill up 20/12/2025 from 12.00 am
Last date of Registration 29/12/2025 (midnight)
Last date of Final Submission of Form 31/12/2025 (midnight)
Last date of receiving Hard Copy & Demand Draft 02/01/2026 up to 5:00 pm

Salary/Stipend

  • District Manager Quality Assurance (QA): Rs. 40,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).
  • District Consultant Quality Monitoring (QA): Rs. 35,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).
  • District PPM Coordinator (NTEP): Rs. 26,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).
  • TB HV (NTEP): Rs. 18,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).
  • Dental Technician (NOHP): Rs. 22,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).
  • Dental Hygienist (NOHP): Rs. 22,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).
  • Psychiatric Nurse (NMHP): Rs. 28,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).
  • Community Nurse (NMHP): Rs. 25,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).
  • Physiotherapist (NPCDCS): Rs. 25,000/- per month (increment as per NHM Guidelines).

Instructions

  • The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and must have knowledge of local languages.
  • Application forms not properly filled in or incomplete will be cancelled; mismatch between application data and original documents will lead to cancellation.
  • If proper signature and photograph are not uploaded, the application is liable to be cancelled.
  • Any omission/suppression of information will lead to rejection of candidature at any stage.
  • Age will be calculated with respect to 1st January of the year of publication of the recruitment notice (01/01/2025).
  • Original Passport/Aadhaar Card/Voter ID will only be accepted as address proof.
  • Caste and EWS certificates must be issued by competent authorities of West Bengal; OBC certificates must clearly mention Category ‘A’ or ‘B’ and be revalidated where applicable.
  • All marks are to be calculated excluding additional subject; no rounding off; proportionate marking up to 2 decimal places.
  • If aggregate marks after final selection are equal, preference goes to the older candidate (senior in age as on 1st day of the year of advertisement).
  • Recruitment panel will be valid for one year from approval date and vacancies may be filled from the panel within that period.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for selection/test/interview.
  • The decision of the competent authority regarding recruitment is final.

Educational Qualifications

Experience

  • Leave: 10 days leave in a year subject to prior approval
  • Income Tax/GST: Dealt as per applicable provisions under Income Tax/GST Act

  • Walk-in Interview Time: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM
  • Venue: Office of CMO I/c (M&HS), DSP Main Hospital, Durgapur-713205, Paschim Bardhaman, West Bengal

ITI Limited Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 215 Contract Posts

Advertisement

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates wishing to apply for the Young Professional posts must ensure that they fulfil the required eligibility criteria in terms of educational qualification, relevant experience and age as prescribed by ITI Limited in the notification. Educational Qualification

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.
