Selection Process

  • Candidates who submit the online application within the prescribed last date will be called for a physical standard and physical test which will be qualifying in nature.
  • Those who qualify in the physical standard and physical test will be called for the written Test.
  • The final merit list will be prepared on the basis of the performance of the candidates in the competitive written examination /test only.

General Information/Instructions

  • The applicant must be a citizen of India.
  • CSIR-CMERI will not undertake detailed scrutiny of applications for the eligibility and other aspects before Physical and Personality Assessment Test / Written Examination and, therefore, candidature of each of the applicant will be purely provisional. Candidates must go through the requirements of essential qualification (EQ), experience, age, physical and medical standards etc. and satisfy themselves that they are eligible for the post. The scanned copies of the certificates/documents in support of their Educational Qualifications, Caste/Category, Essential Experience, previous employment, ‘No Objection Certificate’ from present employer etc. are required to be uploaded on the online portal while applying for the post. The document verification of the certificates of EQ, essential experience, caste/ category, etc., will be conducted / carried out at later stage and if during the verification, it is found that the candidate does not possess the required essential qualification, etc. as per the advertisement or any claim made in the application is not substantiated by certificates/ documents, the candidature of candidate will be cancelled. No enquiry for clarification as to eligibility will be entertained.
  • Date of Birth filled by the candidate in the online application form and the same recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate will only be accepted for determining the age and no subsequent request for change will be considered or granted.
  • The candidate should mention, in the online application, all the qualifications and experience in the relevant area supported by documents and ensure that all details are complete and accurate. The candidates must fill in their Name, Date of Birth, and father’s name/mother’s name in the online application strictly as given in the SSC/Matriculation/10th Standard certificate. In case, a candidate claims a change of his/her name after matriculation or marriage or remarriage or divorce etc., then it should also be mentioned in the respective field in the online application and the Candidate claiming a change in name must submit a copy of Gazette Notification/Affidavit from the appropriate authority in support of change of name/mismatch in name/ variation in name of candidate/ parents (if applicable).
  • The period of experience rendered by a candidate on part time basis, daily wages etc will not be counted while calculating the valid experience for the post.
  • The prescribed qualification should have been obtained through recognized Institutions, etc. The prescribed essential qualifications are the minimum mentioned against the post. Mere possession of the same does not entitle a candidate to be called for Physical test and/or written test for selection. If on verification either before or after at any of the stages of selection process, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any of the eligibility conditions, his/her candidature/selection will be summarily rejected/cancelled forthwith.
  • The candidate should ensure to submit her/his application complete in all respect along with the required certificates/documents in support of relevant educational qualification, caste/ community, age, experience, discharge book, etc., as attachments.
  • Incomplete applications i.e. application without photograph or unclear photograph, unsigned application, without application fee (wherever applicable), etc. and without required documents / certificates/ undertaking in support of claims made by the candidates in the Online application form, are liable to be rejected. Any discrepancy found between the information given in application and as evident in original documents will make the candidate ineligible for the post.
  • If any document/Certificate furnished is in a language other than Hindi or English, a transcript thereof in Hindi/English of the same duly attested by a Gazetted Officer or Notary has to be submitted.
  • Applicants working in Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings and government funded Research Agencies, etc. as a regular employee must inform their department or office and upload a ‘NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE’ (NOC) from their present employer at the time of submitting the online application (as per attached format), failing which their candidature will NOT be considered.
  • The decision of the CSIR-CMERI/ CSIR in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, action for furnishing false information/claims, mode of selection and conduction of physical/ written test, etc. will be final and binding on the candidates. CSIR-CMERI reserves the right to cancel the advertisement or reserves the right not to fill up the post without assigning any reason thereof.
  • The selection process is subject to the CSIR/GoI instructions prevalent at a given point of time during various stages of selection process.
  • This is to be noted that, if any declaration given or information furnished by a candidate is found to be false or if he/she is found to have willfully suppressed any material information, his/her candidature may be cancelled at any stage and/or he/she will be liable to removal from service even after joining and such other action(s) as deemed necessary may be taken by the Competent Authority.
  • The incumbent shall be placed on probation for a specified period from the date of his joining the post. The probationary period may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Competent Authority. After successful completion of the probationary period, he/ she will be considered for continuation in accordance with the extant rules.
  • Applicant must disclose as to whether any of his/her close or blood relative(s) is/are employee(s) of CSIR-CMERI or CSIR or any other laboratory/ Institute of CSIR, in the Application Form.
  • Candidates shall not be reimbursed / paid any Travelling Allowance / Daily Allowance for appearing for Physical/ Written test.
  • The recruitment for the above post is governed by the rules for Isolated Category of staff as amended from time to time. Hence all other terms and conditions not stipulated herein will be applicable as per the said Recruitment Rules.
  • The selected candidate shall serve under the administrative control of the Director of the Institute.
  • Canvassing in any form and /or bringing in any influence political or otherwise will be treated as a disqualification for the post.
  • Further, notifications regarding selection, details of eligible candidates to be called for physical test and written examination and any updates/ subsequent information / notification / corrigendum / addendum regarding this recruitment drive shall be notified on the CSIR-CMERI website only. Hence, applicants are advised to visit regularly the Institute website i.e. https://www.cmeri.res.in.
  • The Director, CSIR-CMERI reserves the right to cancel the advertisement, amend, delete and add terms & conditions to this Advertisement without assigning any reason thereof.
  • NO INTERIM ENQUIRY OR CORRESPONDENCE WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online through CSIR-CMERI official website http://www.cmeri.res.in only. No other mode of application will be considered.
  • If a candidate does not have a valid E-mail ID, he/she should create a new valid e-mail ID before applying online. Candidate must enter his/her correct and active e-mail ID and mobile number in the online application, as communication shall be made by the CSIR-CMERI through this number / email ID only. The registered email address should be active till the completion of recruitment process.
  • For online application process please refer “How-to-apply online” instructions, “Fee Payment Procedure’, etc. available on the above- mentioned website. Candidates are advised to go through the instructions for filling of the online application carefully.
  • The online application is to be submitted in six distinct steps, as below: a. Registration b. Primary Details c. Educational and Employment details d. Online Payment e. Upload Certificate details f. Application submission
  • The deadlines for the above-mentioned stages of application are as follows: -  Start Date for commencement of submission of Online application: 06.12.2025 at 10:00 AM.  Last Date for submission of Online application: 05.01.2026 at 05.00 PM.
  • The Candidate is required to upload his/her recent passport size scanned colour photograph, signature and also relevant certificates at the specified places in the online application portal. In case the face in the photograph is blurred or unclear or signature or essential documents uploaded is unclear / smudged, the candidate’s application shall be rejected.
  • If a candidate submits multiple online applications using different email ID, only the last completed application will be considered. Candidates should retain a copy of the application print-out and the payment details for their records.
  • The candidate must register with his/her name, email ID. After successful registration, the candidate can log in using his/her credentials to apply through the Online Application Portal. Once the application form is completed, the candidate can upload all relevant supporting documents and verify the application to ensure it is accurate and complete. After finalizing the application, the candidate must click 'Submit' button and upload/enter the payment details, if applicable, to successfully submit the application form. Once the application is submitted, no further modifications or amendments will be permitted. It is important to keep a printout of the completed application form. Eligibility Criteria for WBMSC Assistant Engineer (Civil) 2025

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering from recognized University or equivalent from a recognized university/board to apply for WBMSC Assistant Engineer positions.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for WBMSC Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Maximum Age: 36 years
  • Age Relaxation: As per government norms (SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen)
  • Age calculation date: As mentioned in official notification

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens or as specified in the official notification.

Selection Process for WBMSC Assistant Engineer (Civil) 2025

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

The Examination will be held in Kolkata center only and in two successive stages, viz. (1)     Written Test (Multiple choice Objective type) (2) Personality Test, as detailed below:    

(1) Written Test: 200 marks    

The OMR based Written Examination of 200 marks consisting of 100 multiple choices,     objective type questions carrying 02 (two) marks each will be conducted. There will be negative marking of 01 (one) mark each for every incorrect / wrong answer. Question will be set in English and time     allowed will be 1 & ½ (One & half) hours.    

(2) Personality Test: 40 marks    

The Personality test will be held at the Commission's office in Kolkata. Based on merit.     candidates of 3 (three) times the number of vacancies, will be called for Personality test subject to     verification of original documents and obtaining qualifying marks @ 45% for General Candidates, a 40% for O.B.C. & EWS Candidates and @ 35% for S.C., S.T. & PWD candidates. The Commission shall have discretion to relax qualifying marks of any or all categories of candidate applied for the examination. After the said verification, eligible candidates will be allowed to appear for Interview / Personality Test. The candidature of the candidates absenting themselves on the date of Interview / Personality test will be cancelled without making any reference to them.    

Final merit list will be prepared on the basis of total marks obtained by the candidates in the written examination and Personality test.If more than one candidate obtains the same aggregate (total marks), the merit position of the Candidates shall be determined according to their date of birth, i.c., candidates with earlier date of birth shall be preferred and if the aggregate marks and also the date of birth be the same the candidates obtaining higher marks in Written Examination shall be preferred.    

Application Fee for WBMSC Assistant Engineer (Civil) 2025

  • Application fee for U.R., EWS & O.B.C candidates are Rs. 150-00 (Rupees One hundred and fifty) plus Processing Charges Rs. 50-00 (Rupees Fifty) i.e., Rs. 200-00 (Rupees Two hundred) only.
  • For SC, S.T. & P.W.D candidates only Processing Charges Rs. 50=00 (Rupees Fifty) to be paid.
  • No exemption of fee is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates of other states.

Eligible candidates can apply online for WBMSC Assistant Engineer (Civil) 2025 by following these steps:

For Manager-Law in Grade/Scale-II

  • Essential Qualification: A Bachelor Degree in Law (LLB) and enrolled as an advocate with Bar Council.
  • Marks Required: A candidate must have minimum 50% of marks in Graduation & Post Graduation examination.
  • Experience: Two years as an officer in a Bank or Financial Institution OR Minimum experience of 3 Years of practicing as an Advocate independently or with the Law Firm of good repute before a district or High court out of which 1-year experience of working as Law Officer in Bank or FI's.
  • Desirable: Candidates with Master's degree will be given preference.

For Manager-Security Officer in Grade/Scale-II

  • Essential Qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized University or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate.
  • Experience: Minimum 05 years' Experience as an Officer in Indian Army/Navy/Air force not below the rank of Captain (In Army and subsequent in other forces) OR Minimum 05 years' Experience as an Officer in Paramilitary not below the rank of Deputy Commandant.

Salary/Stipend

  • Customer Service Associate (CSA): Pay Scale: 24050-1340/3-28070-1650/3-33020-2000/4-41020-2340/7-57400-4400/1-61800-2680/1-64480
  • Officers in Grade/Scale-I: Pay Scale: 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920
  • Managers in Grade/Scale-II: Pay Scale: 64820-2340/1-67160-2680-10/93960

  • Customer Service Associate (CSA): Minimum 21 years, Maximum 32 years
  • Probationary Officers and Specialist Officers in Grade/Scale-I (Posts 2-9): Minimum 21 years, Maximum 32 years

  • Manager-Risk in Grade/Scale-II: Minimum 25 years, Maximum 35 years
  • Manager-Chartered Accountant (CA) in Grade/Scale-II: Minimum 25 years, Maximum 40 years
  • Manager-Law in Grade/Scale-II: Minimum 25 years, Maximum 40 years
  • Manager-Security Officer in Grade/Scale-II: Not more than 45 years of age

Application Fee

  • For CSA: Rs. 1000.00 (Rupees one thousand only) including GST
  • For Scale I & II: Rs. 1500.00 (Rupees one thousand five hundred only) including GST
  • Bank Transaction charges for Online Payment of application fees/intimation charges will have to be borne by the candidate
  • Application Fee is Non-Refundable

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 11-12-2025
Commencement of on-line registration of Application 12-12-2025
Closure of registration of application 01-01-2026
On-line Fee Payment 12-12-2025 to 02-01-2026
Tentative date Of Examination 18-01-2026

Selection Process

  • The selection process consists of Online Examination followed by Personal Interview.
  • The successful candidates in the Online written test will be called for an interview.
  • On selection of the candidates based on the online written test and interview, appointment letters will be issued for joining as CSA/PO/Specialist Cadre as the case may be subject to their being medically fit for assignment.
  • Online Examination for Customer Service Associate/Generalist Officer includes: Reasoning (40 questions, 40 marks, 35 minutes), English Language (40 questions, 40 marks, 35 minutes), General Awareness with special reference to Banking (40 questions, 40 marks, 20 minutes), Computer Knowledge (40 questions, 40 marks, 20 minutes), Quantitative Aptitude (40 questions, 40 marks, 35 minutes). Total: 200 questions, 200 marks, 145 minutes.
  • Online Examination for Specialist Officers includes: Reasoning (40 questions, 40 marks, 35 minutes), English Language (40 questions, 40 marks, 35 minutes), General Awareness with special reference to Banking (40 questions, 40 marks, 20 minutes), Professional Knowledge (40 questions, 40 marks, 20 minutes), Quantitative Aptitude (40 questions, 40 marks, 35 minutes). Total: 200 questions, 200 marks, 145 minutes.
  • Penalty for wrong answer: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Number of Answer choices per question: 5 Options.
  • All tests will be in English language only.
  • Cutoffs are applied in two stages: on scores in individual tests and on Total Score.

General Information/Instructions

Indemnity Bond

  • On selection, the candidates shall execute the Indemnity Bond before joining in Bank's service as Officer/Clerk.
  • Customer Service Associate (CSA): Bond Amount Rs. 1.5 Lakhs for 02 years
  • Grade/Scale I & II: Bond Amount Rs. 3.00 Lakhs for 02 years
  • In case the candidate resigns or leaves or abandons the service before completion of the specified period, he/she will indemnify the Bank for the amount of Bond costs, charges and expenses incurred by the Bank.

Identity Verification

  • In the examination hall as well as at the time of interview, the call letter along with original and a photocopy of the candidate's currently valid photo identity should be submitted to the invigilator for verification.
  • Valid photo identity proofs: PAN Card/Passport/Permanent Driving License/Voter's Card/Bank Passbook with photograph/Photo identity proof issued by a Gazette Officer on official letterhead along with photograph/Photo identity proof issued by a People's Representative on official letterhead along with photograph/valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognized College/University/Aadhar card/E-Aadhar Card with a photograph/Employee ID/Bar Council Identity Card with photograph.
  • Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid id proof.
  • Candidates must note that the name as appearing on the call letter should exactly match the name as appearing on the photo identity proof.
  • Female candidates who have changed first/last/middle name post marriage must take special note of this. In case of candidates who have changed their name, will be allowed only if they produce original Gazette notification/their original marriage certificate/affidavit in original.

Examination Centers

  • Online Exam for all posts will be conducted in centers at following locations: Haldwani Distt. Nainital (Uttarakhand), Dehradun (Uttarakhand), Roorkee (Uttarakhand), Bareilly (Uttar Pradesh), Meerut (Uttar Pradesh), Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh), Lucknow (Uttar Pradesh), Jaipur (Rajasthan), Delhi/NCR, Ambala (Haryana).
  • Candidates will have to choose any three centers of their preference and convenience.
  • No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/or add some other Centres, at its discretion.
  • Choice of center once exercised by the candidate will be final.

Multiple Applications

  • A candidate can apply for the Post of Customer Service Associate (CSA) and can also apply for the Post of Officers.
  • However, a candidate can apply for only one post in officer's cadre i.e. for Officer Scale-I (PO/SO) or Scale-II (PO/SO).
  • Candidates have to separately apply and pay application fees/intimation charges for each post for which they apply.
  • In case of multiple Applications for a post, only the latest valid (completed) application in each post will be retained and the application fee/intimation charges paid for the other multiple registrations will stand forfeited.

Guidelines for Persons with Disabilities

  • The visually impaired candidates and candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the online examination.
  • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination.
  • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.

Important Notes

  • The candidates can be posted/subsequently transferred to any of the existing/proposed Branches/Offices of the Bank as per Banking exigencies.
  • In case of experience, the relevant experience certificate must contain specifically experience in Bank/FIs related sector.
  • Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process partly/entirely at any time.
  • The Bank reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • The application fee once paid will NOT BE REFUNDED for any reason nor would be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.
  • Decision of the Bank in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate.
  • Candidates reporting late i.e. after the reporting time specified on the call letter for Examination will not be permitted to take the examination.
  • Candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including the time required for completion of various formalities.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 12.12.2025 to 01.01.2026 and no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates to go to the recruitment section of Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register application, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id.
  • A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), signature, left thumb impression and hand written declaration as per specifications.
  • The text for the hand written declaration is: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • After filling all details, click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details.
  • After registering online candidates are advised to take a printout of their system generated online application forms.
  • Call letters for online test can be downloaded from Bank's website www.nainitalbank.bank.in.
  • Intimation for downloading call letter will also be sent through e-mail/SMS.
  • Candidates need to affix recent recognizable photograph on the call letter and appear at the examination centre with Call Letter, Photo Identity Proof and Photocopy of the same Photo Identity Proof.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Educational Qualification: Must possess a Bachelor's degree of a University established by law in India or qualification recognized as equivalent thereto

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Typing Test (Qualifying/Mandatory): English Typing at minimum speed of 40 words per minute (corresponding to 12000 key-depressions per hour). Candidates not achieving this speed will be disqualified
  • Stage 2 - Shorthand Test: Candidates qualifying the typing test will appear for Shorthand Test
    • Speed: 100 words per minute in English
    • Maximum Marks: 120
    • Duration of Dictation: 07 minutes
    • Transcription Time: 45 Minutes (excludes 10 minutes for reading notes)
    • Maximum Admissible Mistakes: 7% of total dictated words (49 mistakes out of 700 words)
    • Marking: Full mistakes (1 mark deduction each), Half mistakes (0.5 mark deduction each)
  • Stage 3 - Written Examination: Paper I - General Knowledge and English Language
    • Total Marks: 80 Marks
    • Duration: 90 minutes
    • Part A - General Knowledge (40 marks): Indian History, Knowledge of Uttarakhand, General Science, Constitution of India, Current Affairs (Multiple Choice Questions)
    • Part B - English Language (40 marks):
      • Words, Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms: 10 marks
      • Grammar: 10 marks
      • Translation from English to Hindi: 10 marks
      • Precis writing in English: 10 marks
  • Negative Marking: For objective type questions, 1/4th mark will be deducted for each wrong answer
  • Final Merit List: Based on combined marks of Shorthand Test (120 marks) + Written Examination (80 marks) = Total 200 marks
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • General/EWS Category: 40% marks
    • OBC/SC/ST Category: 35% marks
  • Tie Breaker: In case of equal marks, preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of Hindi shorthand and typewriting
  • Examination Centre: Examination will be conducted at Examination Bhawan, UKPSC, Haridwar (Single Centre)

General Information/Instructions

  • Nationality: No person shall be appointed unless he/she is a citizen of India
  • Character: Character must be suitable in all respects for appointment to the service
  • Marital Status: Male candidate having more than one wife living or female candidate married to a person already having a wife living shall not be eligible
  • Physical Fitness: Candidate must be in good mental and bodily health. Medical certificate of physical fitness required before final appointment
  • PWD Categories Identified: B, LV (Blindness/Low Vision), D, HH (Deaf/Hard of Hearing), OA, OL, OAL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV, MDy (Locomotor Disability categories), ASD(M), SLD, MI (Intellectual Disability), MD involving above categories
  • Typing Test Special Concession: Only OA, LV, PB, and B category PWD candidates will get 5 minutes extra time for 10 minutes typing test
  • Scribe Facility: Only LV and B category PWD candidates can avail scribe facility if requested in online application
  • Employment Exchange Registration: Candidates applying for Group C posts must be registered with Employment Exchange in Uttarakhand (with certain exceptions)
  • Uttarakhand Domicile: Candidates must have passed High School and Intermediate from recognized institutions in Uttarakhand State (with certain exceptions for government employees and permanent residents)
  • Multiple Applications: Only latest valid application will be retained, previous fees will be forfeited
  • Admit Card: Will be available for download from website, not sent by post
  • Document Verification: Original documents along with self-attested photocopies must be produced when called by Commission
  • Provisional Selection: Selection is provisional at every stage until final appointment
  • No Permanent Right: Selection does not confer any right to appointment unless government is satisfied after necessary verification
  • Uttarakhand Competitive Examinations Act 2023: Action will be taken as per this Act against any malpractice

How to Apply

  • Step 2: Read the advertisement carefully and check eligibility
  • Step 3: Go to ukpsc.net.in and click on "How to Apply" in Menu bar
  • Step 4: Click on "Apply Now" button after reading instructions

Date Description

General Information/Instructions

Accordingly, such candidates may choose to apply against the "UR" positions provided they meet the age criteria applicable to General category candidates and indicate their category as "General". Relevant list can be viewed at http://www.ncbc.nic.in. Accordingly, for claiming the benefit of OBC (NCL) category, candidate should submit & shall subsequently produce his/her latest caste certificate in the proforma prescribed by Government of India, applicable for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Govt. of India/Central Government /Public Sector Undertaking, as contained in DOPT Memo No.36036/2/2013-Estt/(Res.) dated 30.05.2014 from a Competent Authority issued on or after 1st April 2025. Such certificate should specifically state the candidate does not belong to the persons/sections (creamy layer) as mentioned in column 3 of the schedule to the Department of Personnel & Training, Government of India OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt. (SC/ST) dated 08.09.1993 and modifications issued vide OM No. 36033/1/2013Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017. There is no application processing fee for SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Female category Candidates.
  • Before registering their application on the website, the candidates should possess the following:
  • Following are the specifications for uploading the documents –
  • Photo - Image should be of size 165 x 125 pixels in jpg/jpeg format and should not exceed 50 KB and not less than 20KB.
  • Sign - Image should be of size 80 x 125 pixels in jpg/jpeg format and should not exceed 20 KB and not less than 10KB.
  • Scanned copies of documents in support of age, date of birth, educational qualification, experience etc. (PDF File).
  • Provision to pay application fee plus bank processing charges plus GST is there. Candidates can opt to pay through internet banking/ credit/ debit card.
  • Valid & active Bank details such as Account Number, IFSC code, MICR code & PAN number for Reimbursement of Travelling Allowance.
  • On filling up the Online Application Form, the candidate should check the details that he/she has filled in and if any corrections are required, the same should be done. He/she has then to confirm the details by pressing the “Submit Form” button after which no changes will be possible in the details provided. Then he/she is required to take a print of the application form. The candidates can also take the print out of application form later by submitting the application number in the link on the website under recruitment section. The Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) is inviting applications for the Scientific Officer positions through the OCES/DGFS 2026 recruitment. This prestigious program offers engineering graduates and science postgraduates the chance to join the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) through two distinct training schemes: the one-year Orientation Course for Engineering Graduates and Science Postgraduates (OCES-2026) and the two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for Engineering Graduates (DGFS-2026). Successful candidates will undergo intensive training, with a stipend of ₹74,000 per month during the training period. Upon appointment, they will be placed in Group-A posts with an attractive pay scale under the 7th CPC, totaling approximately ₹1,35,000 per month, along with various allowances.

This recruitment offers a unique opportunity to contribute to India's nuclear and atomic energy programs in various DAE units, such as BARC, IGCAR, and NPCIL. Candidates must meet specific educational qualifications, including a minimum of 60% marks in engineering or science degrees, and fulfill the age criteria (18 to 31 years). The selection process includes an online examination, GATE score-based shortlisting, and a final interview. Interested candidates can apply online from 22 December 2025 to 21 January 2026. This is an excellent opportunity for aspiring scientists to be part of a prestigious and impactful sector.

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

Credit Officer Eligibility Criteria 2025-26

Candidates willing to apply for Credit Officer posts must ensure that they fulfil the required Credit Officer Eligibility Criteria 2025-26 as specified by Bank of India. For all posts, candidates must indicate graduation percentage up to two decimals and convert CGPA/OGPA into percentage as per university norms. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC/PWD) applying for reserved vacancies are entitled to 5% relaxation wherever a minimum of 60% marks is prescribed, and should therefore have at least 55% marks.

Credit Officer Selection Process 2025-26

The Credit Officer selection is based on shortlisting candidates through an online examination and/or direct shortlisting followed by a personal interview. The screening focuses on assessing the candidate's reasoning, quantitative aptitude and professional knowledge in their selected discipline in addition to English language. Only those who qualify in the screening stage and rank sufficiently high in merit are invited for the interview.

The selection process is carried out in main stages as explained below.

1. Scrutiny and Shortlisting of Applications: Applications are shortlisted on the basis of documents uploaded in support of eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, category, etc.) at the time of registration. Only candidates whose documents clearly establish eligibility are taken forward for the online test and/or interview.

2. Online Examination:

  • Mode: Online objective test.
  • Structure: English Language (25 questions, 25 marks), Reasoning (25 questions, 25 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 25 marks), Professional Knowledge relevant to the post (75 questions, 75 marks); total 150 questions for 150 marks, composite time of 120 minutes.
  • Language: All tests except English are bilingual (English & Hindi); English Language test is only qualifying and its marks are not added in merit.
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum 35% in each test for General/EWS; SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates get 5% relaxation.
  • Negative Marking: 1/4th of the marks assigned to each question is deducted for every wrong answer; no penalty for unanswered questions.

3. Interview: Candidates who secure the minimum qualifying marks in the online tests and rank high in order of merit (category-wise) are called for a personal interview, generally in the ratio of about 1:3 to the number of vacancies. The interview carries 100 marks with minimum qualifying marks of 50% for General/EWS and 45% for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates.

Final Merit: If both online exam and interview are conducted, final merit is prepared by combining scores of online examination (Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude and Professional Knowledge) and interview in a 70:30 ratio, subject to candidates qualifying in both stages. If the online exam is not conducted, selection will be based solely on interview marks in descending order of merit up to the number of vacancies.

The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Nagpur, Department of Anatomy, has released a recruitment notice for a DBT-sponsored project titled “Establishment of DBT NIDAN KENDRA at AIIMS Nagpur". This Recruitment 2025 drive invites applications for three key positions: Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Laboratory Technician, and Project Coordinator. A total of 03 vacancies are available purely on a temporary and contractual basis. Candidates must apply online via a specific Google Form link before the last date of 30/12/2025.

Successful applicants will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 23,200/- to Rs. 60,000/- per month, depending on the position. The appointment duration is initially 12 months, with renewal based on performance evaluation by the project investigator.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Medical Officer (02 posts): Essential: MBBS degree from recognized University; (2) One year experience in Hospital after completion of one-year internship. Desirable: A post graduate medical degree from a recognized University.
  • Physician: Essential: MD General Medicine from recognized University; (2) Post-qualification experience of three years in reputed hospital in the relevant field of specialization.
  • Anesthesiologist: Essential: MD Anaesthesia from recognized University with minimum three years’ experience; OR (2) Diploma in Anaesthesia with minimum five years’ experience.
  • Orthopaedician: Essential: MS Orthopaedics from recognized University with minimum three years’ experience; OR (2) Diploma in Orthopaedics with minimum five years’ experience.
  • Gynecologist: Essential: MD Obstetrics & Gynecology from recognized University with minimum three years’ experience; OR (2) Diploma in Gynecology with minimum five years’ experience.
  • Dietician: Essential:  B.Sc./Diploma in Nutrition and Dietetics or equivalent qualification from recognized University/Institution.
  • Biomedical Engineer: Essential: As printed in the PDF: B.Sc./Diploma in Nutrition and Dietetics or equivalent qualification from recognized University/Institution (noted as such in the advertisement text).
  • Cut-off date for age, qualifications and experience is 01 December 2025.
  • Candidates must possess the essential qualifications mentioned against the post; candidates not possessing certificate of essential qualifications will not be eligible.

Salary/Stipend

  • Medical Officers: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,00,000/-.
  • Physician: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,15,000/-.
  • Anesthesiologist: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,15,000/-.
  • Orthopaedician: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,15,000/-.
  • Gynecologist: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,15,000/-.
  • Dietician: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 60,000/-.
  • Biomedical Engineer: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 60,000/-.
  • Remuneration is subject to tax deducted at source; no other financial benefits will be admissible, and monthly remuneration will be based on day-to-day attendance certified by Head of Department/Hospital-in-charge.

Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 25 years for all advertised posts.
  • Maximum age: 45 years for all advertised posts.
  • No age, qualification or experience relaxation will be provided to any candidate, except that age or experience norms may be relaxed for deserving candidates who: (1) Belong to local Project Affected Persons (PAP) families of Jawaharlal Nehru Port Project, (2) Have valid Jawaharlal Nehru Port PAP certificate in their own name issued by competent authority, and (3) Provide a self-declaration, subject to scrutiny, that is found correct. No relaxation is permitted in essential educational qualification criteria.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

Important Dates

Event Date
Cut-off date for age, qualifications and experience 01/12/2025
Last date for receipt of applications 13/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made on the basis of performance in one or more rounds of trade test and/or oral interview, experience, additional qualifications etc.
  • Selection of shortlisted candidates will be subject to verification of required documents in original as indicated in the advertisement.
  • Non-submission of requisite documents during verification will disqualify candidature from further participation; if documents do not meet prescribed criteria, candidature will not be considered further.
  • JNPA reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates for the selection process, by short-listing with reference to qualifications, age, relevant experience etc.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications shall be accepted only by post/speed post/registered post/courier during working hours; the envelope must clearly mention “Application for the post of ___(Mention the post name)___”.
  • Applications should reach on or before 13/01/2026 to: Deputy General Manager (P&IR) I/c, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, Navi Mumbai – 400707.
  • Along with application, details must be given in prescribed format, with self-attested photocopies of proof of age, qualifications, experience, training, caste, PWD certificate, Ex-Servicemen discharge book (as applicable) and a passport size photograph.
  • A valid local Jawaharlal Nehru Port Project Affected Persons candidate will be given preference in selection process, subject to fulfillment of essential criteria.
  • List of documents to attach and produce at verification includes: proof of date of birth; proof of nationality; mark-sheets and certificates of educational qualifications and other eligibility documents; experience certificates on company letterhead; APARs/experience/service certificates; disability certificate where applicable.
  • Applicants should be of sound health and meet medical standards; engagement is subject to fitness certificate/medical report from Government recognized reputed Hospital.
  • If at any stage it is found that a candidate does not fulfill eligibility criteria or has furnished incorrect/false information or suppressed material facts, candidature will be cancelled; if detected after joining, services are liable to be terminated and candidate debarred from future JNPA recruitments.
  • JNPA does not assume responsibility for applications received after last date; such applications will be rejected without reasons.
  • Candidates must clearly mention valid mobile number and email address in application for correspondence; no other mode of correspondence will be accepted.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSUs must produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview/verification; selected candidates must produce unconditional relieving letter at joining.
  • No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in interview/document verification.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness and service/conduct rules of JNPA; JNPA decisions on eligibility, number of posts, conduct of tests and selection are final.
  • Any legal proceedings will be instituted only in Mumbai; courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai shall have sole jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates will be governed by terms and conditions of service and other regulations of JNPA in force; no claim for benefits at par with regular employees except as explicitly provided will be entertained.
  • JNPA reserves the right to cancel the recruitment exercise at any stage without assigning reasons; in case of discrepancies, detailed advertisement/corrigendum on JNPA website Career section shall be final; canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted only by post/speed post/registered post/courier in working hours.
  • On the envelope, candidates must clearly mention “Application for the post of ___(Mention the post name)___”.
  • Applications should reach the Deputy General Manager (P&IR) I/c, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, Navi Mumbai – 400707, on or before 13/01/2026.
  • Applicants must use the prescribed proforma, providing full personal details, address, contact numbers, present employment details, date of birth, age as on 01/12/2025, category, educational qualifications, and details of employment/experience in chronological order.

Instructions

The suppression of any material fact will be treated in same manner.
  • No complaint/grievance of any candidate shall be entertained or heard by the High Court in case of failure on his/her part to view/ download/print the Hall Ticket/Admit Card within the stipulated time. Eligibility Criteria

  • Educational Qualification (General Requirement): B.E/B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering (4 years course) from recognised Institute/University/College in the following Engineering disciplines – Mechanical Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Electrical and Electronics Engineering.

  • Degree & Marks Proof: Candidates have to compulsorily attach Provisional/Final Degree Certificate as proof of completion of Degree with indication of Class and percentage of marks. Where CGPA/DGPA/OGPA/letter grade is followed, proof of percentage issued by University/Institution/College and awarded class must be submitted.
  • Trainee Engineer-I – Qualification: B.E/B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering degree (4 years course) in Mechanical discipline with PASS Class.
  • Trainee Engineer-I – Experience: 0–1 year industrial experience as on 01.12.2025.

Academic/Teaching/Research work, experience in non-profit organizations, internships/project work placements as part of academic curriculum and work experience prior to completion of B.E/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg) will not be considered as relevant post qualification experience.
  • Experience Documentation: Candidates should possess experience certificates/documents issued by previous and present employer clearly indicating period of employment and post held; work experience indicated without supporting documents will not be considered and is liable to be rejected/cancelled.

Salary/Stipend

  • Trainee Engineer-I – Consolidated Remuneration: Rs.30,000/- per month.
  • Trainee Engineer-I – Additional Benefits: Rs.12,000/- per year towards insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, footwear allowance, etc.
  • Trainee Engineer-I – Tenure: Initially engaged for a period of two years which may be extended for one more year based on project requirement and individual’s performance, totaling a maximum of three years. Alternatively, Trainee Engineer-II may be advanced to Project Engineer-I subject to performance assessment scores, discipline etc. (as structured in the remuneration table).
  • Project Engineer-I – Consolidated Remuneration: 1st year – Rs.40,000/- per month; 2nd year – Rs.45,000/- per month; 3rd year – Rs.50,000/- per month; 4th year – Rs.55,000/- per month.
  • Project Engineer-I – Additional Benefits: Rs.12,000/- per year towards insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, footwear allowance, etc.
  • Project Engineer-I – Retention Bonus: Project Engineer-I who complete overall tenure of 4 years will be entitled for retention bonus of Rs.25,000/- for every completed year, payable at the end of 4 years (total Rs.1,00,000/-).

  • Trainee Engineer-I: The upper age limit should not be more than 28 years for General & EWS candidates as on 01.12.2025.

  • Tie-Breaking: In case of tie in marks, the overall percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying degree shall be considered to determine merit.
  • Centre for Selection Process: Selection process will be done at Navi Mumbai; no request for change of examination centre/venue will be entertained after final submission of online application form. BEL Management reserves the right to cancel or add any centre depending upon response and administrative feasibility.
  • Shortlisting & Final Selection Publication: Names of candidates shortlisted for written test and final selection will be notified on the company’s website.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: For General/EWS/OBC-NCL – 35% in written test and 35% in interview. For SC/ST/PwBD – 30% in written test and 30% in interview. Relaxation in minimum qualifying marks will be provided subject to vacancy in respective category in that particular discipline.

General Information/Instructions

  • Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) is a Navaratna Company and a premier Indian Public Limited Company in professional electronics with a portfolio of over 350 different products in areas such as Military Radars, Naval Systems, Electro-Optics, Weapon & Fire Control Communication, Homeland Security, Strategic Communication & Unmanned Systems.
  • BEL Navi Mumbai will conduct pre-registered walk-in selections for the notified posts on temporary basis; candidates must be willing to work in any location as decided by BEL Management and should be ready to travel frequently to various locations.
  • Only Indian nationals can apply for the posts.
  • The number of posts indicated may vary based on the actual requirement at the time of selection; application forms incomplete, not in prescribed format, or without required enclosures will be summarily rejected without assigning any reason and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Candidates are required to possess at least one valid E-mail ID, to be kept active for at least one year; all correspondence shall be done through email only and BEL will not be responsible for bouncing/non-receipt of e-mails.
  • Applications without fee payment (except for SC/ST/PwBD) will be rejected/cancelled without any prior intimation.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of document verification or at any stage; if any document/information is found false, incorrect or not conforming to eligibility criteria, candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at any stage including after joining.
  • There will be no separate communication to candidates on their non-selection at any stage; decision of BEL in all matters regarding eligibility, stages of scrutiny, qualification and other norms will be final and binding.
  • Relaxation and concession will be applicable to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD as per Government directives.
  • Selected candidates are required to be covered under medical insurance scheme for a sum of Rs.2 lakhs per annum for medical cover and Rs.5 lakhs for life cover and submit the same at the time of joining.
  • BEL reserves the right to debar/disqualify any candidate at any stage of the selection process for any reason whatsoever and to change (cancel/modify/add) any of the criteria, method of selection and number of posts based on actual requirement without further notice.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • BEL has a robust and transparent recruitment process and does not demand or charge any fee or request for money deposits at any stage of the recruitment process other than the application fee mentioned; the company is not liable for any loss from fraudulent communications and reserves the right to take legal action including criminal action against such fraudsters.

  • The last date to submit the online application is 06.01.2026.
  • Candidates are required to read all the instructions given in the advertisement and enter all information correctly in the application form and verify the same before submission, as changes shall not be permitted after submission of the application form.
  • In case a candidate submits more than one application for the same post, the application against which bank receipt is deposited shall only be considered; if two applications with bank receipts are submitted for the same post, the application with latest registration number shall only be considered.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post have to fill separate application forms with separate payment receipts for each post.
  • Candidates already working as Project Engineer-I in one of the Units of BEL (as on 01.12.2025) are not eligible to apply for the above posts. Candidates working as Trainee Engineers who have completed minimum one year (as on 01.12.2025) in BEL and fulfilling eligibility criteria can apply for Project Engineer-I, but must submit prior intimation to their respective SBU/Unit HR.
  • Documents to be submitted at the time of Walk-in Selection:

BMC Laboratory Assistant 2025 Vacancy Details

The notification invites applications for 1 post of Prayogshala Sahayak (Laboratory Assistant) in the establishment of Seth A.J.B. Municipal Ear, Nose & Throat Hospital under Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation. This is an “Ekaki” (single) post in Group ‘C’, and as per circular MBC/1259 dated 13.04.2004 (Amendment 8, clause 3(1)(gha)), reservation does not apply to this isolated post.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • The candidate must be a B.Sc. (Science) graduate in a subject as specified (ravidnyan shakhichi B.Sc.) from a recognized institution.
  • He/She must be working as Laboratory Attendant (Prayogshala Parichar) in the establishments of:
    – Major Municipal Hospitals,
    – New & Medical Colleges,
    – Public Health Departments,
    – Pr. V.A. (Kha.Pra.Ma.A.Se.) and Pr. V.A. (Rav.Ru.) as specified in the notification.
  • For B.Sc. degree holders – at least 1 year of service as Laboratory Attendant is required.
    Otherwise (if not B.Sc. Science branch as above) – 2 years of service as Laboratory Attendant is required, as per approved rules.
  • Candidates must pass the departmental Vyavsay Chachani (Trade Test) conducted for the post of Prayogshala Sahayak.
  • Computer qualification: Candidate must possess DOEACC Society’s CCC / O Level / A Level / B Level / C Level certificate OR Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education MS-CIT OR GE.C.T. certificate OR any other government-approved course in computer handling/usage of at least 2 years as per Government orders.
  • Language: Candidate must have passed Secondary School Certificate (SSC) or equivalent with Marathi (50 marks question paper) as higher/lower level, and must be able to read, write and speak Marathi. Note: Those appointed before 06.11.2009 must be able to read, write and speak Marathi even without SSC language paper condition as per note.

2. Experience

  • Service in the cadre of Laboratory Attendant (Prayogshala Parichar) in the concerned BMC establishments as per the approved note:
    – 1 year post for B.Sc. Science branch degree holders, OR
    – 2 years for others as Laboratory Attendant.
  • Experience must be duly verified from the service record and certified by the concerned department head and service record officer.

3. Disability Criteria (Divyang Reservation Matrix)

  • The notification includes a Divyang post suitability table mentioning physical requirements such as sitting, standing, walking, bending, finger manipulation, reading/writing, seeing, hearing and communication, and Divyang categories like Deaf/Hard of Hearing, One Arm/One Leg/Both Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness and Multiple Disabilities.
  • It clarifies that Divyang candidates who can perform the duties of Laboratory Assistant (test sample handling, record-keeping, coordinating laboratory work and assisting laboratory technologists) as per the specified physical criteria may apply. However, this is an isolated post and reservation benefit does not apply; Divyang candidates will be considered as general if otherwise eligible.

Selection Process

  • The selection will be based on a Vyavsay Chachani (Trade Test), which is only a qualifying test.
  • Applications received through proper channel will be scrutinized, and eligible candidates will be called for Trade Test as per departmental schedule.
  • Candidates who qualify the Trade Test will be placed before a Selection Committee, which will consider:
    – Confidential Reports (Gopaniya Ahwal) of last 5 years,
    – Service record, inquiry reports and other documents,
    – Seniority in service (Sevajyeshtha) determined from date of entry into service and cadre as per circular MPM/03/2781 dated 07.04.2010 and related instructions.
  • Final selection will be made strictly on service seniority amongst Trade Test qualified candidates, and appointment orders will be issued as per committee’s recommendations.
  • If two or more candidates have the same date of entry and equal seniority, tie-breaking will be done by:
    – Giving preference to the candidate senior in age (higher date of birth priority),
    – If date of birth is also same, preference will be decided on the alphabetical order of the initial letter of the surname.

Application Fee

  • No application fee has been mentioned in the notification for the post of Prayogshala Sahayak.

How To Apply

  • Only eligible in-service BMC employees working as Laboratory Attendant in specified hospitals/colleges/departments may apply in the prescribed departmental format attached with the notification.
  • Applications must be filled legibly in Marathi with the candidate’s own handwriting and signed clearly.
  • Candidates must route their applications through their concerned department/ward head and Service Record Officer (Seva-abhilekh) as per rules.
  • Service details must be verified and certified; the application should bear the inward/outward number of the department and be forwarded to:
    Pramukh Vaidhakiya Adhikari, Seth A.J.B. Mahanagarpalika Kan Nak Ghsa Rugnalay, Prashaskiye Karyalaya, 7, Mahatma (Phule) Marg, Fort, Mumbai – 400001.
  • Applications must reach the office from 22.12.2025 to 09.01.2026 during working hours only.
  • Applications received before or after this period, applications sent by Speed Post, ordinary post, tapal or courier directly, incomplete applications, applications not as per prescribed format, or without the employee’s signature will not be accepted.
  • Candidates must attach the following attested documents with their application:
    – Service verification in prescribed Form-B (two copies),
    – Inquiry certificates based on service record and SAP system,
    – Confidential reports of last 5 years,
    – Caste certificate & Caste Validity Certificate where applicable,
    – Non-Creamy Layer certificate/validity as applicable,
    – Pay slips/pay fixation order & Municipal ID card,
    – Initial appointment order in BMC service,
    – Marriage registration and Gazette notification for name change (if applicable),
    – SSC or equivalent marksheet and certificate for those appointed after 2009 to prove Marathi language qualification,
    – Computer qualification certificates (DOEACC/MS-CIT/GECT/other approved).
  • Original certificates must be produced at the time of document verification; absence of originals will render the candidate ineligible for Trade Test and selection.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 17/12/2025
Start date for receipt of applications 22/12/2025 (during office hours)
Last date for receipt of applications 09/01/2026 (during office hours)
Document Verification Date & Time 19/01/2026, 11:00 am to 4:00 pm at Seth A.J.B. Municipal ENT Hospital
Trade Test Date & Time To be notified separately; candidates must attend at their own cost

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Prayogshala Sahayak is in revised pay scale M-13, Rs. 21,700 – 69,000/- as sanctioned by BMC orders.
  • Other allowances and benefits will be admissible as per Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation service rules and applicable government norms for Group ‘C’ posts.

Instructions

  • This recruitment is strictly departmental and limited to in-service BMC staff working as Laboratory Attendant in specified health establishments.
  • Backward category employees who have already availed reservation earlier or are shown as “adhik sankhya” (excess) or whose category change is under process must submit valid Caste and Caste Validity Certificates along with Non-Creamy Layer certificates as applicable; otherwise, their applications will not be considered.
  • All eligible candidates (including backward category) will be considered in general merit list for this isolated post; reservation is not applicable, but category must be correctly mentioned for record purposes.
  • Candidates appointed in Group ‘D’ and later promoted to Group ‘C’ posts must pass compulsory computer examination within 2 years from appointment; otherwise, they may be reverted to original post as per circular MPM/2/3221 dated 14.11.2014.
  • Candidates under departmental inquiry, preliminary inquiry, or suspension will not be considered for appointment until such proceedings are cleared.
  • Selected candidates for Prayogshala Sahayak must submit an application within 2 years from selection date for reversion to original post in case they do not wish to continue; otherwise, their rights to original post will lapse.
  • Applications received under this recruitment process will be considered only for this selection; future vacancies will require fresh recruitment/notification.
  • Waiting list (Pratiksha Yadi), if prepared, will remain valid for 2 years; after that, it will lapse automatically.
  • The administration reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.

HoD level posts in Major Port Authorities, Port official who withdraws his candidature for the post after his selection by the Services Selection Committee, will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy.   • Associate Professor: Academic Pay Level 13A2: ₹ 1,39,600 (Entry Pay) to ₹ 2,11,300 (Max Pay) per month.

Eligibility Criteria for HAL Operator & Staff Nurse 2025

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates applying must have acquired their qualifications through regular mode only. The minimum percentage of marks required in the qualifying examination is 60% for UR/OBC and 50% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.

  • Operator (Electrical) (D6): Diploma in Electrical Engineering.
  • Operator (Electronics) (D6): Diploma in Electronics / Electronics & Tele Communication / Electronics & Communication Engineering.
  • Operator (Mechanical) (D6): Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Operator (Fitter) (C5): SSC/SSLC plus NTC/ ITI plus NAC/NCTVT in the Fitter Trade.
  • Staff Nurse (C5): PUC/Inter + Diploma in General Nursing (Certificate of registration from State Nursing Council or Indian Nursing Council is mandatory).

2. Age Limit

The age limit for HAL Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Maximum Age: 28 years (as on 10-12-2025)
  • Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 10 years for PwBD (over and above category relaxation), up to 7 years for relevant post-qualification experience (max age 35 years with experience), and for Ex-Servicemen as per government norms.

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens.

Personnel engaged on a tenure basis will receive a Consolidated Remuneration every month. The remuneration includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), and Perks & Allowances (25% of Basic Pay).

  • Maximum Salary (Basic Pay for D6 posts): Rs. 23,000/- per month

Candidates will be shortlisted for a Written Test based on the marks secured in the Qualifying Examination (cut-off decided by HAL). The Written Test will be of 2.5 hours duration with Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) in three parts:

  • Part-I: 20 questions on General Awareness.
  • Part-II: 40 questions on English & Reasoning.
  • Part-III: 100 questions on the concerned Discipline.

There is no negative marking, and candidates need at least 50% marks to qualify for document verification. Final selection is subject to document verification, pre-employment medical examination, and character verification.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Junior Engineer (Electrical): Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution with valid certificate
  • Junior Engineer (Mechanical): Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution with valid certificate

  • Municipal Deputy Secretary: Graduate degree with law qualification or legal experience
  • Assistant Law Officer: Graduate with Law degree (LLB) and Marathi language knowledge
  • Biomedical Engineer: Degree in Biomedical Engineering with relevant experience
  • Surgeon: MBBS with MD/MS in Surgery and relevant post-graduate qualification
  • Gynecologist: MBBS with MD/MS in Obstetrics and Gynecology
  • Other Medical Posts: MBBS with respective post-graduate qualifications in the concerned specialization

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidates must possess the required educational qualification from a recognized University/Board/Institution
  • Knowledge of Marathi language is essential for most administrative positions
  • Valid professional registration certificates wherever applicable (for medical posts)
  • Computer knowledge and typing skills for clerical posts

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in municipal corporation or government organization
  • Additional certifications in the relevant field
  • Knowledge of local government procedures and regulations
  • Proficiency in English along with Marathi

Experience

  • For technical posts, relevant work experience in government/municipal bodies is desirable
  • For medical specialist posts, clinical experience in respective specialization is required
  • Fresh graduates can also apply for positions where experience is not mandatory

Salary/Stipend

  • Junior Engineer (Electrical/Mechanical): Rs. 38,600 - 1,22,800 per month
  • Assistant Commissioner: Rs. 44,900 - 1,42,400 per month
  • Municipal Deputy Secretary: Rs. 41,600 - 1,32,300 per month
  • Assistant Law Officer: Rs. 41,600 - 1,32,300 per month
  • Biomedical Engineer: Rs. 56,900 - 1,77,500 per month
  • Surgeon/Gynecologist/Medical Specialists: Rs. 56,900 - 1,77,500 per month

  • Additional allowances like DA, HRA, TA and other benefits as per NMMC rules

  • Maximum Age: 38 years for most posts
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC/ST Candidates: 5 years
    • OBC Candidates: 3 years
    • PWD Candidates: 10 years
    • Ex-Servicemen: As per government rules
    • Women candidates: Additional relaxation as per norms

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Computer-based test covering general knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, technical subjects related to the post, and Marathi language
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in written test will be called for document verification. Candidates must bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Personal Interview/Skill Test: For technical and specialist posts, candidates may have to appear for personal interview and/or skill test
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must undergo medical fitness test as per NMMC norms
  • Final Merit List: Final selection will be based on performance in written test, interview (if applicable) and document verification
  • Typing Test: For Clerk-Typist and similar posts, typing test in Marathi and English will be conducted

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must read the official notification carefully before applying
  • Only online applications through the official website www.nmmc.gov.in will be accepted
  • Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number which should be active during the entire recruitment process
  • Incomplete applications or applications without required documents will be rejected
  • False information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • NMMC reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage
  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply unless otherwise specified
  • Candidates already employed in government/semi-government organizations must produce NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their employer
  • Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for a period as per NMMC rules
  • The decision of NMMC in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate
  • No TA/DA will be provided for attending the exam or interview

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation at www.nmmc.gov.in
  • Step 2: On the homepage, locate the "Recruitment" or "Career" section
  • Step 3: Click on the relevant recruitment notification link for NMMC Recruitment 2025
  • Step 4: Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Online" button to start the application process
  • Step 6: Register yourself by providing basic details like name, email ID, and mobile number
  • Step 7: After registration, login using the credentials received on your email/mobile
  • Step 8: Fill the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and other required details
  • Step 9: Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and other required documents in prescribed format and size
  • Step 10: Pay the application fee online through available payment modes (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI)
  • Step 11: Review all the entered information carefully before final submission
  • Step 12: Submit the application form and take a printout of the confirmation page for future reference
  • Step 13: Keep the payment receipt and application confirmation safe until the recruitment process is complete
